title: Intel Foveros 封裝案例
summary: 從Foveros 平台變體與立體功能分割拆成 4 階段、24 項可保存的工程作業；包含物理模型、算例、可區分失效的量測與驗收證據。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 saveable work packages investigate Foveros variants and three-dimensional functional partitioning, including physical models, a worked example, discriminating measurements and acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開原理的概念設計與資料判讀課，非供應商配方或可直接投產的操作程序。算例全部是教學假設；真正驗收須使用適用版本、合格設備與實測參數。代表照片、示意圖與影片不宣稱為每步製造實拍。
scopeEn: Conceptual design and data interpretation from public principles, not a vendor recipe or production-ready procedure. All worked inputs are educational assumptions. Real acceptance requires the applicable revision, qualified equipment and measured parameters. Representative media are not claimed as footage of every operation.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假設互連等效 C=20 fF、電壓 V=0.7 V：電容儲能½CV²=4.9 fJ。理想電阻充電時電源供能 CV²=9.8 fJ，其中一半在充電路徑耗散；完整充放電週期從電源取9.8 fJ。若活動率定義為每週期0→1機率，P=αCV²f；不能把4.9 fJ稱為完整晶片每位元能量。
workedExample.textEn: For C=20 fF and V=0.7 V, stored energy ½CV²=4.9 fJ. A resistive charge draws CV²=9.8 fJ from the supply, half dissipated during charging; a full charge/discharge cycle draws 9.8 fJ. If α is the probability of a 0-to-1 event per cycle, P=αCV²f. The 4.9 fJ is not full-chip energy per bit.
workedExample.assumptions: 理想線性電容與電阻充放電，排除漏電、短路、驅動器、時鐘和協議開銷；數值不是 Foveros 規格。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Ideal linear capacitor/resistive charging excludes leakage, short-circuit, drivers, clocks and protocol overhead; values are not Foveros specifications.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行編寫的假想算例；原始資料支援領域原理，不提供這組假設數值。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently authored hypothetical exercise; primary sources support the field, not these chosen inputs.

stages.title: 變體與接合路線
stages.description: 以三個技術單元檢查「變體與接合路線」，每一單元交付設計模型及獨立判別證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Three technical units examine variants and bonding routes, each delivering a model and independent diagnostic evidence.

steps.title: 名稱與版本：模型與設計
steps.titleEn: Names and revisions: model and design
steps.objective: 以「名稱與版本」建立可檢驗的物理模型，交付可重算且列明邊界的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a falsifiable physical model for names and revisions, with reproducible calculations and stated boundaries.
steps.instruction: 先以師傅示意確認「名稱與版本」的輸入、輸出與座標，再在學徒工作台完成對應元件或資料流的排列。Foveros 平台有不同整合路線，不能把所有名稱都當成同一 Cu-Cu 接合結構。 用本單元的變數畫出至少兩種設計狀態，說明它們在「按官方日期將 Foveros-S、R 和 Direct 3D 分列，區分已提供與規劃中。」的驗證中應有何差異；把待量測參數另列，不以動畫位置當成實際公差。
steps.instructionEn: Use the mentor view to identify the inputs, outputs and coordinates for names and revisions, then arrange the corresponding components or data flow in the apprentice workspace. Foveros includes different integration routes; not every name denotes the same Cu-Cu bond structure. Draw at least two design states using this unit's variables and predict how the following verification distinguishes them: List S, R and Direct 3D by official revision, distinguishing available and planned offerings. List unmeasured parameters separately; animation positions are not manufacturing tolerances.
steps.observation: 按官方日期將 Foveros-S、R 和 Direct 3D 分列，區分已提供與規劃中。
steps.observationEn: List S, R and Direct 3D by official revision, distinguishing available and planned offerings.
steps.failure: 須排除的錯誤假說：所有 Foveros 變體都具有完全相同的接合材料和架構。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: Every Foveros variant has identical bonding material and architecture. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.
steps.check: 提交名稱與版本的兩狀態模型、變數表，以及能由「按官方日期將 Foveros-S、R 和 Direct 3D 分列，區分已提供與規劃中。」反駁模型的預測。
steps.checkEn: Submit two model states and a variable table for names and revisions, plus a falsifiable prediction using: List S, R and Direct 3D by official revision, distinguishing available and planned offerings.

knowledge.textEn: Bridges must meet die shoreline contacts; rotation or size changes can alter reachability.

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與證據
knowledge.text: 在俯視圖標出每段邊界的訊號數與禁佈區，檢查未連通端點。
knowledge.textEn: Map signal counts/keepouts by shoreline and check disconnected endpoints.

knowledge.title: 量化模型與適用邊界
knowledge.text: td≈L√εeff/c；均勻低損近似的固定延遲需和反射、色散及抖動分開。 準 TEM、均勻有效介質與固定頻段的教學近似，未包含接點不連續及導體損耗。
knowledge.textEn: td≈L√εeff/c; separate uniform low-loss fixed delay from reflection, dispersion and jitter. Teaching quasi-TEM uniform-effective-medium approximation over a fixed band; contact discontinuities and conductor loss are excluded.

quiz.question: 要審查「邊界配置」，哪項主張或驗證方法有根據？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or verification is justified when reviewing shoreline placement?
options: 所有 EMIB 版本永遠都不可能含 TSV。
橋須與晶粒接點邊界對接，晶粒旋轉或尺寸改變可能改變可達連接。
只減少矽面積就保證總封裝成本較低。
optionsEn: No EMIB variant can ever contain TSVs.
Bridges must meet die shoreline contacts; rotation or size changes can alter reachability.
Reducing silicon area guarantees a lower total package cost.
quiz.explanation: 橋須與晶粒接點邊界對接，晶粒旋轉或尺寸改變可能改變可達連接。 在俯視圖標出每段邊界的訊號數與禁佈區，檢查未連通端點。
quiz.explanationEn: Bridges must meet die shoreline contacts; rotation or size changes can alter reachability. Map signal counts/keepouts by shoreline and check disconnected endpoints.

steps.title: 邊界配置：量測與判別
steps.objective: 以「邊界配置」區分機制並作出有證據的驗收決定，交付可重算且列明邊界的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Discriminate mechanisms and make an evidence-based acceptance decision for shoreline placement, with reproducible calculations and stated boundaries.
steps.instruction: 保留上一作業的模型，現在檢驗它是否足以解釋觀察。在俯視圖標出每段邊界的訊號數與禁佈區，檢查未連通端點。 記錄原始量、單位、基準與重複量測差異；以支持及否定各一項證據比較「橋須與晶粒接點邊界對接，晶粒旋轉或尺寸改變可能改變可達連接。」與錯誤假說「所有 EMIB 版本永遠都不可能含 TSV。」，最後提出放行、重測或修模決定。 假想均勻傳輸線長 L=5 mm、有效相對介電常數 εeff=4，v≈c/√εeff=1.50×10⁸ m/s，因此單向傳播延遲約33.3 ps。若資料單位間隔 UI=100 ps，此延遲為0.333 UI，但固定延遲不是同量的抖動或眼圖閉合。這不是 EMIB 產品長度或材料規格。
steps.instructionEn: Retain the previous model and test whether it explains the observations. Map signal counts/keepouts by shoreline and check disconnected endpoints. Record raw quantities, units, reference conditions and repeatability. Use supporting and falsifying evidence to compare "Bridges must meet die shoreline contacts; rotation or size changes can alter reachability." against the incorrect hypothesis "No EMIB variant can ever contain TSVs."; decide whether to accept, repeat or revise the model. For a hypothetical 5 mm uniform line with εeff=4, v≈c/√εeff=1.50×10⁸ m/s, giving about 33.3 ps one-way delay. At a 100 ps UI this is 0.333 UI; fixed delay is not equivalent jitter or eye closure. These are not EMIB product dimensions/materials.
steps.observation: 在俯視圖標出每段邊界的訊號數與禁佈區，檢查未連通端點。
steps.observationEn: Map signal counts/keepouts by shoreline and check disconnected endpoints.
steps.failure: 須排除的錯誤假說：所有 EMIB 版本永遠都不可能含 TSV。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: No EMIB variant can ever contain TSVs. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.
steps.check: 提交邊界配置的量測判別表：在俯視圖標出每段邊界的訊號數與禁佈區，檢查未連通端點。 附上基準、重複性或不確定度，及不能由本資料判定的結論。
steps.checkEn: Submit a measurement-discrimination table for shoreline placement: Map signal counts/keepouts by shoreline and check disconnected endpoints. Include the reference, repeatability or uncertainty, and conclusions the data cannot support.

steps.instructionEn: Use the mentor view to identify the inputs, outputs and coordinates for bridge placement error, then arrange the corresponding components or data flow in the apprentice workspace. Bridge/substrate/die placement form an error chain; tool accuracy is not final accuracy. Draw at least two design states using this unit's variables and predict how the following verification distinguishes them: Separate bias/random error and use justified correlations for worst-case or statistical stacking. List unmeasured parameters separately; animation positions are not manufacturing tolerances.

steps.check: 提交橋接位置誤差的兩狀態模型、變數表，以及能由「區分偏差和隨機誤差，以適用相關性計算最壞界限或統計疊加。」反駁模型的預測。

title: imec iSiPP 矽光子平台
summary: 從iSiPP 平台選擇、授權設計與驗證交付拆成 4 階段、24 項可保存的工程作業；包含物理模型、算例、可區分失效的量測與驗收證據。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 saveable work packages investigate iSiPP platform selection, licensed design and verification handoff, including physical models, a worked example, discriminating measurements and acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開原理的概念設計與資料判讀課，非供應商配方或可直接投產的操作程序。算例全部是教學假設；真正驗收須使用適用版本、合格設備與實測參數。代表照片、示意圖與影片不宣稱為每步製造實拍。
scopeEn: Conceptual design and data interpretation from public principles, not a vendor recipe or production-ready procedure. All worked inputs are educational assumptions. Real acceptance requires the applicable revision, qualified equipment and measured parameters. Representative media are not claimed as footage of every operation.

workedExample.title: 可重算的教學算例
workedExample.text: 假想環形腔光路長 L=1 mm、群折射率 ng=4、中心波長 λ=1550 nm。小範圍近似 FSRλ≈λ²/(ngL)=1550²/(4×1,000,000)=0.6006 nm；頻率間距 c/(ngL)≈74.95 GHz。這只估計間距，不提供共振線寬、Q 或插入損耗，也不是 iSiPP 的元件規格。
workedExample.textEn: For a hypothetical ring of path length 1 mm, group index 4 and wavelength 1550 nm, the local FSR approximation is λ²/(ngL)=0.6006 nm; frequency spacing is c/(ngL)≈74.95 GHz. This estimates spacing, not linewidth, Q or insertion loss, and is not an iSiPP device specification.
workedExample.assumptions: 單一模態、局部近似與假想群折射率；未包含耦合器相位色散、溫度漂移及實際製程分布。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Single mode, local approximation and hypothetical group index; coupler phase dispersion, thermal drift and process distributions are excluded.
workedExample.sourceScope: 自行編寫的假想算例；原始資料支援領域原理，不提供這組假設數值。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Independently authored hypothetical exercise; primary sources support the field, not these chosen inputs.

steps.title: 元件庫邊界：量測與判別
steps.objective: 以「元件庫邊界」區分機制並作出有證據的驗收決定，交付可重算且列明邊界的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Discriminate mechanisms and make an evidence-based acceptance decision for library boundary, with reproducible calculations and stated boundaries.
steps.instruction: 保留上一作業的模型，現在檢驗它是否足以解釋觀察。建立元件、模型、版本與授權來源對照，不複製受限 PDK。 記錄原始量、單位、基準與重複量測差異；以支持及否定各一項證據比較「公開元件清單提供能力入口；完整參數、設計規則和模型需要適用授權版本。」與錯誤假說「iSiPP200 和 iSiPP300 除尺寸外所有規則和元件完全相同。」，最後提出放行、重測或修模決定。 假想環形腔光路長 L=1 mm、群折射率 ng=4、中心波長 λ=1550 nm。小範圍近似 FSRλ≈λ²/(ngL)=1550²/(4×1,000,000)=0.6006 nm；頻率間距 c/(ngL)≈74.95 GHz。這只估計間距，不提供共振線寬、Q 或插入損耗，也不是 iSiPP 的元件規格。
steps.instructionEn: Retain the previous model and test whether it explains the observations. Map devices, models, revisions and licensed sources without copying restricted PDKs. Record raw quantities, units, reference conditions and repeatability. Use supporting and falsifying evidence to compare "Public component lists describe capabilities; full parameters, rules and models require the licensed revision." against the incorrect hypothesis "iSiPP200 and iSiPP300 differ only in diameter, with identical rules and devices."; decide whether to accept, repeat or revise the model. For a hypothetical ring of path length 1 mm, group index 4 and wavelength 1550 nm, the local FSR approximation is λ²/(ngL)=0.6006 nm; frequency spacing is c/(ngL)≈74.95 GHz. This estimates spacing, not linewidth, Q or insertion loss, and is not an iSiPP device specification.
steps.observation: 建立元件、模型、版本與授權來源對照，不複製受限 PDK。
steps.observationEn: Map devices, models, revisions and licensed sources without copying restricted PDKs.
steps.failure: 須排除的錯誤假說：iSiPP200 和 iSiPP300 除尺寸外所有規則和元件完全相同。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: iSiPP200 and iSiPP300 differ only in diameter, with identical rules and devices. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.
steps.check: 提交元件庫邊界的量測判別表：建立元件、模型、版本與授權來源對照，不複製受限 PDK。 附上基準、重複性或不確定度，及不能由本資料判定的結論。

steps.titleEn: Poles and speed: model and design
steps.objective: 針對「極數與轉速」建立可重算、可檢查的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a reproducible, reviewable engineering record for poles and speed.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，標出「極數與轉速」的輸入、輸出及量測基準，再在學徒工作台排列對應元件或資料流。同步轉速由頻率與極數共同決定。 在離線草圖或試算表建立基準與擾動兩種情境，寫出因果預測；用「比較二極與四極的轉速表。」規劃如何反駁模型。把未知參數、單位與邊界記錄在學習筆記。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor diagram, identify inputs, outputs and references for poles and speed, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Frequency and pole count jointly determine synchronous speed. Build baseline and perturbed cases offline and predict causality. Plan a falsification using: Compare two- and four-pole speed tables. Record unknown parameters, units and boundaries in your learning notes.
steps.observation: 比較二極與四極的轉速表。
steps.observationEn: Compare two- and four-pole speed tables.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「極數與轉速」的驗證。 應先核對量測基準、模型邊界及競爭失效原因。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Equal nominal ratings justify skipping poles and speed verification. Check references, model boundaries and competing failure causes first.
steps.check: 提交「極數與轉速」的兩情境模型、單位表及可反駁預測；說明「比較二極與四極的轉速表。」如何區分情境。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case model, units and a falsifiable prediction for poles and speed; explain how the proposed check distinguishes cases.

knowledge.title: 本單元機制
knowledge.text: 同步轉速由頻率與極數共同決定。
knowledge.textEn: Frequency and pole count jointly determine synchronous speed.

knowledge.title: 可區分原因的證據
knowledge.text: 比較二極與四極的轉速表。 必須保留基準、單位及不確定度，未有實測資料時只做假想案例判讀。
knowledge.textEn: Compare two- and four-pole speed tables. Retain references, units and uncertainty; without measured data, interpret hypothetical cases only.

knowledge.title: 本課量化連結
knowledge.text: 教學假設二極同步機接 60 Hz：n=120f/p=3600 rpm；若輸出 100 MW、效率 98%，輸入 102.041 MW、損失 2.041 MW。效率為假設且未含汽輪機熱效率。
knowledge.textEn: Assume a two-pole synchronous machine at 60 Hz: n=120f/p=3600 rpm. At 100 MW output and assumed 98% efficiency, input is 102.041 MW and loss 2.041 MW; turbine thermal efficiency is excluded.

quiz.question: 審查「極數與轉速」時，哪個判斷或驗證方法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or check is justified for poles and speed?
options: 同步轉速由頻率與極數共同決定。
只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「極數與轉速」的驗證。
只調整「極數與轉速」的顯示結果吻合，便可當作獨立量測證據。
optionsEn: Frequency and pole count jointly determine synchronous speed.
Equal nominal ratings justify skipping poles and speed verification.
Tuning the displayed poles and speed result to match counts as independent measurement evidence.
quiz.explanation: 同步轉速由頻率與極數共同決定。 比較二極與四極的轉速表。
quiz.explanationEn: Frequency and pole count jointly determine synchronous speed. Compare two- and four-pole speed tables.

steps.title: 極數與轉速：量測與判讀
steps.titleEn: Poles and speed: measurement and diagnosis
steps.objective: 針對「極數與轉速」建立可重算、可檢查的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a reproducible, reviewable engineering record for poles and speed.
steps.instruction: 先重播本單元模型，讀取兩種假想情境而不接觸真實帶電設備。比較二極與四極的轉速表。 比較差異是否符合「同步轉速由頻率與極數共同決定。」；列出至少兩個競爭原因，指定能區分原因的新增量測。先依專案規格訂接受條件，再納入量測不確定度，將未驗證項保持為未決。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit model and inspect two hypothetical cases without accessing energized equipment. Compare two- and four-pole speed tables. Compare the result against: Frequency and pole count jointly determine synchronous speed. List at least two competing causes and select an additional discriminating measurement. Define acceptance from project requirements before observing results, include uncertainty and retain unverified items as unresolved.
steps.observation: 比較二極與四極的轉速表。
steps.observationEn: Compare two- and four-pole speed tables.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「極數與轉速」的驗證。 應先核對量測基準、模型邊界及競爭失效原因。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Equal nominal ratings justify skipping poles and speed verification. Check references, model boundaries and competing failure causes first.
steps.check: 提交「極數與轉速」的量測比較、誤差來源及放行／保留理由；不能用單一平均值掩蓋最差條件。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement comparison, error sources and accept/hold rationale for poles and speed; do not hide limiting conditions behind one average.

steps.title: 轉子圓周應力：模型與設計
steps.titleEn: Rotor hoop stress: model and design
steps.objective: 針對「轉子圓周應力」建立可重算、可檢查的工程紀錄。

steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor diagram, identify inputs, outputs and references for rotor hoop stress, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Centrifugal stress scales approximately with squared speed. Build baseline and perturbed cases offline and predict causality. Plan a falsification using: Compare equal geometry at 1.0 and 1.1 speed. Record unknown parameters, units and boundaries in your learning notes.

summary: 以轉速、電磁負載與轉子熱機械限制串連 12 個技術單元；新增 24 步，包含原理、假想算例、量測設計、失效辨識與驗收證據。
summaryEn: Twelve technical units connect speed, electromagnetic loading and rotor thermomechanical limits through 24 new tasks with principles, hypothetical calculations, measurement design, failure discrimination and acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開原理的離線工程教育與報告判讀。數值為自行設定的教學假設，非產品保證、現場整定、製造配方或帶電操作程序；高壓、旋轉與大型設備實務由合格團隊依正式規格驗證。完成課程不是專業執照。
scopeEn: Offline engineering education and report interpretation from public principles. Inputs are independently chosen teaching assumptions, not product guarantees, field settings, recipes or live-work procedures. Qualified teams validate high-voltage, rotating and large equipment under formal requirements. Course completion is not professional licensure.

steps.failure: 常見誤判：只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「狀態交接」的驗證。 應先核對量測基準、模型邊界及競爭失效原因。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Equal nominal ratings justify skipping condition handoff verification. Check references, model boundaries and competing failure causes first.
steps.check: 提交「狀態交接」的兩情境模型、單位表及可反駁預測；說明「以相同工況比較趨勢而非單點。」如何區分情境。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case model, units and a falsifiable prediction for condition handoff; explain how the proposed check distinguishes cases.

knowledge.title: 本單元機制
knowledge.text: 振動基準須記錄水頭與負載條件。
knowledge.textEn: Vibration baselines require head and load conditions.

knowledge.title: 可區分原因的證據
knowledge.text: 以相同工況比較趨勢而非單點。 必須保留基準、單位及不確定度，未有實測資料時只做假想案例判讀。
knowledge.textEn: Compare matched operating conditions, not isolated values. Retain references, units and uncertainty; without measured data, interpret hypothetical cases only.

knowledge.title: 本課量化連結
knowledge.text: 假設 60 Hz、40 極，n=180 rpm；水頭 50 m、流量 100 m³/s、整體效率 0.90，P=ρgQHη≈44.145 MW（ρ=1000 kg/m³，g=9.81 m/s²）。未含水頭隨流量變動。
knowledge.textEn: For 60 Hz and 40 poles, n=180 rpm. With head 50 m, flow 100 m³/s and overall efficiency 0.90, P=ρgQHη≈44.145 MW using ρ=1000 kg/m³ and g=9.81 m/s²; flow-dependent head is omitted.

quiz.question: 審查「狀態交接」時，哪個判斷或驗證方法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or check is justified for condition handoff?
options: 只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「狀態交接」的驗證。
振動基準須記錄水頭與負載條件。
只調整「狀態交接」的顯示結果吻合，便可當作獨立量測證據。
optionsEn: Equal nominal ratings justify skipping condition handoff verification.
Vibration baselines require head and load conditions.
Tuning the displayed condition handoff result to match counts as independent measurement evidence.
quiz.explanation: 振動基準須記錄水頭與負載條件。 以相同工況比較趨勢而非單點。
quiz.explanationEn: Vibration baselines require head and load conditions. Compare matched operating conditions, not isolated values.

steps.title: 狀態交接：量測與判讀
steps.objective: 針對「狀態交接」建立可重算、可檢查的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a reproducible, reviewable engineering record for condition handoff.
steps.instruction: 先重播本單元模型，讀取兩種假想情境而不接觸真實帶電設備。以相同工況比較趨勢而非單點。 比較差異是否符合「振動基準須記錄水頭與負載條件。」；列出至少兩個競爭原因，指定能區分原因的新增量測。先依專案規格訂接受條件，再納入量測不確定度，將未驗證項保持為未決。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit model and inspect two hypothetical cases without accessing energized equipment. Compare matched operating conditions, not isolated values. Compare the result against: Vibration baselines require head and load conditions. List at least two competing causes and select an additional discriminating measurement. Define acceptance from project requirements before observing results, include uncertainty and retain unverified items as unresolved.
steps.observation: 以相同工況比較趨勢而非單點。
steps.observationEn: Compare matched operating conditions, not isolated values.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「狀態交接」的驗證。 應先核對量測基準、模型邊界及競爭失效原因。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Equal nominal ratings justify skipping condition handoff verification. Check references, model boundaries and competing failure causes first.
steps.check: 提交「狀態交接」的量測比較、誤差來源及放行／保留理由；不能用單一平均值掩蓋最差條件。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement comparison, error sources and accept/hold rationale for condition handoff; do not hide limiting conditions behind one average.

summary: 以多極磁路、氣隙偏心與垂直軸承串連 12 個技術單元；新增 24 步，包含原理、假想算例、量測設計、失效辨識與驗收證據。
summaryEn: Twelve technical units connect multipolar magnetics, air-gap eccentricity and vertical bearings through 24 new tasks with principles, hypothetical calculations, measurement design, failure discrimination and acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開原理的離線工程教育與報告判讀。數值為自行設定的教學假設，非產品保證、現場整定、製造配方或帶電操作程序；高壓、旋轉與大型設備實務由合格團隊依正式規格驗證。完成課程不是專業執照。
scopeEn: Offline engineering education and report interpretation from public principles. Inputs are independently chosen teaching assumptions, not product guarantees, field settings, recipes or live-work procedures. Qualified teams validate high-voltage, rotating and large equipment under formal requirements. Course completion is not professional licensure.

workedExample.title: 含假設的可重算例
workedExample.text: 假設 60 Hz、40 極，n=180 rpm；水頭 50 m、流量 100 m³/s、整體效率 0.90，P=ρgQHη≈44.145 MW（ρ=1000 kg/m³，g=9.81 m/s²）。未含水頭隨流量變動。
workedExample.textEn: For 60 Hz and 40 poles, n=180 rpm. With head 50 m, flow 100 m³/s and overall efficiency 0.90, P=ρgQHη≈44.145 MW using ρ=1000 kg/m³ and g=9.81 m/s²; flow-dependent head is omitted.
workedExample.assumptions: 算例內列出的參數及理想化條件；更改波形、材料、溫度、拓撲或模型邊界後須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Use the stated parameters and idealizations; recalculate after changing waveforms, materials, temperature, topology or boundaries.
workedExample.sourceScope: 作者原創的假想數值題；官方資料支援領域脈絡，並非這組數字的實測來源。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original hypothetical numerical exercise; official sources support context, not measurements of these inputs.

vendorHints.name: Voith
vendorHints.role: 水力發電機：可用來比較本課的設備／元件／設計工具角色；不代表本網站推薦或廠商授課。
vendorHints.roleEn: Hydropower generators: compare the equipment, component or design-tool role in this course; no endorsement or vendor teaching is implied.

title: 大型電力變壓器製造
summary: 以頻率響應、含水絕緣與短路力的進階診斷串連 12 個技術單元；新增 24 步，包含原理、假想算例、量測設計、失效辨識與驗收證據。 原有步驟完整保留。
summaryEn: Twelve technical units connect advanced diagnosis of frequency response, moist insulation and short-circuit forces through 24 new tasks with principles, hypothetical calculations, measurement design, failure discrimination and acceptance evidence. Existing tasks are preserved.

stages.title: 電磁需求與主動部件
stages.description: 將額定需求轉成鐵心、繞組與損失的設計問題。
stages.descriptionEn: Translate ratings into core, winding and loss considerations.

steps.title: 界定變比、容量與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Define ratio, rating and system boundary
steps.objective: 區分電壓比、容量、頻率與冷卻條件。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish voltage ratio, power rating, frequency and cooling conditions.
steps.instruction: 畫出一次側、磁心、二次側與冷卻系統，在紙上名牌分別填入明確假設的電壓比、容量與頻率。比較兩台變比相同但容量不同的設備，說明為何不能互換使用。
steps.instructionEn: Draw primary, core, secondary and cooling system. Enter explicitly hypothetical ratio, rating and frequency on a paper nameplate, then compare equal-ratio units with different ratings and explain why they are not interchangeable.
steps.observation: 相同變比不代表具有相同導體尺寸、散熱能力或絕緣配置。
steps.observationEn: Equal ratio does not imply equal conductor size, cooling capability or insulation arrangement.
steps.failure: 把電壓比當作全部規格，會漏掉電流、熱及系統條件。
steps.failureEn: Treating voltage ratio as the complete specification omits current, thermal and system conditions.
steps.check: 需求表分開列明變比、額定能力、頻率及使用環境假設。
steps.checkEn: Record ratio, rated capability, frequency and environmental assumptions separately.

knowledge.title: 額定條件
knowledge.text: 額定能力必須連同適用條件解讀。
knowledge.textEn: Rated capability must be interpreted with its applicable conditions.

knowledge.title: 系統邊界
knowledge.text: 主動部件、絕緣與冷卻共同限制可用能力。
knowledge.textEn: Active parts, insulation and cooling jointly constrain usable capability.

quiz.question: 兩台變壓器變比相同，能否直接互換？
quiz.questionEn: Can equal-ratio transformers be exchanged without further review?
options: 不能，還需核對容量、頻率、絕緣及系統條件。
能，變比相同代表額定電流也必然相同。
能，兩台只要具有相同端子數便完全相容。
optionsEn: No; rating, frequency, insulation and system conditions still need checking.
Yes; equal ratio guarantees equal current ratings.
Yes; equal terminal count establishes full compatibility.
quiz.explanation: 不能，還需核對容量、頻率、絕緣及系統條件。 額定能力必須連同適用條件解讀。
quiz.explanationEn: No; rating, frequency, insulation and system conditions still need checking. Rated capability must be interpreted with its applicable conditions.

steps.title: 用理想模型核對匝數比與功率
steps.titleEn: Check turns ratio and power in an ideal model
steps.objective: 理解升壓與電流變化的對應，而不把理想結果當額定設計。
steps.objectiveEn: Relate voltage transformation to current without treating an ideal result as rated design.
steps.instruction: 在紙上假設匝數比 10:1、一次電壓 100 V，推得理想二次電壓 10 V。再假設功率因數為 1 的理想輸出 100 W，求兩側電流並檢查功率平衡；這些只作算術，不接線通電。
steps.instructionEn: On paper, assume a 10:1 turns ratio and 100 V primary to obtain 10 V ideally. Assume 100 W ideal output at unity power factor, calculate both currents and check power balance; perform no wiring or energization.
steps.observation: 降壓時理想二次電流增加，並不是憑空產生更多功率。
steps.observationEn: In step-down operation, ideal secondary current increases without creating extra power.
steps.failure: 將電壓與電流比同方向套用會破壞能量平衡。
steps.failureEn: Applying voltage and current ratios in the same direction breaks the ideal power balance.
steps.check: 得到一次 1 A、二次 10 A，並列出損失與激磁尚未納入。
steps.checkEn: Obtain 1 A primary and 10 A secondary and state that losses and excitation are omitted.

knowledge.title: 理想能量平衡
knowledge.text: 理想變壓器改變電壓與電流的比例，同時維持功率平衡。
knowledge.textEn: An ideal transformer changes voltage and current ratios while conserving power.

knowledge.title: 模型限制
knowledge.text: 實際設備有損失、激磁與熱限制，不能由匝數比推得所有額定能力。 此例電流試算另假設功率因數為 1。
knowledge.textEn: Real units have losses, excitation and thermal limits; turns ratio does not determine every rating. The current calculation also assumes unity power factor.

quiz.question: 本例理想二次電流為多少？
quiz.questionEn: What is the ideal secondary current in this example?
quiz.explanation: 10 A。 理想變壓器改變電壓與電流的比例，同時維持功率平衡。
quiz.explanationEn: 10 A. An ideal transformer changes voltage and current ratios while conserving power.

steps.title: 辨認疊片磁心與磁路連續性
steps.titleEn: Identify a laminated core and magnetic path
steps.objective: 區分導磁路徑與導電短接風險。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish the magnetic path from unwanted conductive paths.
steps.instruction: 用原創截面畫出柱、軛與絕緣疊片，沿磁路追蹤一圈。比較整塊導電材料與薄片隔離的概念，並把接縫、缺口及裝配受力列為需由設計文件確認的項目。
steps.instructionEn: Draw limbs, yokes and insulated laminations and trace the magnetic path. Compare a solid conductive core with isolated sheets and list joints, gaps and assembly loads for review against the design documentation.
steps.observation: 層間絕緣與磁路連續具有不同目的，不能互相取代。
steps.observationEn: Interlaminar insulation and magnetic continuity serve different purposes.
steps.failure: 若把所有疊片用導電橋連成一體，不能只憑機械更牢固就判定改善。
steps.failureEn: Conductively bridging laminations cannot be judged beneficial merely because the structure appears stronger.
steps.check: 模型清楚標示磁路、疊片方向與應保護的層間狀態。
steps.checkEn: Mark the magnetic path, lamination orientation and interlaminar condition to preserve.

knowledge.title: 疊片作用
knowledge.text: 磁心使用分層電工鋼，以兼顧導磁與損失控制。
knowledge.textEn: Layered electrical steel supports magnetic flux while helping control losses.

knowledge.title: 接縫與機械
knowledge.text: 接縫配置與支撐須服從核准設計，不能由外觀任意改動。
knowledge.textEn: Joint layout and support follow an approved design, not arbitrary visual preference.

quiz.question: 為何不能把層間絕緣視為無關細節？
quiz.questionEn: Why is interlaminar insulation not a trivial detail?
options: 它只影響表面防鏽，不影響電磁損失。
只要磁心尺寸足夠，層間導電狀態便不重要。
它關係到不希望出現的導電路徑與損失。
optionsEn: It affects only corrosion protection, not electromagnetic loss.
Sufficient core size makes interlaminar conduction irrelevant.
It affects unwanted conductive paths and losses.
quiz.explanation: 它關係到不希望出現的導電路徑與損失。 磁心使用分層電工鋼，以兼顧導磁與損失控制。
quiz.explanationEn: It affects unwanted conductive paths and losses. Layered electrical steel supports magnetic flux while helping control losses.

steps.title: 比較繞組導體、電阻與熱負擔
steps.titleEn: Compare winding conductors, resistance and heat
steps.objective: 把電流路徑與熱產生連在一起。
steps.objectiveEn: Connect current paths to heat generation.
steps.instruction: 在繞組示意圖標出導體長度、截面與連接點。以相同電阻的假設比較電流 I 與 2I 的 I²R 損失，再指出實際設計還需考慮交流與散熱效應。
steps.instructionEn: Mark conductor length, cross-section and joints on a winding schematic. At hypothetical fixed resistance, compare I²R loss for I and 2I, then identify additional AC and cooling considerations in real design.
steps.observation: 局部接點電阻偏高可形成熱點，即使整體尺寸看起來合理。
steps.observationEn: Elevated local joint resistance can create a hotspot even when overall dimensions look reasonable.
steps.failure: 只用直流電阻估計所有交流損失會不完整；保留模型邊界。
steps.failureEn: DC resistance alone does not capture every AC loss; keep the model boundary explicit.
steps.check: 說明電流加倍的示例損失變成四倍，而非把它當作整機溫升預測。
steps.checkEn: Explain fourfold loss in the doubled-current example without claiming a full-unit temperature-rise prediction.

knowledge.title: 電阻熱
knowledge.text: 固定電阻的 I²R 模型顯示電流增加會更快增加熱負擔。
knowledge.textEn: At fixed resistance, I²R shows heat burden increasing faster than current.

knowledge.title: 熱點與平均
knowledge.text: 平均溫度不能保證局部接點沒有異常。
knowledge.textEn: An average temperature does not rule out abnormal local joints.

quiz.question: 固定電阻下電流加倍，電阻損失如何變化？
quiz.questionEn: With fixed resistance, how does resistive loss change when current doubles?
options: 變成四倍。
保持不變。
減為四分之一。
optionsEn: It becomes four times greater.
It stays unchanged.
It becomes one quarter.
quiz.explanation: 變成四倍。 固定電阻的 I²R 模型顯示電流增加會更快增加熱負擔。
quiz.explanationEn: It becomes four times greater. At fixed resistance, I²R shows heat burden increasing faster than current.

stages.title: 絕緣與機械整合
stages.description: 把絕緣、支撐、乾燥與油箱視為互相影響的系統。
stages.descriptionEn: Treat insulation, support, drying and tanking as interacting systems.

steps.title: 配置主絕緣、匝間絕緣與油隙
steps.titleEn: Map major insulation, turn insulation and oil gaps
steps.objective: 分辨不同電位之間的絕緣任務。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish insulation duties between different potentials.
steps.instruction: 在不通電的剖面模型為繞組、磁心與油箱標記相對電位，將匝間、繞組間及對地絕緣分色。比較改變間距對電場和空間配置的概念影響，不自行指定高壓耐受值。
steps.instructionEn: In a de-energized section, label relative potentials of windings, core and tank. Color turn, winding-to-winding and ground insulation separately and compare spacing effects without inventing high-voltage withstand ratings.
steps.observation: 同一厚度的材料處於不同幾何位置，可能承受不同局部電場。
steps.observationEn: Equal material thickness in different geometries can face different local electric fields.
steps.failure: 只增加某處間距而阻擋冷卻通道，可能改善一項卻損害另一項。
steps.failureEn: Increasing a clearance while obstructing cooling can improve one aspect and harm another.
steps.check: 標示各絕緣介面、其功能與需由正式設計確認的條件。
steps.checkEn: Mark each insulation interface, its function and conditions requiring formal design verification.

knowledge.title: 多介面絕緣
knowledge.text: 紙、壓板與絕緣液各承擔不同介面和支撐功能。
knowledge.textEn: Paper, pressboard and insulating liquid serve different interface and support functions.

knowledge.title: 電熱耦合
knowledge.text: 絕緣配置亦影響散熱及機械布局，不能只看單一間距。
knowledge.textEn: Insulation layout also affects cooling and mechanics, not just one clearance.

quiz.question: 增加絕緣距離時，還應共同檢查什麼？
quiz.questionEn: What else should be checked when insulation spacing increases?
options: 只需重新計算匝數比，熱路徑不會受影響。
冷卻通道與機械布局是否受影響。
只要絕緣材料相同，機械與冷卻布局不需重查。
optionsEn: Recalculate only turns ratio; thermal paths cannot be affected.
Whether cooling paths and mechanical layout are affected.
Identical insulation material eliminates review of mechanical and cooling layout.
quiz.explanation: 冷卻通道與機械布局是否受影響。 紙、壓板與絕緣液各承擔不同介面和支撐功能。
quiz.explanationEn: Whether cooling paths and mechanical layout are affected. Paper, pressboard and insulating liquid serve different interface and support functions.

steps.title: 追蹤繞組支撐與力的傳遞
steps.titleEn: Trace winding support and load paths
steps.objective: 理解異常電流下的機械完整性需要設計驗證。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand that mechanical integrity under abnormal current requires design verification.
steps.instruction: 在繞組、墊塊、夾件與支架示意圖畫出徑向和軸向受力路徑。比較支撐完整與缺少一處支撐的案例，指出哪些位移可能損害絕緣；不提供現場鎖固力矩。
steps.instructionEn: Draw radial and axial load paths through windings, spacers, clamps and supports. Compare complete support with one missing support and identify displacements that could damage insulation without prescribing tightening torque.
steps.observation: 外殼沒有明顯變形，不代表內部繞組位置沒有改變。
steps.observationEn: An unchanged enclosure does not prove unchanged internal winding positions.
steps.failure: 過度夾緊可能損害材料，不能以「越緊越安全」取代設計。
steps.failureEn: Excessive clamping can damage materials; tighter is safer cannot replace design.
steps.check: 每條受力路徑有明確支撐介面，未知強度列為待驗證。
steps.checkEn: Give each load path a defined support interface and mark unknown strength as unverified.

knowledge.title: 機電耦合
knowledge.text: 電流相關作用力與機械支撐共同影響繞組完整性。
knowledge.textEn: Current-related forces and mechanical support jointly affect winding integrity.

knowledge.title: 形變證據
knowledge.text: 內部幾何變化可能需要專門試驗與前後基線比較才能判斷。
knowledge.textEn: Internal geometric change may need dedicated testing and before/after baselines.

quiz.question: 看到油箱外觀完整，能否證明繞組支撐全部正常？
quiz.questionEn: Does an intact tank exterior prove every winding support is sound?
options: 能，外殼會顯示所有內部位移。
能，絕緣材料不可能受到機械影響。
不能，內部狀態仍需相應證據。
optionsEn: Yes; the enclosure reveals every internal displacement.
Yes; insulation cannot be mechanically affected.
No; internal condition still needs appropriate evidence.
quiz.explanation: 不能，內部狀態仍需相應證據。 電流相關作用力與機械支撐共同影響繞組完整性。
quiz.explanationEn: No; internal condition still needs appropriate evidence. Current-related forces and mechanical support jointly affect winding integrity.

steps.title: 規劃乾燥與防再吸濕的交接
steps.titleEn: Plan drying and protection against rewetting
steps.objective: 把乾燥結果與後續暴露控制連接。
steps.objectiveEn: Connect drying results with subsequent exposure control.
steps.instruction: 畫出主動部件組裝、專業乾燥、封閉轉移及入箱的流程。以兩個假設時程比較乾燥後立即受控交接與長時間不受控暴露，列出需要保留的含水和環境紀錄。
steps.instructionEn: Map active-part assembly, professional drying, protected transfer and tanking. Compare controlled handoff with prolonged uncontrolled exposure and list moisture and environmental records to retain.
steps.observation: 乾燥完成時合格，不代表之後仍維持相同含水狀態。
steps.observationEn: Passing at the end of drying does not guarantee unchanged moisture afterward.
steps.failure: 只記乾燥時間而缺少結果與暴露紀錄，不能證明交付狀態。
steps.failureEn: Drying time without outcome and exposure records does not establish the delivered condition.
steps.check: 交接表同時包含乾燥證據、時間線與再吸濕防護。
steps.checkEn: Include drying evidence, timeline and rewetting protection in the handoff record.

knowledge.title: 含水影響
knowledge.text: 水分會影響絕緣性能與老化，因此需要受控處理。
knowledge.textEn: Moisture affects insulation performance and aging and therefore needs controlled handling.

knowledge.title: 狀態保持
knowledge.text: 完成一個製程後，仍需維持其成果直到下一站。
knowledge.textEn: A completed process result must be preserved until the next operation.

quiz.question: 乾燥後長時間暴露且沒有紀錄，能否沿用原先合格結論？
quiz.questionEn: After long unrecorded exposure, can the original drying pass simply be reused?
options: 不能，需要重新確認目前狀態。
能，只要原乾燥設備的設定未改變。
能，乾燥時間已記錄就能代表之後的含水狀態。
optionsEn: No; the present condition needs confirmation.
Yes, if the original dryer settings remain unchanged.
Yes; recorded drying time represents all later moisture conditions.
quiz.explanation: 不能，需要重新確認目前狀態。 水分會影響絕緣性能與老化，因此需要受控處理。
quiz.explanationEn: No; the present condition needs confirmation. Moisture affects insulation performance and aging and therefore needs controlled handling.

steps.title: 整合油箱、密封與冷卻路徑
steps.titleEn: Integrate tank, seals and cooling paths
steps.objective: 辨認絕緣液保存與熱移除的不同功能。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish insulating-liquid preservation from heat removal.
steps.instruction: 在油箱剖面標出熱源、液體流路、散熱器及對外密封界面。比較通道順暢與局部阻擋的模型，另列出密封證據，避免以「沒有漏油」代替冷卻驗證。
steps.instructionEn: Mark heat sources, liquid paths, radiators and external seals in a tank section. Compare clear and obstructed flow models and list sealing evidence separately from cooling verification.
steps.observation: 密封良好與散熱足夠是不同指標，兩者都不能由外觀單獨證明。
steps.observationEn: Adequate sealing and adequate cooling are different criteria, neither proven by appearance alone.
steps.failure: 把冷卻通道當作可任意填滿的空隙，可能造成熱點。
steps.failureEn: Treating cooling passages as expendable empty space can create hotspots.
steps.check: 熱路徑與密封界面各有獨立檢核，並保留適用的冷卻條件。
steps.checkEn: Give heat paths and seals separate checks and retain applicable cooling conditions.

knowledge.title: 熱路徑
knowledge.text: 繞組損失必須經材料與冷卻系統傳到環境。
knowledge.textEn: Winding heat must pass through materials and cooling systems to the environment.

knowledge.title: 液體保存
knowledge.text: 絕緣液的污染和水分狀態也取決於保存及密封設計。
knowledge.textEn: Contamination and moisture in insulating liquid also depend on preservation and sealing design.

quiz.question: 油箱不漏油，是否足以證明冷卻設計合格？
quiz.questionEn: Does a leak-free tank prove adequate cooling design?
options: 足夠，油量正確便能保證所有局部流路暢通。
不足，熱移除能力還需獨立驗證。
足夠，密封試驗已涵蓋額定熱負載下的表現。
optionsEn: Yes; correct oil quantity guarantees every local flow path is clear.
No; heat-removal capability needs separate verification.
Yes; a seal test covers performance under rated thermal load.
quiz.explanation: 不足，熱移除能力還需獨立驗證。 繞組損失必須經材料與冷卻系統傳到環境。
quiz.explanationEn: No; heat-removal capability needs separate verification. Winding heat must pass through materials and cooling systems to the environment.

stages.title: 附件、試驗與交付
stages.description: 理解不同試驗的證據範圍，保留運輸前後的比較基線。
stages.descriptionEn: Understand the limits of each test and retain pre/post-transport baselines.

steps.title: 核對套管、分接與監測介面
steps.titleEn: Check bushings, taps and monitoring interfaces
steps.objective: 將附件的電氣、機械與監測責任明確分開。
steps.objectiveEn: Separate electrical, mechanical and monitoring roles of accessories.
steps.instruction: 用系統圖連接套管、繞組分接位置、溫度與油位監測。為每個介面寫出輸入、輸出及應核對文件；區分分接裝置類型，不示範現場切換或帶電操作。
steps.instructionEn: Connect bushings, winding tap positions, temperature and oil-level monitoring in a system diagram. Record inputs, outputs and documents to check, distinguishing tap-device types without demonstrating field switching or live operation.
steps.observation: 附件型號相近也可能有不同電氣等級、安裝界面或操作限制。
steps.observationEn: Similar accessory models can differ in electrical rating, mounting interface or operating limits.
steps.failure: 把所有分接裝置都假定可帶載切換，會造成錯誤操作理解。
steps.failureEn: Assuming every tap device can switch under load creates a dangerous misunderstanding.
steps.check: 介面表包含相容性與操作類型，未知項目不以推測補足。
steps.checkEn: Include compatibility and operating type, leaving unknown items unverified rather than guessed.

knowledge.title: 介面相容性
knowledge.text: 附件需符合主體設計，機械可裝上並不代表電氣相容。
knowledge.textEn: Accessories must match the main design; mechanical fit does not prove electrical compatibility.

knowledge.title: 監測限制
knowledge.text: 監測器提供特定狀態資訊，不能取代所有工廠試驗。
knowledge.textEn: Sensors report particular conditions and do not replace all factory tests.

quiz.question: 兩種分接裝置外觀相似，可否假定操作方式相同？
quiz.questionEn: Two tap devices look similar. Can their operating method be assumed identical?
options: 可以，只要名義變比相同便代表切換條件相同。
可以，機械接口吻合就不需查閱電氣操作類型。
不可，應核對裝置類型與正式規範。
optionsEn: Yes; equal nominal ratio implies equal switching conditions.
Yes; mechanical fit removes the need to check the electrical operating type.
No; verify device type and formal requirements.
quiz.explanation: 不可，應核對裝置類型與正式規範。 附件需符合主體設計，機械可裝上並不代表電氣相容。
quiz.explanationEn: No; verify device type and formal requirements. Accessories must match the main design; mechanical fit does not prove electrical compatibility.

steps.title: 閱讀工廠試驗的不同證據
steps.objective: 把變比、損失、阻抗與絕緣試驗對應到不同問題。
steps.objectiveEn: Map ratio, loss, impedance and insulation tests to different questions.
steps.instruction: 使用自製空白試驗報告模板，分別列出變比、繞組電阻、損失、阻抗及絕緣相關試驗的目的。加入一項假設超限結果，選擇應回查的設計或製造紀錄；不搭建高壓試驗回路。
steps.instructionEn: Use an original blank report template to list purposes of ratio, winding resistance, loss, impedance and insulation-related tests. Add a hypothetical out-of-limit result and select records to review without building a high-voltage test circuit.
steps.observation: 通過變比檢查不能替代絕緣或熱性能證據。
steps.observationEn: Passing a ratio check does not replace insulation or thermal evidence.
steps.failure: 跨不同試驗條件比較數字可能產生假異常；先核對條件和單位。
steps.failureEn: Comparing values from different test conditions can create false anomalies; check conditions and units first.
steps.check: 每項試驗都有目的、條件、判據來源及不涵蓋的範圍。
steps.checkEn: Give each test a purpose, conditions, criteria source and excluded scope.

knowledge.title: 試驗分工
knowledge.text: 多種試驗共同驗證不同性能，沒有一個結果代表全部合格。
knowledge.textEn: Different tests verify different properties; no single result proves complete compliance.

knowledge.title: 條件正規化
knowledge.text: 報告需保留溫度、接法與參考條件等解讀必要資訊。
knowledge.textEn: Reports need interpretive context such as temperature, connection and reference conditions.

quiz.question: 變比正確但絕緣證據尚未取得，應如何判定？
quiz.questionEn: Ratio is correct but insulation evidence is missing. What follows?
options: 只能確認已測的變比，整體驗收仍未完成。
變比正確可取代所有介電和熱性能證據。
只要試驗報告有簽名，缺少的項目可視為已完成。
optionsEn: Only the measured ratio is confirmed; overall acceptance is incomplete.
Correct ratio replaces all dielectric and thermal evidence.
A signed report lets missing tests be treated as completed.
quiz.explanation: 只能確認已測的變比，整體驗收仍未完成。 多種試驗共同驗證不同性能，沒有一個結果代表全部合格。
quiz.explanationEn: Only the measured ratio is confirmed; overall acceptance is incomplete. Different tests verify different properties; no single result proves complete compliance.

steps.title: 建立油與絕緣的診斷基線
steps.titleEn: Establish oil and insulation diagnostic baselines
steps.objective: 以趨勢與多項證據判讀，而非單一數字猜測故障。
steps.objectiveEn: Interpret trends and combined evidence rather than diagnose from one number.
steps.instruction: 在紙上報告分開列出水分、介電性質、溶解氣體及相關材料狀態。用兩組假設時間序列比較穩定與變化情境，說明需要哪些運行背景；不實作現場取樣。
steps.instructionEn: Separate moisture, dielectric properties, dissolved gases and material condition in a paper report. Compare two hypothetical time series, stable and changing, and list operating context needed without field sampling.
steps.observation: 相同最終數值可能來自不同歷程，不能忽略趨勢與取樣條件。
steps.observationEn: Identical final values can arise from different histories; trends and sampling conditions matter.
steps.failure: 單一氣體或單次數值不宜被簡化成唯一故障原因。
steps.failureEn: One gas or one reading should not be reduced to a unique fault diagnosis.
steps.check: 判讀說明基線、趨勢、可能原因與追加證據需求。
steps.checkEn: State baseline, trend, possible causes and further evidence needed.

knowledge.title: 條件診斷
knowledge.text: 油與氣體分析可提供內部狀態線索，仍需結合設計與運行資訊。
knowledge.textEn: Oil and gas analysis provide internal-condition clues that still need design and operating context.

knowledge.title: 基線價值
knowledge.text: 初始紀錄讓之後的變化具有比較依據。
knowledge.textEn: Initial records make later changes interpretable.

quiz.question: 兩台設備最終數值相同但變化速度不同，應如何處理？
quiz.questionEn: Two units have the same final reading but different rates of change. What should be done?
options: 直接認定兩台狀態完全相同。
結合各自基線、趨勢與運行背景判讀。
只保留最後一筆並刪除時間。
optionsEn: Declare their conditions identical.
Interpret each using its baseline, trend and operating context.
Keep only the last value and delete timestamps.
quiz.explanation: 結合各自基線、趨勢與運行背景判讀。 油與氣體分析可提供內部狀態線索，仍需結合設計與運行資訊。
quiz.explanationEn: Interpret each using its baseline, trend and operating context. Oil and gas analysis provide internal-condition clues that still need design and operating context.

steps.title: 規劃運輸前後的驗證交接
steps.objective: 保存拆卸、運輸及到貨後可比較的證據。
steps.objectiveEn: Preserve comparable evidence across disassembly, transport and arrival.
steps.instruction: 畫出工廠驗收、運輸準備、物流交接、到貨檢查與專業再組裝五個狀態。列出每次交接的零件身分、保存條件及基線報告，加入一個運輸異常以決定應暫停哪項後續工作。
steps.instructionEn: Map factory acceptance, transport preparation, logistics handoff, arrival inspection and professional reassembly. Record component identity, preservation and baseline reports, then add a transport anomaly to decide which later work must pause.
steps.observation: 出廠合格不能排除運輸過程中發生的變化。
steps.observationEn: Factory acceptance does not rule out changes during transport.
steps.failure: 忽略異常後直接推進投運，會失去確認狀態的機會；此課程不提供投運操作。
steps.failureEn: Proceeding after an unresolved anomaly loses the chance to verify condition; this course provides no energization procedure.
steps.check: 交接清單可追蹤每項異常、負責人與所需專業複查，保留未放行狀態。
steps.checkEn: Trace anomalies, responsibility and required professional review while retaining an unreleased status where appropriate.

knowledge.title: 狀態保持與重驗
knowledge.text: 大型設備的運輸與再組裝是品質鏈的一部分。
knowledge.textEn: Transportation and reassembly are part of the quality chain for large equipment.

knowledge.title: 證據可比性
knowledge.text: 前後量測需有一致的基準和條件，才能判讀是否改變。
knowledge.textEn: Before-and-after measurements need consistent references and conditions to reveal change.

quiz.question: 運輸紀錄有異常但外觀正常，最佳下一步為何？
quiz.questionEn: Transport records show an anomaly but the exterior looks normal. What is the best next step?
options: 出廠試驗已合格，所以可忽略運輸後的新證據。
只重複外觀檢查，就可排除所有內部變化。
保留異常並依專業程序追加檢查後再決定放行。
optionsEn: Factory acceptance allows new post-transport evidence to be ignored.
Repeating a visual inspection rules out every internal change.
Retain the anomaly and obtain appropriate professional checks before release.
quiz.explanation: 保留異常並依專業程序追加檢查後再決定放行。 大型設備的運輸與再組裝是品質鏈的一部分。
quiz.explanationEn: Retain the anomaly and obtain appropriate professional checks before release. Transportation and reassembly are part of the quality chain for large equipment.

stages.title: 電磁模型延伸
stages.description: 以三個技術單元完成「電磁模型延伸」的模型及判讀，共六項獨立保存的作業。
stages.descriptionEn: Three technical units develop extended magnetic model through six separately saved modeling and interpretation tasks.

steps.title: 標么基準：模型與設計
steps.objective: 針對「標么基準」建立可重算、可檢查的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a reproducible, reviewable engineering record for per-unit bases.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，標出「標么基準」的輸入、輸出及量測基準，再在學徒工作台排列對應元件或資料流。阻抗百分比需使用一致容量及電壓基準。 在離線草圖或試算表建立基準與擾動兩種情境，寫出因果預測；用「以實際歐姆值交叉換算。」規劃如何反駁模型。把未知參數、單位與邊界記錄在學習筆記。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor diagram, identify inputs, outputs and references for per-unit bases, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Impedance percentages require consistent power and voltage bases. Build baseline and perturbed cases offline and predict causality. Plan a falsification using: Cross-check by converting through ohms. Record unknown parameters, units and boundaries in your learning notes.
steps.observation: 以實際歐姆值交叉換算。
steps.observationEn: Cross-check by converting through ohms.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「標么基準」的驗證。 應先核對量測基準、模型邊界及競爭失效原因。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Equal nominal ratings justify skipping per-unit bases verification. Check references, model boundaries and competing failure causes first.
steps.check: 提交「標么基準」的兩情境模型、單位表及可反駁預測；說明「以實際歐姆值交叉換算。」如何區分情境。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case model, units and a falsifiable prediction for per-unit bases; explain how the proposed check distinguishes cases.

knowledge.title: 本單元機制
knowledge.text: 阻抗百分比需使用一致容量及電壓基準。
knowledge.textEn: Impedance percentages require consistent power and voltage bases.

knowledge.title: 可區分原因的證據
knowledge.text: 以實際歐姆值交叉換算。 必須保留基準、單位及不確定度，未有實測資料時只做假想案例判讀。
knowledge.textEn: Cross-check by converting through ohms. Retain references, units and uncertainty; without measured data, interpret hypothetical cases only.

knowledge.title: 本課量化連結
knowledge.text: 假設 100 MVA、線電壓 230 kV，額定線電流 I=S/(√3V)=251.0 A；若等效阻抗 0.10 pu 且忽略上游阻抗，三相短路電流約 10 pu。僅為模型，不是保護整定。
knowledge.textEn: Assume 100 MVA at line voltage 230 kV: rated line current I=S/(√3V)=251.0 A. An equivalent 0.10 pu impedance gives about 10 pu three-phase fault current when upstream impedance is omitted; this is not a protection setting.

quiz.question: 審查「標么基準」時，哪個判斷或驗證方法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or check is justified for per-unit bases?
options: 阻抗百分比需使用一致容量及電壓基準。
只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「標么基準」的驗證。
只調整「標么基準」的顯示結果吻合，便可當作獨立量測證據。
optionsEn: Impedance percentages require consistent power and voltage bases.
Equal nominal ratings justify skipping per-unit bases verification.
Tuning the displayed per-unit bases result to match counts as independent measurement evidence.
quiz.explanation: 阻抗百分比需使用一致容量及電壓基準。 以實際歐姆值交叉換算。
quiz.explanationEn: Impedance percentages require consistent power and voltage bases. Cross-check by converting through ohms.

steps.title: 標么基準：量測與判讀
steps.objective: 針對「標么基準」建立可重算、可檢查的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a reproducible, reviewable engineering record for per-unit bases.
steps.instruction: 先重播本單元模型，讀取兩種假想情境而不接觸真實帶電設備。以實際歐姆值交叉換算。 比較差異是否符合「阻抗百分比需使用一致容量及電壓基準。」；列出至少兩個競爭原因，指定能區分原因的新增量測。先依專案規格訂接受條件，再納入量測不確定度，將未驗證項保持為未決。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit model and inspect two hypothetical cases without accessing energized equipment. Cross-check by converting through ohms. Compare the result against: Impedance percentages require consistent power and voltage bases. List at least two competing causes and select an additional discriminating measurement. Define acceptance from project requirements before observing results, include uncertainty and retain unverified items as unresolved.
steps.observation: 以實際歐姆值交叉換算。
steps.observationEn: Cross-check by converting through ohms.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「標么基準」的驗證。 應先核對量測基準、模型邊界及競爭失效原因。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Equal nominal ratings justify skipping per-unit bases verification. Check references, model boundaries and competing failure causes first.
steps.check: 提交「標么基準」的量測比較、誤差來源及放行／保留理由；不能用單一平均值掩蓋最差條件。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement comparison, error sources and accept/hold rationale for per-unit bases; do not hide limiting conditions behind one average.

knowledge.title: 本單元機制
knowledge.text: 阻抗百分比需使用一致容量及電壓基準。
knowledge.textEn: Impedance percentages require consistent power and voltage bases.

knowledge.title: 可區分原因的證據
knowledge.text: 以實際歐姆值交叉換算。 必須保留基準、單位及不確定度，未有實測資料時只做假想案例判讀。
knowledge.textEn: Cross-check by converting through ohms. Retain references, units and uncertainty; without measured data, interpret hypothetical cases only.

knowledge.title: 本課量化連結
knowledge.text: 假設 100 MVA、線電壓 230 kV，額定線電流 I=S/(√3V)=251.0 A；若等效阻抗 0.10 pu 且忽略上游阻抗，三相短路電流約 10 pu。僅為模型，不是保護整定。
knowledge.textEn: Assume 100 MVA at line voltage 230 kV: rated line current I=S/(√3V)=251.0 A. An equivalent 0.10 pu impedance gives about 10 pu three-phase fault current when upstream impedance is omitted; this is not a protection setting.

quiz.question: 審查「標么基準」時，哪個判斷或驗證方法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or check is justified for per-unit bases?
options: 只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「標么基準」的驗證。
以實際歐姆值交叉換算。
只調整「標么基準」的顯示結果吻合，便可當作獨立量測證據。
optionsEn: Equal nominal ratings justify skipping per-unit bases verification.
Cross-check by converting through ohms.
Tuning the displayed per-unit bases result to match counts as independent measurement evidence.
quiz.explanation: 阻抗百分比需使用一致容量及電壓基準。 以實際歐姆值交叉換算。
quiz.explanationEn: Impedance percentages require consistent power and voltage bases. Cross-check by converting through ohms.

steps.title: 磁通積分：模型與設計
steps.objective: 針對「磁通積分」建立可重算、可檢查的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a reproducible, reviewable engineering record for flux integration.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，標出「磁通積分」的輸入、輸出及量測基準，再在學徒工作台排列對應元件或資料流。磁通由電壓時間積分決定而非瞬時電壓。 在離線草圖或試算表建立基準與擾動兩種情境，寫出因果預測；用「比較同峰值不同波形的積分。」規劃如何反駁模型。把未知參數、單位與邊界記錄在學習筆記。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor diagram, identify inputs, outputs and references for flux integration, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Flux follows voltage-time integral, not instantaneous voltage. Build baseline and perturbed cases offline and predict causality. Plan a falsification using: Compare integrals of equal-peak waveforms. Record unknown parameters, units and boundaries in your learning notes.
steps.observation: 比較同峰值不同波形的積分。
steps.observationEn: Compare integrals of equal-peak waveforms.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「磁通積分」的驗證。 應先核對量測基準、模型邊界及競爭失效原因。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Equal nominal ratings justify skipping flux integration verification. Check references, model boundaries and competing failure causes first.
steps.check: 提交「磁通積分」的兩情境模型、單位表及可反駁預測；說明「比較同峰值不同波形的積分。」如何區分情境。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case model, units and a falsifiable prediction for flux integration; explain how the proposed check distinguishes cases.

Compare the result against: Flux follows voltage-time integral, not instantaneous voltage. List at least two competing causes and select an additional discriminating measurement. steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，標出「交叉診斷」的輸入、輸出及量測基準，再在學徒工作台排列對應元件或資料流。單項異常不足以唯一確定失效機制。 在離線草圖或試算表建立基準與擾動兩種情境，寫出因果預測；用「用熱、電、機械證據建立假說表。」規劃如何反駁模型。把未知參數、單位與邊界記錄在學習筆記。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor diagram, identify inputs, outputs and references for cross-diagnosis, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. One abnormal metric cannot uniquely identify a failure. Build baseline and perturbed cases offline and predict causality. Plan a falsification using: Build hypotheses from thermal, electrical and mechanical evidence. Record unknown parameters, units and boundaries in your learning notes.
steps.observation: 用熱、電、機械證據建立假說表。
steps.observationEn: Build hypotheses from thermal, electrical and mechanical evidence.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「交叉診斷」的驗證。 應先核對量測基準、模型邊界及競爭失效原因。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Equal nominal ratings justify skipping cross-diagnosis verification. Check references, model boundaries and competing failure causes first.
steps.check: 提交「交叉診斷」的兩情境模型、單位表及可反駁預測；說明「用熱、電、機械證據建立假說表。」如何區分情境。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case model, units and a falsifiable prediction for cross-diagnosis; explain how the proposed check distinguishes cases.

knowledge.title: 本單元機制
knowledge.text: 單項異常不足以唯一確定失效機制。
knowledge.textEn: One abnormal metric cannot uniquely identify a failure.

knowledge.title: 可區分原因的證據
knowledge.text: 用熱、電、機械證據建立假說表。 必須保留基準、單位及不確定度，未有實測資料時只做假想案例判讀。
knowledge.textEn: Build hypotheses from thermal, electrical and mechanical evidence. Retain references, units and uncertainty; without measured data, interpret hypothetical cases only.

knowledge.title: 本課量化連結
knowledge.text: 假設 100 MVA、線電壓 230 kV，額定線電流 I=S/(√3V)=251.0 A；若等效阻抗 0.10 pu 且忽略上游阻抗，三相短路電流約 10 pu。僅為模型，不是保護整定。
knowledge.textEn: Assume 100 MVA at line voltage 230 kV: rated line current I=S/(√3V)=251.0 A. An equivalent 0.10 pu impedance gives about 10 pu three-phase fault current when upstream impedance is omitted; this is not a protection setting.

quiz.question: 審查「交叉診斷」時，哪個判斷或驗證方法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or check is justified for cross-diagnosis?
options: 只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「交叉診斷」的驗證。
單項異常不足以唯一確定失效機制。
只調整「交叉診斷」的顯示結果吻合，便可當作獨立量測證據。
optionsEn: Equal nominal ratings justify skipping cross-diagnosis verification.
One abnormal metric cannot uniquely identify a failure.
Tuning the displayed cross-diagnosis result to match counts as independent measurement evidence.
quiz.explanation: 單項異常不足以唯一確定失效機制。 用熱、電、機械證據建立假說表。
quiz.explanationEn: One abnormal metric cannot uniquely identify a failure. Build hypotheses from thermal, electrical and mechanical evidence.

steps.title: 交叉診斷：量測與判讀
steps.objective: 針對「交叉診斷」建立可重算、可檢查的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a reproducible, reviewable engineering record for cross-diagnosis.
steps.instruction: 先重播本單元模型，讀取兩種假想情境而不接觸真實帶電設備。用熱、電、機械證據建立假說表。 比較差異是否符合「單項異常不足以唯一確定失效機制。」；列出至少兩個競爭原因，指定能區分原因的新增量測。先依專案規格訂接受條件，再納入量測不確定度，將未驗證項保持為未決。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit model and inspect two hypothetical cases without accessing energized equipment. Build hypotheses from thermal, electrical and mechanical evidence. Compare the result against: One abnormal metric cannot uniquely identify a failure. List at least two competing causes and select an additional discriminating measurement. Define acceptance from project requirements before observing results, include uncertainty and retain unverified items as unresolved.
steps.observation: 用熱、電、機械證據建立假說表。
steps.observationEn: Build hypotheses from thermal, electrical and mechanical evidence.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「交叉診斷」的驗證。 應先核對量測基準、模型邊界及競爭失效原因。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Equal nominal ratings justify skipping cross-diagnosis verification. Check references, model boundaries and competing failure causes first.
steps.check: 提交「交叉診斷」的量測比較、誤差來源及放行／保留理由；不能用單一平均值掩蓋最差條件。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement comparison, error sources and accept/hold rationale for cross-diagnosis; do not hide limiting conditions behind one average.

scope: 公開原理的離線工程教育與報告判讀。數值為自行設定的教學假設，非產品保證、現場整定、製造配方或帶電操作程序；高壓、旋轉與大型設備實務由合格團隊依正式規格驗證。完成課程不是專業執照。
scopeEn: Offline engineering education and report interpretation from public principles. Inputs are independently chosen teaching assumptions, not product guarantees, field settings, recipes or live-work procedures. Qualified teams validate high-voltage, rotating and large equipment under formal requirements. Course completion is not professional licensure.

workedExample.title: 含假設的可重算例
workedExample.text: 假設 100 MVA、線電壓 230 kV，額定線電流 I=S/(√3V)=251.0 A；若等效阻抗 0.10 pu 且忽略上游阻抗，三相短路電流約 10 pu。僅為模型，不是保護整定。
workedExample.textEn: Assume 100 MVA at line voltage 230 kV: rated line current I=S/(√3V)=251.0 A. An equivalent 0.10 pu impedance gives about 10 pu three-phase fault current when upstream impedance is omitted; this is not a protection setting.
workedExample.assumptions: 算例內列出的參數及理想化條件；更改波形、材料、溫度、拓撲或模型邊界後須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Use the stated parameters and idealizations; recalculate after changing waveforms, materials, temperature, topology or boundaries.
workedExample.sourceScope: 作者原創的假想數值題；官方資料支援領域脈絡，並非這組數字的實測來源。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original hypothetical numerical exercise; official sources support context, not measurements of these inputs.

steps.title: 磁路截面：模型與設計

steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor diagram, identify inputs, outputs and references for core section, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Lower frequency at fixed voltage increases peak flux. Build baseline and perturbed cases offline and predict causality. Plan a falsification using: Compare equal and unequal V/f cases. Record unknown parameters, units and boundaries in your learning notes.

knowledge.title: 本課量化連結
knowledge.text: 假設損失 2 kW、等效熱阻 0.025 K/W，穩態平均溫升 50 K。熱阻增加 20% 時為 60 K；集中參數模型不預測樹脂內局部熱點。

summary: 以樹脂絕緣、通風與非線性負載降額串連 12 個技術單元；新增 24 步，包含原理、假想算例、量測設計、失效辨識與驗收證據。
summaryEn: Twelve technical units connect resin insulation, ventilation and nonlinear-load derating through 24 new tasks with principles, hypothetical calculations, measurement design, failure discrimination and acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開原理的離線工程教育與報告判讀。數值為自行設定的教學假設，非產品保證、現場整定、製造配方或帶電操作程序；高壓、旋轉與大型設備實務由合格團隊依正式規格驗證。完成課程不是專業執照。
scopeEn: Offline engineering education and report interpretation from public principles. Inputs are independently chosen teaching assumptions, not product guarantees, field settings, recipes or live-work procedures. Qualified teams validate high-voltage, rotating and large equipment under formal requirements. Course completion is not professional licensure.

workedExample.title: 含假設的可重算例
workedExample.text: 假設損失 2 kW、等效熱阻 0.025 K/W，穩態平均溫升 50 K。熱阻增加 20% 時為 60 K；集中參數模型不預測樹脂內局部熱點。
workedExample.textEn: Assume loss 2 kW and equivalent thermal resistance 0.025 K/W: steady mean rise is 50 K. A 20% resistance increase gives 60 K; this lumped model does not predict local resin hot spots.
workedExample.assumptions: 算例內列出的參數及理想化條件；更改波形、材料、溫度、拓撲或模型邊界後須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Use the stated parameters and idealizations; recalculate after changing waveforms, materials, temperature, topology or boundaries.
workedExample.sourceScope: 作者原創的假想數值題；官方資料支援領域脈絡，並非這組數字的實測來源。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original hypothetical numerical exercise; official sources support context, not measurements of these inputs.

steps.title: 同軸電場：模型與設計
steps.objective: 針對「同軸電場」建立可重算、可檢查的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a reproducible, reviewable engineering record for coaxial field.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，標出「同軸電場」的輸入、輸出及量測基準，再在學徒工作台排列對應元件或資料流。場強在內導體表面最大而非均勻。 在離線草圖或試算表建立基準與擾動兩種情境，寫出因果預測；用「比較解析徑向曲線與網格結果。」規劃如何反駁模型。把未知參數、單位與邊界記錄在學習筆記。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor diagram, identify inputs, outputs and references for coaxial field, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Field peaks at the inner conductor, not uniformly. Build baseline and perturbed cases offline and predict causality. Plan a falsification using: Compare analytic radial fields with mesh results. Record unknown parameters, units and boundaries in your learning notes.
steps.observation: 比較解析徑向曲線與網格結果。
steps.observationEn: Compare analytic radial fields with mesh results.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「同軸電場」的驗證。 應先核對量測基準、模型邊界及競爭失效原因。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Equal nominal ratings justify skipping coaxial field verification. Check references, model boundaries and competing failure causes first.
steps.check: 提交「同軸電場」的兩情境模型、單位表及可反駁預測；說明「比較解析徑向曲線與網格結果。」如何區分情境。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case model, units and a falsifiable prediction for coaxial field; explain how the proposed check distinguishes cases.

knowledge.title: 本單元機制
knowledge.text: 場強在內導體表面最大而非均勻。
knowledge.textEn: Field peaks at the inner conductor, not uniformly.

knowledge.title: 可區分原因的證據
knowledge.text: 比較解析徑向曲線與網格結果。 必須保留基準、單位及不確定度，未有實測資料時只做假想案例判讀。
knowledge.textEn: Compare analytic radial fields with mesh results. Retain references, units and uncertainty; without measured data, interpret hypothetical cases only.

knowledge.title: 本課量化連結
knowledge.text: 理想同軸導體半徑 a=20 mm、外殼內半徑 b=80 mm，瞬時電壓 V=100 kV，導體表面 E=V/[a ln(b/a)]≈3.61 MV/m；忽略端部與顆粒，不是絕緣耐壓。
knowledge.textEn: For ideal coaxial radii a=20 mm and b=80 mm at instantaneous V=100 kV, conductor-surface E=V/[a ln(b/a)]≈3.61 MV/m. End effects and particles are omitted; this is not a withstand rating.

quiz.question: 審查「同軸電場」時，哪個判斷或驗證方法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or check is justified for coaxial field?
options: 場強在內導體表面最大而非均勻。
只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「同軸電場」的驗證。
只調整「同軸電場」的顯示結果吻合，便可當作獨立量測證據。
optionsEn: Field peaks at the inner conductor, not uniformly.
Equal nominal ratings justify skipping coaxial field verification.
Tuning the displayed coaxial field result to match counts as independent measurement evidence.
quiz.explanation: 場強在內導體表面最大而非均勻。 比較解析徑向曲線與網格結果。
quiz.explanationEn: Field peaks at the inner conductor, not uniformly. Compare analytic radial fields with mesh results.

steps.title: 同軸電場：量測與判讀
steps.objective: 針對「同軸電場」建立可重算、可檢查的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a reproducible, reviewable engineering record for coaxial field.
steps.instruction: 先重播本單元模型，讀取兩種假想情境而不接觸真實帶電設備。比較解析徑向曲線與網格結果。 比較差異是否符合「場強在內導體表面最大而非均勻。」；列出至少兩個競爭原因，指定能區分原因的新增量測。先依專案規格訂接受條件，再納入量測不確定度，將未驗證項保持為未決。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit model and inspect two hypothetical cases without accessing energized equipment. Compare analytic radial fields with mesh results. Compare the result against: Field peaks at the inner conductor, not uniformly. List at least two competing causes and select an additional discriminating measurement. Define acceptance from project requirements before observing results, include uncertainty and retain unverified items as unresolved.
steps.observation: 比較解析徑向曲線與網格結果。
steps.observationEn: Compare analytic radial fields with mesh results.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「同軸電場」的驗證。 應先核對量測基準、模型邊界及競爭失效原因。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Equal nominal ratings justify skipping coaxial field verification. Check references, model boundaries and competing failure causes first.
steps.check: 提交「同軸電場」的量測比較、誤差來源及放行／保留理由；不能用單一平均值掩蓋最差條件。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement comparison, error sources and accept/hold rationale for coaxial field; do not hide limiting conditions behind one average.

steps.title: 氣體密度：模型與設計
steps.objective: 針對「氣體密度」建立可重算、可檢查的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a reproducible, reviewable engineering record for gas density.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，標出「氣體密度」的輸入、輸出及量測基準，再在學徒工作台排列對應元件或資料流。壓力讀值需溫度補償才可比較密度。 在離線草圖或試算表建立基準與擾動兩種情境，寫出因果預測；用「固定氣體組成與理想氣體近似下，用絕對壓力 p 及 Kelvin 溫度 T 比較 p/T；不可用表壓或攝氏溫度。」規劃如何反駁模型。把未知參數、單位與邊界記錄在學習筆記。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor diagram, identify inputs, outputs and references for gas density, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Pressure needs temperature compensation to compare density. Build baseline and perturbed cases offline and predict causality. Plan a falsification using: At fixed composition under the ideal-gas approximation, compare p/T using absolute pressure and kelvin, never gauge pressure or Celsius. Record unknown parameters, units and boundaries in your learning notes.
steps.observation: 固定氣體組成與理想氣體近似下，用絕對壓力 p 及 Kelvin 溫度 T 比較 p/T；不可用表壓或攝氏溫度。
steps.observationEn: At fixed composition under the ideal-gas approximation, compare p/T using absolute pressure and kelvin, never gauge pressure or Celsius.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「氣體密度」的驗證。 應先核對量測基準、模型邊界及競爭失效原因。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Equal nominal ratings justify skipping gas density verification. Check references, model boundaries and competing failure causes first.
steps.check: 提交「氣體密度」的兩情境模型、單位表及可反駁預測；說明「固定氣體組成與理想氣體近似下，用絕對壓力 p 及 Kelvin 溫度 T 比較 p/T；不可用表壓或攝氏溫度。」如何區分情境。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case model, units and a falsifiable prediction for gas density; explain how the proposed check distinguishes cases.

knowledge.title: 本單元機制
knowledge.text: 壓力讀值需溫度補償才可比較密度。
knowledge.textEn: Pressure needs temperature compensation to compare density.

knowledge.title: 可區分原因的證據
knowledge.text: 固定氣體組成與理想氣體近似下，用絕對壓力 p 及 Kelvin 溫度 T 比較 p/T；不可用表壓或攝氏溫度。 必須保留基準、單位及不確定度，未有實測資料時只做假想案例判讀。
knowledge.textEn: At fixed composition under the ideal-gas approximation, compare p/T using absolute pressure and kelvin, never gauge pressure or Celsius. Retain references, units and uncertainty; without measured data, interpret hypothetical cases only.

quiz.question: 審查「氣體密度」時，哪個判斷或驗證方法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or check is justified for gas density?
options: 壓力讀值需溫度補償才可比較密度。
只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「氣體密度」的驗證。
只調整「氣體密度」的顯示結果吻合，便可當作獨立量測證據。
optionsEn: Pressure needs temperature compensation to compare density.
Equal nominal ratings justify skipping gas density verification.
Tuning the displayed gas density result to match counts as independent measurement evidence.
quiz.explanation: 壓力讀值需溫度補償才可比較密度。 固定氣體組成與理想氣體近似下，用絕對壓力 p 及 Kelvin 溫度 T 比較 p/T；不可用表壓或攝氏溫度。
quiz.explanationEn: Pressure needs temperature compensation to compare density. At fixed composition under the ideal-gas approximation, compare p/T using absolute pressure and kelvin, never gauge pressure or Celsius.

steps.title: 氣體密度：量測與判讀
steps.objective: 針對「氣體密度」建立可重算、可檢查的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a reproducible, reviewable engineering record for gas density.
steps.instruction: 先重播本單元模型，讀取兩種假想情境而不接觸真實帶電設備。固定氣體組成與理想氣體近似下，用絕對壓力 p 及 Kelvin 溫度 T 比較 p/T；不可用表壓或攝氏溫度。 比較差異是否符合「壓力讀值需溫度補償才可比較密度。」；列出至少兩個競爭原因，指定能區分原因的新增量測。先依專案規格訂接受條件，再納入量測不確定度，將未驗證項保持為未決。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit model and inspect two hypothetical cases without accessing energized equipment. At fixed composition under the ideal-gas approximation, compare p/T using absolute pressure and kelvin, never gauge pressure or Celsius. Compare the result against: Pressure needs temperature compensation to compare density. List at least two competing causes and select an additional discriminating measurement. Define acceptance from project requirements before observing results, include uncertainty and retain unverified items as unresolved.
steps.observation: 固定氣體組成與理想氣體近似下，用絕對壓力 p 及 Kelvin 溫度 T 比較 p/T；不可用表壓或攝氏溫度。
steps.observationEn: At fixed composition under the ideal-gas approximation, compare p/T using absolute pressure and kelvin, never gauge pressure or Celsius.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「氣體密度」的驗證。 應先核對量測基準、模型邊界及競爭失效原因。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Equal nominal ratings justify skipping gas density verification. Check references, model boundaries and competing failure causes first.
steps.check: 提交「氣體密度」的量測比較、誤差來源及放行／保留理由；不能用單一平均值掩蓋最差條件。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement comparison, error sources and accept/hold rationale for gas density; do not hide limiting conditions behind one average.

steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor diagram, identify inputs, outputs and references for material compatibility, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Plan a falsification using: List material, gas and temperature combinations. Record unknown parameters, units and boundaries in your learning notes.

summary: 以同軸電場、隔室密封與開關暫態串連 12 個技術單元；新增 24 步，包含原理、假想算例、量測設計、失效辨識與驗收證據。
summaryEn: Twelve technical units connect coaxial fields, compartment sealing and switching transients through 24 new tasks with principles, hypothetical calculations, measurement design, failure discrimination and acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開原理的離線工程教育與報告判讀。數值為自行設定的教學假設，非產品保證、現場整定、製造配方或帶電操作程序；高壓、旋轉與大型設備實務由合格團隊依正式規格驗證。完成課程不是專業執照。
scopeEn: Offline engineering education and report interpretation from public principles. Inputs are independently chosen teaching assumptions, not product guarantees, field settings, recipes or live-work procedures. Qualified teams validate high-voltage, rotating and large equipment under formal requirements. Course completion is not professional licensure.

workedExample.assumptions: 算例內列出的參數及理想化條件；更改波形、材料、溫度、拓撲或模型邊界後須重算。

knowledge.title: 本課量化連結

options: 只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「半導電屏蔽」的驗證。
平滑屏蔽界面減少幾何場集中。
只調整「半導電屏蔽」的顯示結果吻合，便可當作獨立量測證據。
optionsEn: Equal nominal ratings justify skipping semiconductive screens verification.
Smooth screen interfaces reduce geometric field concentration.
Tuning the displayed semiconductive screens result to match counts as independent measurement evidence.
quiz.explanation: 平滑屏蔽界面減少幾何場集中。 比較粗糙度與局部場模型。
quiz.explanationEn: Smooth screen interfaces reduce geometric field concentration. Compare roughness and local-field models.

steps.title: 半導電屏蔽：量測與判讀
steps.objective: 針對「半導電屏蔽」建立可重算、可檢查的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a reproducible, reviewable engineering record for semiconductive screens.
steps.instruction: 先重播本單元模型，讀取兩種假想情境而不接觸真實帶電設備。比較粗糙度與局部場模型。 比較差異是否符合「平滑屏蔽界面減少幾何場集中。」；列出至少兩個競爭原因，指定能區分原因的新增量測。先依專案規格訂接受條件，再納入量測不確定度，將未驗證項保持為未決。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit model and inspect two hypothetical cases without accessing energized equipment. Compare roughness and local-field models. Compare the result against: Smooth screen interfaces reduce geometric field concentration. List at least two competing causes and select an additional discriminating measurement. Define acceptance from project requirements before observing results, include uncertainty and retain unverified items as unresolved.
steps.observation: 比較粗糙度與局部場模型。
steps.observationEn: Compare roughness and local-field models.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「半導電屏蔽」的驗證。 應先核對量測基準、模型邊界及競爭失效原因。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Equal nominal ratings justify skipping semiconductive screens verification. Check references, model boundaries and competing failure causes first.
steps.check: 提交「半導電屏蔽」的量測比較、誤差來源及放行／保留理由；不能用單一平均值掩蓋最差條件。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement comparison, error sources and accept/hold rationale for semiconductive screens; do not hide limiting conditions behind one average.

steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor diagram, identify inputs, outputs and references for screen cutback, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Screen termination requires axial field redistribution. Build baseline and perturbed cases offline and predict causality. Plan a falsification using: Compare equipotentials with and without stress control. Record unknown parameters, units and boundaries in your learning notes.

steps.check: 提交「屏蔽截斷」的兩情境模型、單位表及可反駁預測；說明「對照應力控制前後等位線。」如何區分情境。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case model, units and a falsifiable prediction for screen cutback; explain how the proposed check distinguishes cases.

summary: 以徑向電場、熱阻與接頭界面控制串連 12 個技術單元；新增 24 步，包含原理、假想算例、量測設計、失效辨識與驗收證據。
summaryEn: Twelve technical units connect radial fields, thermal resistance and joint interfaces through 24 new tasks with principles, hypothetical calculations, measurement design, failure discrimination and acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開原理的離線工程教育與報告判讀。數值為自行設定的教學假設，非產品保證、現場整定、製造配方或帶電操作程序；高壓、旋轉與大型設備實務由合格團隊依正式規格驗證。完成課程不是專業執照。
scopeEn: Offline engineering education and report interpretation from public principles. Inputs are independently chosen teaching assumptions, not product guarantees, field settings, recipes or live-work procedures. Qualified teams validate high-voltage, rotating and large equipment under formal requirements. Course completion is not professional licensure.

steps.objectiveEn: Produce a reproducible, reviewable engineering record for minimum curvature.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，標出「最小彎曲」的輸入、輸出及量測基準，再在學徒工作台排列對應元件或資料流。張力與彎曲共同作用於多層結構。 在離線草圖或試算表建立基準與擾動兩種情境，寫出因果預測；用「列組合載荷而非只看彎曲半徑。」規劃如何反駁模型。把未知參數、單位與邊界記錄在學習筆記。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor diagram, identify inputs, outputs and references for minimum curvature, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Tension and bending jointly load multilayer structures. Build baseline and perturbed cases offline and predict causality. Plan a falsification using: List combined loads, not bend radius alone. Record unknown parameters, units and boundaries in your learning notes.
steps.observation: 列組合載荷而非只看彎曲半徑。
steps.observationEn: List combined loads, not bend radius alone.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「最小彎曲」的驗證。 應先核對量測基準、模型邊界及競爭失效原因。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Equal nominal ratings justify skipping minimum curvature verification. Check references, model boundaries and competing failure causes first.
steps.check: 提交「最小彎曲」的兩情境模型、單位表及可反駁預測；說明「列組合載荷而非只看彎曲半徑。」如何區分情境。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case model, units and a falsifiable prediction for minimum curvature; explain how the proposed check distinguishes cases.

knowledge.text: 張力與彎曲共同作用於多層結構。
knowledge.textEn: Tension and bending jointly load multilayer structures.

knowledge.textEn: List combined loads, not bend radius alone. Retain references, units and uncertainty; without measured data, interpret hypothetical cases only.

Tuning the displayed minimum curvature result to match counts as independent measurement evidence.
Tension and bending jointly load multilayer structures.

steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit model and inspect two hypothetical cases without accessing energized equipment. List combined loads, not bend radius alone. Compare the result against: Tension and bending jointly load multilayer structures. List at least two competing causes and select an additional discriminating measurement. steps.observation: 列組合載荷而非只看彎曲半徑。

steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Equal nominal ratings justify skipping minimum curvature verification. Check references, model boundaries and competing failure causes first.
steps.check: 提交「最小彎曲」的量測比較、誤差來源及放行／保留理由；不能用單一平均值掩蓋最差條件。

steps.instruction: 先重播本單元模型，讀取兩種假想情境而不接觸真實帶電設備。計算位置對時間及速度的敏感度。 比較差異是否符合「傳播速度不確定度會放大距離誤差。」；列出至少兩個競爭原因，指定能區分原因的新增量測。先依專案規格訂接受條件，再納入量測不確定度，將未驗證項保持為未決。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit model and inspect two hypothetical cases without accessing energized equipment. Calculate position sensitivity to time and speed. Compare the result against: Propagation-speed uncertainty amplifies distance error. List at least two competing causes and select an additional discriminating measurement. Define acceptance from project requirements before observing results, include uncertainty and retain unverified items as unresolved.
steps.observation: 計算位置對時間及速度的敏感度。
steps.observationEn: Calculate position sensitivity to time and speed.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「故障定位」的驗證。 應先核對量測基準、模型邊界及競爭失效原因。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Equal nominal ratings justify skipping fault location verification. Check references, model boundaries and competing failure causes first.
steps.check: 提交「故障定位」的量測比較、誤差來源及放行／保留理由；不能用單一平均值掩蓋最差條件。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement comparison, error sources and accept/hold rationale for fault location; do not hide limiting conditions behind one average.

knowledge.title: 本單元機制
knowledge.text: 傳播速度不確定度會放大距離誤差。

knowledge.title: 可區分原因的證據
knowledge.text: 計算位置對時間及速度的敏感度。 必須保留基準、單位及不確定度，未有實測資料時只做假想案例判讀。
knowledge.textEn: Calculate position sensitivity to time and speed. Retain references, units and uncertainty; without measured data, interpret hypothetical cases only.

steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor diagram, identify inputs, outputs and references for repair availability, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. summary: 以海床路由、機械張力與海纜熱可靠度串連 12 個技術單元；新增 24 步，包含原理、假想算例、量測設計、失效辨識與驗收證據。
summaryEn: Twelve technical units connect seabed routing, mechanical tension and cable thermal reliability through 24 new tasks with principles, hypothetical calculations, measurement design, failure discrimination and acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開原理的離線工程教育與報告判讀。數值為自行設定的教學假設，非產品保證、現場整定、製造配方或帶電操作程序；高壓、旋轉與大型設備實務由合格團隊依正式規格驗證。完成課程不是專業執照。
scopeEn: Offline engineering education and report interpretation from public principles. Inputs are independently chosen teaching assumptions, not product guarantees, field settings, recipes or live-work procedures. Qualified teams validate high-voltage, rotating and large equipment under formal requirements. Course completion is not professional licensure.

workedExample.title: 含假設的可重算例
workedExample.text: 假設導體回路總電阻 4 Ω，直流 1000 A 時損失 I²R=4 MW。若傳送 500 MW，線路電阻損失為 0.8%；未含換流、護套或介電損失。
workedExample.textEn: For an assumed total DC conductor-loop resistance 4 Ω at 1000 A, I²R=4 MW, or 0.8% of 500 MW transmitted. Conversion, sheath and dielectric losses are excluded.
workedExample.assumptions: 算例內列出的參數及理想化條件；更改波形、材料、溫度、拓撲或模型邊界後須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Use the stated parameters and idealizations; recalculate after changing waveforms, materials, temperature, topology or boundaries.
workedExample.sourceScope: 作者原創的假想數值題；官方資料支援領域脈絡，並非這組數字的實測來源。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original hypothetical numerical exercise; official sources support context, not measurements of these inputs.

steps.title: 導線複合：模型與設計
steps.objective: 針對「導線複合」建立可重算、可檢查的工程紀錄。

steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，標出「導線複合」的輸入、輸出及量測基準，再在學徒工作台排列對應元件或資料流。鋼芯與導體層共同承擔拉力和熱伸長。 在離線草圖或試算表建立基準與擾動兩種情境，寫出因果預測；用「比較各材料面積與應變相容。」規劃如何反駁模型。把未知參數、單位與邊界記錄在學習筆記。

Core and conductor layers share tension and thermal expansion. Build baseline and perturbed cases offline and predict causality. Plan a falsification using: Compare areas and strain compatibility. Record unknown parameters, units and boundaries in your learning notes.

knowledge.text: 小弧垂拋物線假設：均布重量 w=15 N/m、跨距 L=300 m、水平張力 H=30 kN，弧垂 f=wL²/(8H)=5.625 m。風、覆冰及高差未納入，不能用於現場淨空放行。
knowledge.textEn: Under a small-sag parabolic model with w=15 N/m, L=300 m and horizontal tension H=30 kN, f=wL²/(8H)=5.625 m. Wind, ice and elevation difference are omitted; this cannot authorize clearance.
