steps.objectiveEn: Produce a reproducible, reviewable engineering record for performance and limits.
steps.instruction: 先重播本單元模型，讀取兩種假想情境而不接觸真實帶電設備。以戶分鐘及失敗案例共同報告。 比較差異是否符合「復電比例需同時報時間及未復電客群。」；列出至少兩個競爭原因，指定能區分原因的新增量測。先依專案規格訂接受條件，再納入量測不確定度，將未驗證項保持為未決。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit model and inspect two hypothetical cases without accessing energized equipment. Report customer-minutes and failed cases together. Compare the result against: Restoration fraction needs time and remaining-customer context. List at least two competing causes and select an additional discriminating measurement. Define acceptance from project requirements before observing results, include uncertainty and retain unverified items as unresolved.
steps.observation: 以戶分鐘及失敗案例共同報告。
steps.observationEn: Report customer-minutes and failed cases together.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「績效與限制」的驗證。 應先核對量測基準、模型邊界及競爭失效原因。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Equal nominal ratings justify skipping performance and limits verification. Check references, model boundaries and competing failure causes first.
steps.check: 提交「績效與限制」的量測比較、誤差來源及放行／保留理由；不能用單一平均值掩蓋最差條件。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement comparison, error sources and accept/hold rationale for performance and limits; do not hide limiting conditions behind one average.

knowledge.title: 本單元機制
knowledge.text: 復電比例需同時報時間及未復電客群。
knowledge.textEn: Restoration fraction needs time and remaining-customer context.

knowledge.title: 可區分原因的證據
knowledge.text: 以戶分鐘及失敗案例共同報告。 必須保留基準、單位及不確定度，未有實測資料時只做假想案例判讀。
knowledge.textEn: Report customer-minutes and failed cases together. Retain references, units and uncertainty; without measured data, interpret hypothetical cases only.

knowledge.title: 本課量化連結
knowledge.text: 假想故障使 1000 戶停電 60 min，客戶停電時間為 60000 戶·min；若 700 戶在 5 min 復電，其餘 300 戶仍 60 min，合計 21500 戶·min，降低約 64.17%。不是任何真實配電網績效。
knowledge.textEn: A hypothetical outage of 1000 customers for 60 min gives 60000 customer-minutes. Restoring 700 at 5 min while 300 remain out for 60 min gives 21500 customer-minutes, a 64.17% reduction; no real feeder performance is claimed.

quiz.question: 審查「績效與限制」時，哪個判斷或驗證方法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or check is justified for performance and limits?
options: 只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「績效與限制」的驗證。
只調整「績效與限制」的顯示結果吻合，便可當作獨立量測證據。
以戶分鐘及失敗案例共同報告。
optionsEn: Equal nominal ratings justify skipping performance and limits verification.
Tuning the displayed performance and limits result to match counts as independent measurement evidence.
Report customer-minutes and failed cases together.
quiz.explanation: 復電比例需同時報時間及未復電客群。 以戶分鐘及失敗案例共同報告。
quiz.explanationEn: Restoration fraction needs time and remaining-customer context. Report customer-minutes and failed cases together.

summary: 以故障區段辨識、拓撲推理與復電容量串連 12 個技術單元；新增 24 步，包含原理、假想算例、量測設計、失效辨識與驗收證據。
summaryEn: Twelve technical units connect fault-section identification, topology reasoning and restoration capacity through 24 new tasks with principles, hypothetical calculations, measurement design, failure discrimination and acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開原理的離線工程教育與報告判讀。數值為自行設定的教學假設，非產品保證、現場整定、製造配方或帶電操作程序；高壓、旋轉與大型設備實務由合格團隊依正式規格驗證。完成課程不是專業執照。
scopeEn: Offline engineering education and report interpretation from public principles. Inputs are independently chosen teaching assumptions, not product guarantees, field settings, recipes or live-work procedures. Qualified teams validate high-voltage, rotating and large equipment under formal requirements. Course completion is not professional licensure.

workedExample.title: 含假設的可重算例
workedExample.text: 假想故障使 1000 戶停電 60 min，客戶停電時間為 60000 戶·min；若 700 戶在 5 min 復電，其餘 300 戶仍 60 min，合計 21500 戶·min，降低約 64.17%。不是任何真實配電網績效。
workedExample.textEn: A hypothetical outage of 1000 customers for 60 min gives 60000 customer-minutes. Restoring 700 at 5 min while 300 remain out for 60 min gives 21500 customer-minutes, a 64.17% reduction; no real feeder performance is claimed.
workedExample.assumptions: 算例內列出的參數及理想化條件；更改波形、材料、溫度、拓撲或模型邊界後須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Use the stated parameters and idealizations; recalculate after changing waveforms, materials, temperature, topology or boundaries.
workedExample.sourceScope: 作者原創的假想數值題；官方資料支援領域脈絡，並非這組數字的實測來源。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original hypothetical numerical exercise; official sources support context, not measurements of these inputs.

title: 微電網孤島與併網控制

stages.title: 資源與邊界
stages.description: 以三個技術單元完成「資源與邊界」的模型及判讀，共六項獨立保存的作業。
stages.descriptionEn: Three technical units develop resources and boundaries through six separately saved modeling and interpretation tasks.

steps.title: 邊界定義：模型與設計
steps.objective: 針對「邊界定義」建立可重算、可檢查的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a reproducible, reviewable engineering record for boundary definition.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，標出「邊界定義」的輸入、輸出及量測基準，再在學徒工作台排列對應元件或資料流。公共連接點決定孤島的功率邊界。 在離線草圖或試算表建立基準與擾動兩種情境，寫出因果預測；用「畫輸入、負載及不可中斷支路。」規劃如何反駁模型。把未知參數、單位與邊界記錄在學習筆記。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor diagram, identify inputs, outputs and references for boundary definition, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. The common coupling point defines island power boundaries. Build baseline and perturbed cases offline and predict causality. Plan a falsification using: Map inputs, loads and critical branches. Record unknown parameters, units and boundaries in your learning notes.
steps.observation: 畫輸入、負載及不可中斷支路。
steps.observationEn: Map inputs, loads and critical branches.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「邊界定義」的驗證。 應先核對量測基準、模型邊界及競爭失效原因。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Equal nominal ratings justify skipping boundary definition verification. Check references, model boundaries and competing failure causes first.
steps.check: 提交「邊界定義」的兩情境模型、單位表及可反駁預測；說明「畫輸入、負載及不可中斷支路。」如何區分情境。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case model, units and a falsifiable prediction for boundary definition; explain how the proposed check distinguishes cases.

knowledge.title: 本課量化連結
knowledge.text: 假設孤島負載 500 kW，持續發電 300 kW，電池需補 200 kW；支撐 30 min 的交流能量為 100 kWh。若放電效率 0.90，需可用直流能量 111.11 kWh，未計備援 SOC 或老化。
knowledge.textEn: For island load 500 kW and generation 300 kW, a battery supplies 200 kW. Thirty minutes requires 100 kWh AC, or 111.11 kWh available DC at 0.90 discharge efficiency, before SOC reserve and aging.

steps.title: 電壓匹配：模型與設計
steps.objective: 針對「電壓匹配」建立可重算、可檢查的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a reproducible, reviewable engineering record for voltage matching.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，標出「電壓匹配」的輸入、輸出及量測基準，再在學徒工作台排列對應元件或資料流。再併網需同時核對幅值、頻率與相位。 在離線草圖或試算表建立基準與擾動兩種情境，寫出因果預測；用「建立三條獨立容差曲線。」規劃如何反駁模型。把未知參數、單位與邊界記錄在學習筆記。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor diagram, identify inputs, outputs and references for voltage matching, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Reconnection needs magnitude, frequency and phase agreement. Build baseline and perturbed cases offline and predict causality. Plan a falsification using: Create three independent tolerance traces. Record unknown parameters, units and boundaries in your learning notes.
steps.observation: 建立三條獨立容差曲線。
steps.observationEn: Create three independent tolerance traces.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「電壓匹配」的驗證。 應先核對量測基準、模型邊界及競爭失效原因。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Equal nominal ratings justify skipping voltage matching verification. Check references, model boundaries and competing failure causes first.
steps.check: 提交「電壓匹配」的兩情境模型、單位表及可反駁預測；說明「建立三條獨立容差曲線。」如何區分情境。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case model, units and a falsifiable prediction for voltage matching; explain how the proposed check distinguishes cases.

knowledge.title: 本單元機制
knowledge.text: 再併網需同時核對幅值、頻率與相位。
knowledge.textEn: Reconnection needs magnitude, frequency and phase agreement.

knowledge.title: 可區分原因的證據
knowledge.text: 建立三條獨立容差曲線。 必須保留基準、單位及不確定度，未有實測資料時只做假想案例判讀。
knowledge.textEn: Create three independent tolerance traces. Retain references, units and uncertainty; without measured data, interpret hypothetical cases only.

quiz.question: 審查「電壓匹配」時，哪個判斷或驗證方法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or check is justified for voltage matching?
options: 再併網需同時核對幅值、頻率與相位。
只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「電壓匹配」的驗證。
只調整「電壓匹配」的顯示結果吻合，便可當作獨立量測證據。
optionsEn: Reconnection needs magnitude, frequency and phase agreement.
Equal nominal ratings justify skipping voltage matching verification.
Tuning the displayed voltage matching result to match counts as independent measurement evidence.
quiz.explanation: 再併網需同時核對幅值、頻率與相位。 建立三條獨立容差曲線。
quiz.explanationEn: Reconnection needs magnitude, frequency and phase agreement. Create three independent tolerance traces.

steps.title: 電壓匹配：量測與判讀
steps.objective: 針對「電壓匹配」建立可重算、可檢查的工程紀錄。

steps.instruction: 先重播本單元模型，讀取兩種假想情境而不接觸真實帶電設備。建立三條獨立容差曲線。 比較差異是否符合「再併網需同時核對幅值、頻率與相位。」；列出至少兩個競爭原因，指定能區分原因的新增量測。先依專案規格訂接受條件，再納入量測不確定度，將未驗證項保持為未決。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit model and inspect two hypothetical cases without accessing energized equipment. Create three independent tolerance traces. Compare the result against: Reconnection needs magnitude, frequency and phase agreement. List at least two competing causes and select an additional discriminating measurement. Define acceptance from project requirements before observing results, include uncertainty and retain unverified items as unresolved.

steps.observationEn: Create three independent tolerance traces.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「電壓匹配」的驗證。 應先核對量測基準、模型邊界及競爭失效原因。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Equal nominal ratings justify skipping voltage matching verification. Check references, model boundaries and competing failure causes first.
steps.check: 提交「電壓匹配」的量測比較、誤差來源及放行／保留理由；不能用單一平均值掩蓋最差條件。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement comparison, error sources and accept/hold rationale for voltage matching; do not hide limiting conditions behind one average.

summary: 以孤島功率平衡、同步條件與轉換動態串連 12 個技術單元；新增 24 步，包含原理、假想算例、量測設計、失效辨識與驗收證據。
summaryEn: Twelve technical units connect island power balance, synchronization and transition dynamics through 24 new tasks with principles, hypothetical calculations, measurement design, failure discrimination and acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開原理的離線工程教育與報告判讀。數值為自行設定的教學假設，非產品保證、現場整定、製造配方或帶電操作程序；高壓、旋轉與大型設備實務由合格團隊依正式規格驗證。完成課程不是專業執照。
scopeEn: Offline engineering education and report interpretation from public principles. Inputs are independently chosen teaching assumptions, not product guarantees, field settings, recipes or live-work procedures. Qualified teams validate high-voltage, rotating and large equipment under formal requirements. Course completion is not professional licensure.

summary: 以電壓成形、下垂與限流穩定性串連 12 個技術單元；新增 24 步，包含原理、假想算例、量測設計、失效辨識與驗收證據。
summaryEn: Twelve technical units connect voltage formation, droop and current-limit stability through 24 new tasks with principles, hypothetical calculations, measurement design, failure discrimination and acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開原理的離線工程教育與報告判讀。數值為自行設定的教學假設，非產品保證、現場整定、製造配方或帶電操作程序；高壓、旋轉與大型設備實務由合格團隊依正式規格驗證。完成課程不是專業執照。
scopeEn: Offline engineering education and report interpretation from public principles. Inputs are independently chosen teaching assumptions, not product guarantees, field settings, recipes or live-work procedures. Qualified teams validate high-voltage, rotating and large equipment under formal requirements. Course completion is not professional licensure.

steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit model and inspect two hypothetical cases without accessing energized equipment. Sweep window length and decision delay. Compare the result against: Filter delay affects undervoltage and frequency decisions. List at least two competing causes and select an additional discriminating measurement. Define acceptance from project requirements before observing results, include uncertainty and retain unverified items as unresolved.
steps.observation: 掃描視窗長度與事件延遲。

steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement comparison, error sources and accept/hold rationale for measurement transients; do not hide limiting conditions behind one average.

knowledge.textEn: Sweep window length and decision delay. Retain references, units and uncertainty; without measured data, interpret hypothetical cases only.

knowledge.title: 本課量化連結
knowledge.text: 假設 1 MVA 逆變器、線電壓 400 V，額定 I=S/(√3V)=1443.4 A。若短時限流為假設的 1.2 pu，短時 RMS 電流上限 1732.1 A；這不是實際產品或標準限值。
knowledge.textEn: For an assumed 1 MVA inverter at line voltage 400 V, rated I=S/(√3V)=1443.4 A. An illustrative 1.2 pu short-term RMS limit is 1732.1 A, not a product or standards limit.

summary: 以併網邊界、故障穿越與孤島辨識串連 12 個技術單元；新增 24 步，包含原理、假想算例、量測設計、失效辨識與驗收證據。
summaryEn: Twelve technical units connect interconnection boundaries, ride-through and island detection through 24 new tasks with principles, hypothetical calculations, measurement design, failure discrimination and acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開原理的離線工程教育與報告判讀。數值為自行設定的教學假設，非產品保證、現場整定、製造配方或帶電操作程序；高壓、旋轉與大型設備實務由合格團隊依正式規格驗證。完成課程不是專業執照。
scopeEn: Offline engineering education and report interpretation from public principles. Inputs are independently chosen teaching assumptions, not product guarantees, field settings, recipes or live-work procedures. Qualified teams validate high-voltage, rotating and large equipment under formal requirements. Course completion is not professional licensure.

workedExample.text: 假設 1 MVA 逆變器、線電壓 400 V，額定 I=S/(√3V)=1443.4 A。若短時限流為假設的 1.2 pu，短時 RMS 電流上限 1732.1 A；這不是實際產品或標準限值。
workedExample.textEn: For an assumed 1 MVA inverter at line voltage 400 V, rated I=S/(√3V)=1443.4 A. An illustrative 1.2 pu short-term RMS limit is 1732.1 A, not a product or standards limit.
workedExample.assumptions: 算例內列出的參數及理想化條件；更改波形、材料、溫度、拓撲或模型邊界後須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Use the stated parameters and idealizations; recalculate after changing waveforms, materials, temperature, topology or boundaries.
workedExample.sourceScope: 作者原創的假想數值題；官方資料支援領域脈絡，並非這組數字的實測來源。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original hypothetical numerical exercise; official sources support context, not measurements of these inputs.

knowledge.title: 本單元機制

knowledge.title: 可區分原因的證據
knowledge.text: 列不能依賴的外部輔助系統。 必須保留基準、單位及不確定度，未有實測資料時只做假想案例判讀。
knowledge.textEn: List unavailable external auxiliaries. Retain references, units and uncertainty; without measured data, interpret hypothetical cases only.

knowledge.title: 本課量化連結
knowledge.text: 假設站用負載 100 kW 持續 2 h，加一次馬達起動交流能量 10 kWh，總交流需求 210 kWh；效率 0.9 需 233.33 kWh 可用直流能量。能量足夠仍不能證明瞬時起動電流能力。
knowledge.textEn: Assume auxiliaries draw 100 kW for 2 h plus one motor start requiring 10 kWh AC: total is 210 kWh AC, or 233.33 kWh available DC at 0.9 efficiency. Energy sufficiency does not prove starting-current capability.

quiz.question: 審查「黑啟動定義」時，哪個判斷或驗證方法成立？

只調整「黑啟動定義」的顯示結果吻合，便可當作獨立量測證據。
optionsEn: A black-start resource establishes supply without external AC.
Equal nominal ratings justify skipping black-start definition verification.
Tuning the displayed black-start definition result to match counts as independent measurement evidence.

summary: 以啟動能源、復電路徑與動態負載串連 12 個技術單元；新增 24 步，包含原理、假想算例、量測設計、失效辨識與驗收證據。
summaryEn: Twelve technical units connect starting energy, restoration paths and dynamic loads through 24 new tasks with principles, hypothetical calculations, measurement design, failure discrimination and acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開原理的離線工程教育與報告判讀。數值為自行設定的教學假設，非產品保證、現場整定、製造配方或帶電操作程序；高壓、旋轉與大型設備實務由合格團隊依正式規格驗證。完成課程不是專業執照。
scopeEn: Offline engineering education and report interpretation from public principles. Inputs are independently chosen teaching assumptions, not product guarantees, field settings, recipes or live-work procedures. Qualified teams validate high-voltage, rotating and large equipment under formal requirements. Course completion is not professional licensure.

summary: 以模態、暫態功角與頻率動態串連 12 個技術單元；新增 24 步，包含原理、假想算例、量測設計、失效辨識與驗收證據。
summaryEn: Twelve technical units connect modes, transient rotor angle and frequency dynamics through 24 new tasks with principles, hypothetical calculations, measurement design, failure discrimination and acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開原理的離線工程教育與報告判讀。數值為自行設定的教學假設，非產品保證、現場整定、製造配方或帶電操作程序；高壓、旋轉與大型設備實務由合格團隊依正式規格驗證。完成課程不是專業執照。
scopeEn: Offline engineering education and report interpretation from public principles. Inputs are independently chosen teaching assumptions, not product guarantees, field settings, recipes or live-work procedures. stages.title: 資源與基線
stages.description: 以三個技術單元完成「資源與基線」的模型及判讀，共六項獨立保存的作業。
stages.descriptionEn: Three technical units develop resources and baseline through six separately saved modeling and interpretation tasks.

steps.title: 資源分類：模型與設計
steps.objective: 針對「資源分類」建立可重算、可檢查的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a reproducible, reviewable engineering record for resource classes.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，標出「資源分類」的輸入、輸出及量測基準，再在學徒工作台排列對應元件或資料流。可移時負載與可永久削減負載不同。 在離線草圖或試算表建立基準與擾動兩種情境，寫出因果預測；用「以能量守恆分類負載行為。」規劃如何反駁模型。把未知參數、單位與邊界記錄在學習筆記。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor diagram, identify inputs, outputs and references for resource classes, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Shiftable and permanently reducible loads differ. Build baseline and perturbed cases offline and predict causality. Plan a falsification using: Classify behavior using energy balance. Record unknown parameters, units and boundaries in your learning notes.
steps.observation: 以能量守恆分類負載行為。
steps.observationEn: Classify behavior using energy balance.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「資源分類」的驗證。 應先核對量測基準、模型邊界及競爭失效原因。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Equal nominal ratings justify skipping resource classes verification. Check references, model boundaries and competing failure causes first.
steps.check: 提交「資源分類」的兩情境模型、單位表及可反駁預測；說明「以能量守恆分類負載行為。」如何區分情境。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case model, units and a falsifiable prediction for resource classes; explain how the proposed check distinguishes cases.

knowledge.title: 本單元機制
knowledge.text: 可移時負載與可永久削減負載不同。
knowledge.textEn: Shiftable and permanently reducible loads differ.

knowledge.title: 可區分原因的證據
knowledge.text: 以能量守恆分類負載行為。 必須保留基準、單位及不確定度，未有實測資料時只做假想案例判讀。
knowledge.textEn: Classify behavior using energy balance. Retain references, units and uncertainty; without measured data, interpret hypothetical cases only.

knowledge.title: 本課量化連結
knowledge.text: 假設反事實基線 100 kW，事件平均實測 70 kW、持續 2 h，估计降低能量 60 kWh。若基線可能偏差 ±10 kW，僅此項造成 ±20 kWh 範圍；不等於直接量得節能量。
knowledge.textEn: Assume a counterfactual baseline 100 kW and measured event mean 70 kW for 2 h: estimated reduction is 60 kWh. Baseline error ±10 kW alone gives ±20 kWh; savings are not directly measured.

quiz.question: 審查「資源分類」時，哪個判斷或驗證方法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or check is justified for resource classes?
options: 可移時負載與可永久削減負載不同。
只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「資源分類」的驗證。
只調整「資源分類」的顯示結果吻合，便可當作獨立量測證據。
optionsEn: Shiftable and permanently reducible loads differ.
Equal nominal ratings justify skipping resource classes verification.
Tuning the displayed resource classes result to match counts as independent measurement evidence.
quiz.explanation: 可移時負載與可永久削減負載不同。 以能量守恆分類負載行為。
quiz.explanationEn: Shiftable and permanently reducible loads differ. Classify behavior using energy balance.

steps.title: 資源分類：量測與判讀
steps.objective: 針對「資源分類」建立可重算、可檢查的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a reproducible, reviewable engineering record for resource classes.
steps.instruction: 先重播本單元模型，讀取兩種假想情境而不接觸真實帶電設備。以能量守恆分類負載行為。 比較差異是否符合「可移時負載與可永久削減負載不同。」；列出至少兩個競爭原因，指定能區分原因的新增量測。先依專案規格訂接受條件，再納入量測不確定度，將未驗證項保持為未決。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit model and inspect two hypothetical cases without accessing energized equipment. Classify behavior using energy balance. Compare the result against: Shiftable and permanently reducible loads differ. List at least two competing causes and select an additional discriminating measurement. Define acceptance from project requirements before observing results, include uncertainty and retain unverified items as unresolved.
steps.observation: 以能量守恆分類負載行為。
steps.observationEn: Classify behavior using energy balance.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「資源分類」的驗證。 應先核對量測基準、模型邊界及競爭失效原因。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Equal nominal ratings justify skipping resource classes verification. Check references, model boundaries and competing failure causes first.
steps.check: 提交「資源分類」的量測比較、誤差來源及放行／保留理由；不能用單一平均值掩蓋最差條件。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement comparison, error sources and accept/hold rationale for resource classes; do not hide limiting conditions behind one average.

quiz.question: 審查「績效歸因」時，哪個判斷或驗證方法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or check is justified for performance attribution?
options: 只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「績效歸因」的驗證。
只調整「績效歸因」的顯示結果吻合，便可當作獨立量測證據。
天氣及自然停機不應全歸因於控制。
optionsEn: Equal nominal ratings justify skipping performance attribution verification.
Tuning the displayed performance attribution result to match counts as independent measurement evidence.
Weather and natural outages are not all control effects.
quiz.explanation: 天氣及自然停機不應全歸因於控制。 用對照組及不確定度解釋結果。

steps.title: 績效歸因：量測與判讀
steps.objective: 針對「績效歸因」建立可重算、可檢查的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a reproducible, reviewable engineering record for performance attribution.
steps.instruction: 先重播本單元模型，讀取兩種假想情境而不接觸真實帶電設備。用對照組及不確定度解釋結果。 比較差異是否符合「天氣及自然停機不應全歸因於控制。」；列出至少兩個競爭原因，指定能區分原因的新增量測。先依專案規格訂接受條件，再納入量測不確定度，將未驗證項保持為未決。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit model and inspect two hypothetical cases without accessing energized equipment. Use controls and uncertainty to interpret results. Compare the result against: Weather and natural outages are not all control effects. List at least two competing causes and select an additional discriminating measurement. Define acceptance from project requirements before observing results, include uncertainty and retain unverified items as unresolved.
steps.observation: 用對照組及不確定度解釋結果。
steps.observationEn: Use controls and uncertainty to interpret results.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「績效歸因」的驗證。 應先核對量測基準、模型邊界及競爭失效原因。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Equal nominal ratings justify skipping performance attribution verification. Check references, model boundaries and competing failure causes first.
steps.check: 提交「績效歸因」的量測比較、誤差來源及放行／保留理由；不能用單一平均值掩蓋最差條件。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement comparison, error sources and accept/hold rationale for performance attribution; do not hide limiting conditions behind one average.

summary: 以基線、可調負載與需量反應驗證串連 12 個技術單元；新增 24 步，包含原理、假想算例、量測設計、失效辨識與驗收證據。
summaryEn: Twelve technical units connect baselines, flexible loads and demand-response verification through 24 new tasks with principles, hypothetical calculations, measurement design, failure discrimination and acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開原理的離線工程教育與報告判讀。數值為自行設定的教學假設，非產品保證、現場整定、製造配方或帶電操作程序；高壓、旋轉與大型設備實務由合格團隊依正式規格驗證。完成課程不是專業執照。
scopeEn: Offline engineering education and report interpretation from public principles. Inputs are independently chosen teaching assumptions, not product guarantees, field settings, recipes or live-work procedures. Qualified teams validate high-voltage, rotating and large equipment under formal requirements. Course completion is not professional licensure.

workedExample.title: 含假設的可重算例
workedExample.text: 假設反事實基線 100 kW，事件平均實測 70 kW、持續 2 h，估计降低能量 60 kWh。若基線可能偏差 ±10 kW，僅此項造成 ±20 kWh 範圍；不等於直接量得節能量。
workedExample.textEn: Assume a counterfactual baseline 100 kW and measured event mean 70 kW for 2 h: estimated reduction is 60 kWh. Baseline error ±10 kW alone gives ±20 kWh; savings are not directly measured.
workedExample.assumptions: 算例內列出的參數及理想化條件；更改波形、材料、溫度、拓撲或模型邊界後須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Use the stated parameters and idealizations; recalculate after changing waveforms, materials, temperature, topology or boundaries.
workedExample.sourceScope: 作者原創的假想數值題；官方資料支援領域脈絡，並非這組數字的實測來源。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original hypothetical numerical exercise; official sources support context, not measurements of these inputs.

knowledge.title: 本課量化連結
knowledge.text: 假設正弦 230 V RMS、10 A RMS、功率因數 0.8，P=VI cosφ=1840 W，2 h 電能 3.68 kWh。若電壓、電流各有獨立 0.1% 相對標準不確定度且相位準確，功率約 0.141%（未含其他項）。

steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，標出「抗混疊」的輸入、輸出及量測基準，再在學徒工作台排列對應元件或資料流。超過 Nyquist 的訊號會折疊成假頻率。 在離線草圖或試算表建立基準與擾動兩種情境，寫出因果預測；用「以已知高頻模型檢查混疊。」規劃如何反駁模型。把未知參數、單位與邊界記錄在學習筆記。

quiz.question: 審查「溫漂預算」時，哪個判斷或驗證方法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or check is justified for thermal drift budget?
options: 只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「溫漂預算」的驗證。
電阻與參考源漂移可共同改變讀值。
只調整「溫漂預算」的顯示結果吻合，便可當作獨立量測證據。
optionsEn: Equal nominal ratings justify skipping thermal drift budget verification.
Resistor and reference drift jointly alter readings.
Tuning the displayed thermal drift budget result to match counts as independent measurement evidence.

steps.title: 溫漂預算：量測與判讀

steps.objective: 針對「溫漂預算」建立可重算、可檢查的工程紀錄。

steps.instruction: 先重播本單元模型，讀取兩種假想情境而不接觸真實帶電設備。建立元件溫漂不確定度表。 比較差異是否符合「電阻與參考源漂移可共同改變讀值。」；列出至少兩個競爭原因，指定能區分原因的新增量測。先依專案規格訂接受條件，再納入量測不確定度，將未驗證項保持為未決。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit model and inspect two hypothetical cases without accessing energized equipment. Build a component drift uncertainty table. Compare the result against: Resistor and reference drift jointly alter readings. List at least two competing causes and select an additional discriminating measurement. Define acceptance from project requirements before observing results, include uncertainty and retain unverified items as unresolved.
steps.observation: 建立元件溫漂不確定度表。

steps.failure: 常見誤判：只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「溫漂預算」的驗證。 應先核對量測基準、模型邊界及競爭失效原因。

knowledge.textEn: Retain missing, estimated and measured flags. Retain references, units and uncertainty; without measured data, interpret hypothetical cases only.

knowledge.title: 本課量化連結
knowledge.text: 假設正弦 230 V RMS、10 A RMS、功率因數 0.8，P=VI cosφ=1840 W，2 h 電能 3.68 kWh。若電壓、電流各有獨立 0.1% 相對標準不確定度且相位準確，功率約 0.141%（未含其他項）。
knowledge.textEn: For sinusoidal 230 V RMS, 10 A RMS and power factor 0.8, P=1840 W and 2 h energy is 3.68 kWh. Independent 0.1% voltage/current standard uncertainties give about 0.141% power uncertainty with exact phase, excluding other terms.

quiz.question: 審查「資料完整性」時，哪個判斷或驗證方法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or check is justified for data integrity?
options: 只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「資料完整性」的驗證。
只調整「資料完整性」的顯示結果吻合，便可當作獨立量測證據。
保留缺測、估算及實測旗標。
optionsEn: Equal nominal ratings justify skipping data integrity verification.
Tuning the displayed data integrity result to match counts as independent measurement evidence.
Retain missing, estimated and measured flags.
quiz.explanation: 遺失資料不能無標記地填成零。 保留缺測、估算及實測旗標。
quiz.explanationEn: Missing data must not silently become zero. Retain missing, estimated and measured flags.

summary: 以同步取樣、功率積分與計量不確定度串連 12 個技術單元；新增 24 步，包含原理、假想算例、量測設計、失效辨識與驗收證據。
summaryEn: Twelve technical units connect synchronous sampling, power integration and metrology uncertainty through 24 new tasks with principles, hypothetical calculations, measurement design, failure discrimination and acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開原理的離線工程教育與報告判讀。數值為自行設定的教學假設，非產品保證、現場整定、製造配方或帶電操作程序；高壓、旋轉與大型設備實務由合格團隊依正式規格驗證。完成課程不是專業執照。
scopeEn: Offline engineering education and report interpretation from public principles. Inputs are independently chosen teaching assumptions, not product guarantees, field settings, recipes or live-work procedures. Qualified teams validate high-voltage, rotating and large equipment under formal requirements. Course completion is not professional licensure.

workedExample.title: 含假設的可重算例
workedExample.text: 假設正弦 230 V RMS、10 A RMS、功率因數 0.8，P=VI cosφ=1840 W，2 h 電能 3.68 kWh。若電壓、電流各有獨立 0.1% 相對標準不確定度且相位準確，功率約 0.141%（未含其他項）。
workedExample.textEn: For sinusoidal 230 V RMS, 10 A RMS and power factor 0.8, P=1840 W and 2 h energy is 3.68 kWh. Independent 0.1% voltage/current standard uncertainties give about 0.141% power uncertainty with exact phase, excluding other terms.
workedExample.assumptions: 算例內列出的參數及理想化條件；更改波形、材料、溫度、拓撲或模型邊界後須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Use the stated parameters and idealizations; recalculate after changing waveforms, materials, temperature, topology or boundaries.
workedExample.sourceScope: 作者原創的假想數值題；官方資料支援領域脈絡，並非這組數字的實測來源。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original hypothetical numerical exercise; official sources support context, not measurements of these inputs.

stages.title: 量測與指標
stages.description: 以三個技術單元完成「量測與指標」的模型及判讀，共六項獨立保存的作業。
stages.descriptionEn: Three technical units develop measurement and metrics through six separately saved modeling and interpretation tasks.

steps.title: THD 與 TDD：模型與設計
steps.titleEn: THD versus TDD: model and design
steps.objective: 針對「THD 與 TDD」建立可重算、可檢查的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a reproducible, reviewable engineering record for thd versus tdd.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，標出「THD 與 TDD」的輸入、輸出及量測基準，再在學徒工作台排列對應元件或資料流。不同分母會使失真指標意義不同。 在離線草圖或試算表建立基準與擾動兩種情境，寫出因果預測；用「在低負載與高負載重算兩指標。」規劃如何反駁模型。把未知參數、單位與邊界記錄在學習筆記。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor diagram, identify inputs, outputs and references for thd versus tdd, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Different denominators change distortion-metric meaning. Build baseline and perturbed cases offline and predict causality. Plan a falsification using: Recalculate both metrics at low/high load. Record unknown parameters, units and boundaries in your learning notes.
steps.observation: 在低負載與高負載重算兩指標。
steps.observationEn: Recalculate both metrics at low/high load.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「THD 與 TDD」的驗證。 應先核對量測基準、模型邊界及競爭失效原因。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Equal nominal ratings justify skipping thd versus tdd verification. Check references, model boundaries and competing failure causes first.
steps.check: 提交「THD 與 TDD」的兩情境模型、單位表及可反駁預測；說明「在低負載與高負載重算兩指標。」如何區分情境。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case model, units and a falsifiable prediction for thd versus tdd; explain how the proposed check distinguishes cases.

knowledge.title: 本單元機制
knowledge.text: 不同分母會使失真指標意義不同。
knowledge.textEn: Different denominators change distortion-metric meaning.

knowledge.title: 可區分原因的證據
knowledge.text: 在低負載與高負載重算兩指標。 必須保留基準、單位及不確定度，未有實測資料時只做假想案例判讀。
knowledge.textEn: Recalculate both metrics at low/high load. Retain references, units and uncertainty; without measured data, interpret hypothetical cases only.

knowledge.title: 本課量化連結
knowledge.text: 假設基頻電流 100 A RMS，5、7 次各 10 A 及 5 A，THD=√(10²+5²)/100=11.18%；總 RMS=√10125≈100.62 A。僅兩次諧波，不代表電壓 THD。
knowledge.textEn: Assume fundamental 100 A RMS with fifth/seventh harmonics 10 and 5 A. THD=√(10²+5²)/100=11.18%; total RMS=√10125≈100.62 A. Only two harmonics are included, not voltage THD.

options: 不同分母會使失真指標意義不同。
只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「THD 與 TDD」的驗證。

optionsEn: Different denominators change distortion-metric meaning.
Equal nominal ratings justify skipping thd versus tdd verification.
Tuning the displayed thd versus tdd result to match counts as independent measurement evidence.
quiz.explanation: 不同分母會使失真指標意義不同。 在低負載與高負載重算兩指標。
quiz.explanationEn: Different denominators change distortion-metric meaning. Recalculate both metrics at low/high load.

steps.title: THD 與 TDD：量測與判讀
steps.titleEn: THD versus TDD: measurement and diagnosis
steps.objective: 針對「THD 與 TDD」建立可重算、可檢查的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a reproducible, reviewable engineering record for thd versus tdd.
steps.instruction: 先重播本單元模型，讀取兩種假想情境而不接觸真實帶電設備。在低負載與高負載重算兩指標。 比較差異是否符合「不同分母會使失真指標意義不同。」；列出至少兩個競爭原因，指定能區分原因的新增量測。先依專案規格訂接受條件，再納入量測不確定度，將未驗證項保持為未決。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit model and inspect two hypothetical cases without accessing energized equipment. Recalculate both metrics at low/high load. Compare the result against: Different denominators change distortion-metric meaning. List at least two competing causes and select an additional discriminating measurement. Define acceptance from project requirements before observing results, include uncertainty and retain unverified items as unresolved.
steps.observation: 在低負載與高負載重算兩指標。
steps.observationEn: Recalculate both metrics at low/high load.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「THD 與 TDD」的驗證。 應先核對量測基準、模型邊界及競爭失效原因。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Equal nominal ratings justify skipping thd versus tdd verification. Check references, model boundaries and competing failure causes first.
steps.check: 提交「THD 與 TDD」的量測比較、誤差來源及放行／保留理由；不能用單一平均值掩蓋最差條件。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement comparison, error sources and accept/hold rationale for thd versus tdd; do not hide limiting conditions behind one average.

knowledge.textEn: Independent estimates 1.00±0.01 pu and 1.04±0.02 pu give inverse-variance mean 1.008 pu and standard uncertainty 1/√12500≈0.00894 pu. Common bias invalidates this simple uncertainty result.

quiz.question: 審查「決策邊界」時，哪個判斷或驗證方法成立？

Predictions need uncertainty and applicable operating conditions.
Tuning the displayed decision boundaries result to match counts as independent measurement evidence.

summary: 以拓撲、狀態估計與模型版本一致性串連 12 個技術單元；新增 24 步，包含原理、假想算例、量測設計、失效辨識與驗收證據。
summaryEn: Twelve technical units connect topology, state estimation and model revision consistency through 24 new tasks with principles, hypothetical calculations, measurement design, failure discrimination and acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開原理的離線工程教育與報告判讀。數值為自行設定的教學假設，非產品保證、現場整定、製造配方或帶電操作程序；高壓、旋轉與大型設備實務由合格團隊依正式規格驗證。完成課程不是專業執照。
scopeEn: Offline engineering education and report interpretation from public principles. Inputs are independently chosen teaching assumptions, not product guarantees, field settings, recipes or live-work procedures. Qualified teams validate high-voltage, rotating and large equipment under formal requirements. Course completion is not professional licensure.

steps.title: 電池架構：模型與設計
steps.objective: 針對「電池架構」建立可重算、可檢查的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a reproducible, reviewable engineering record for cell architecture.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，標出「電池架構」的輸入、輸出及量測基準，再在學徒工作台排列對應元件或資料流。接面與鈍化結構影響復合及接觸損失。 在離線草圖或試算表建立基準與擾動兩種情境，寫出因果預測；用「比較不同架構的損失項。」規劃如何反駁模型。把未知參數、單位與邊界記錄在學習筆記。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor diagram, identify inputs, outputs and references for cell architecture, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Junction and passivation structure affect recombination and contact loss. Build baseline and perturbed cases offline and predict causality. Plan a falsification using: Compare loss terms across architectures. Record unknown parameters, units and boundaries in your learning notes.
steps.observation: 比較不同架構的損失項。
steps.observationEn: Compare loss terms across architectures.

steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case model, units and a falsifiable prediction for cell architecture; explain how the proposed check distinguishes cases.

summary: 以晶矽電池互連、封裝應力及模組失效串連 12 個技術單元；新增 24 步，包含原理、假想算例、量測設計、失效辨識與驗收證據。
summaryEn: Twelve technical units connect crystalline-silicon interconnection, package stress and module failures through 24 new tasks with principles, hypothetical calculations, measurement design, failure discrimination and acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開原理的離線工程教育與報告判讀。數值為自行設定的教學假設，非產品保證、現場整定、製造配方或帶電操作程序；高壓、旋轉與大型設備實務由合格團隊依正式規格驗證。完成課程不是專業執照。
scopeEn: Offline engineering education and report interpretation from public principles. Inputs are independently chosen teaching assumptions, not product guarantees, field settings, recipes or live-work procedures. Qualified teams validate high-voltage, rotating and large equipment under formal requirements. Course completion is not professional licensure.

knowledge.title: 可區分原因的證據
knowledge.text: 列能隙、吸收與穩定差異。 必須保留基準、單位及不確定度，未有實測資料時只做假想案例判讀。

knowledge.title: 本課量化連結
knowledge.text: 假設吸收係數 α=10⁶ m⁻¹、厚度 d=2 μm，理想無反射單程吸收 1−exp(−αd)=86.47%；d=3 μm 時為 95.02%。未包含載子收集及前後電極損失，因此不是效率。
knowledge.textEn: Assume α=10⁶ m⁻¹ and d=2 μm: ideal reflection-free single-pass absorption 1−exp(−αd)=86.47%; at 3 μm it is 95.02%. Collection and electrode losses are omitted, so this is not efficiency.

steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit model and inspect two hypothetical cases without accessing energized equipment. Compare registered thickness, optical and electrical maps. steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement comparison, error sources and accept/hold rationale for uniformity maps; do not hide limiting conditions behind one average.

summary: 以薄膜吸收層、單片互連與長期穩定串連 12 個技術單元；新增 24 步，包含原理、假想算例、量測設計、失效辨識與驗收證據。
summaryEn: Twelve technical units connect thin-film absorbers, monolithic interconnects and durability through 24 new tasks with principles, hypothetical calculations, measurement design, failure discrimination and acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開原理的離線工程教育與報告判讀。數值為自行設定的教學假設，非產品保證、現場整定、製造配方或帶電操作程序；高壓、旋轉與大型設備實務由合格團隊依正式規格驗證。完成課程不是專業執照。
scopeEn: Offline engineering education and report interpretation from public principles. Inputs are independently chosen teaching assumptions, not product guarantees, field settings, recipes or live-work procedures. Qualified teams validate high-voltage, rotating and large equipment under formal requirements. Course completion is not professional licensure.

steps.title: 失配與遮蔭：量測與判讀

steps.instruction: 先重播本單元模型，讀取兩種假想情境而不接觸真實帶電設備。比較均匀與部分遮蔭 P–V。 比較差異是否符合「旁路動作可產生多個局部功率峰。」；列出至少兩個競爭原因，指定能區分原因的新增量測。先依專案規格訂接受條件，再納入量測不確定度，將未驗證項保持為未決。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit model and inspect two hypothetical cases without accessing energized equipment. Compare uniform and shaded P–V curves. Compare the result against: Bypass action can create multiple local power peaks. List at least two competing causes and select an additional discriminating measurement. Define acceptance from project requirements before observing results, include uncertainty and retain unverified items as unresolved.

寄生對地電容連結共模電壓及漏電流。
只調整「漏電流」的顯示結果吻合，便可當作獨立量測證據。
optionsEn: Equal nominal ratings justify skipping leakage current verification.
Ground capacitance links common-mode voltage to leakage.
Tuning the displayed leakage current result to match counts as independent measurement evidence.

Compare the result against: Ground capacitance links common-mode voltage to leakage. List at least two competing causes and select an additional discriminating measurement. Define acceptance from project requirements before observing results, include uncertainty and retain unverified items as unresolved.

knowledge.textEn: For assumed 10 kW PV input at 97% efficiency, AC output is 9.7 kW and loss 300 W. At equivalent thermal resistance 0.10 K/W, mean rise is 30 K; junction hot spots and environment variation are omitted.

quiz.question: 審查「產能監測」時，哪個判斷或驗證方法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or check is justified for yield monitoring?
options: 只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「產能監測」的驗證。
只調整「產能監測」的顯示結果吻合，便可當作獨立量測證據。
用氣象歸一化與狀態碼歸因。
optionsEn: Equal nominal ratings justify skipping yield monitoring verification.
Tuning the displayed yield monitoring result to match counts as independent measurement evidence.
Attribute using weather normalization and status codes.
quiz.explanation: 發電降低可能來自天候、污損或限功率。 用氣象歸一化與狀態碼歸因。
quiz.explanationEn: Yield decline may reflect weather, soiling or curtailment. Attribute using weather normalization and status codes.

summary: 以MPPT、直流鏈與三相併網控制串連 12 個技術單元；新增 24 步，包含原理、假想算例、量測設計、失效辨識與驗收證據。
summaryEn: Twelve technical units connect mppt, dc links and three-phase interconnection control through 24 new tasks with principles, hypothetical calculations, measurement design, failure discrimination and acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開原理的離線工程教育與報告判讀。數值為自行設定的教學假設，非產品保證、現場整定、製造配方或帶電操作程序；高壓、旋轉與大型設備實務由合格團隊依正式規格驗證。完成課程不是專業執照。
scopeEn: Offline engineering education and report interpretation from public principles. Inputs are independently chosen teaching assumptions, not product guarantees, field settings, recipes or live-work procedures. Qualified teams validate high-voltage, rotating and large equipment under formal requirements. Course completion is not professional licensure.

workedExample.textEn: For assumed 10 kW PV input at 97% efficiency, AC output is 9.7 kW and loss 300 W. At equivalent thermal resistance 0.10 K/W, mean rise is 30 K; junction hot spots and environment variation are omitted.
workedExample.assumptions: 算例內列出的參數及理想化條件；更改波形、材料、溫度、拓撲或模型邊界後須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Use the stated parameters and idealizations; recalculate after changing waveforms, materials, temperature, topology or boundaries.

stages.title: 模組與輸入
stages.description: 以三個技術單元完成「模組與輸入」的模型及判讀，共六項獨立保存的作業。
stages.descriptionEn: Three technical units develop module and input through six separately saved modeling and interpretation tasks.

steps.title: 模組級控制：模型與設計
steps.objective: 針對「模組級控制」建立可重算、可檢查的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a reproducible, reviewable engineering record for module-level control.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，標出「模組級控制」的輸入、輸出及量測基準，再在學徒工作台排列對應元件或資料流。獨立 MPPT 可減少模組間失配耦合。 在離線草圖或試算表建立基準與擾動兩種情境，寫出因果預測；用「比較同一遮蔭圖的兩種架構。」規劃如何反駁模型。把未知參數、單位與邊界記錄在學習筆記。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor diagram, identify inputs, outputs and references for module-level control, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Independent MPPT reduces intermodule mismatch coupling. Build baseline and perturbed cases offline and predict causality. Plan a falsification using: Compare architectures with identical shading maps. Record unknown parameters, units and boundaries in your learning notes.
steps.observation: 比較同一遮蔭圖的兩種架構。
steps.observationEn: Compare architectures with identical shading maps.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「模組級控制」的驗證。 應先核對量測基準、模型邊界及競爭失效原因。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Equal nominal ratings justify skipping module-level control verification. Check references, model boundaries and competing failure causes first.
steps.check: 提交「模組級控制」的兩情境模型、單位表及可反駁預測；說明「比較同一遮蔭圖的兩種架構。」如何區分情境。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case model, units and a falsifiable prediction for module-level control; explain how the proposed check distinguishes cases.

knowledge.title: 本單元機制
knowledge.text: 獨立 MPPT 可減少模組間失配耦合。
knowledge.textEn: Independent MPPT reduces intermodule mismatch coupling.

knowledge.title: 可區分原因的證據
knowledge.text: 比較同一遮蔭圖的兩種架構。 必須保留基準、單位及不確定度，未有實測資料時只做假想案例判讀。
knowledge.textEn: Compare architectures with identical shading maps. Retain references, units and uncertainty; without measured data, interpret hypothetical cases only.

knowledge.title: 本課量化連結
knowledge.text: 假設單相輸出 300 W、50 Hz，直流鏈 Vdc=400 V、C=100 μF；小波紋且無其他解耦時，雙頻電壓波紋峰值約 ΔV=P/(2ωCV)=11.94 V，ω=2π×50。峰對峰約 23.87 V，不是設計規格。
knowledge.textEn: For single-phase 300 W at 50 Hz with Vdc=400 V and C=100 μF, small-ripple double-frequency voltage amplitude is ΔV≈P/(2ωCV)=11.94 V, ω=2π×50; peak-to-peak≈23.87 V without other decoupling. This is not a design specification.

options: 獨立 MPPT 可減少模組間失配耦合。

optionsEn: Independent MPPT reduces intermodule mismatch coupling.
Equal nominal ratings justify skipping module-level control verification.
Tuning the displayed module-level control result to match counts as independent measurement evidence.
quiz.explanation: 獨立 MPPT 可減少模組間失配耦合。 比較同一遮蔭圖的兩種架構。
quiz.explanationEn: Independent MPPT reduces intermodule mismatch coupling. Compare architectures with identical shading maps.

steps.title: 模組級控制：量測與判讀
steps.objective: 針對「模組級控制」建立可重算、可檢查的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a reproducible, reviewable engineering record for module-level control.
steps.instruction: 先重播本單元模型，讀取兩種假想情境而不接觸真實帶電設備。比較同一遮蔭圖的兩種架構。 比較差異是否符合「獨立 MPPT 可減少模組間失配耦合。」；列出至少兩個競爭原因，指定能區分原因的新增量測。先依專案規格訂接受條件，再納入量測不確定度，將未驗證項保持為未決。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit model and inspect two hypothetical cases without accessing energized equipment. Compare architectures with identical shading maps. Compare the result against: Independent MPPT reduces intermodule mismatch coupling. List at least two competing causes and select an additional discriminating measurement. Define acceptance from project requirements before observing results, include uncertainty and retain unverified items as unresolved.
steps.observation: 比較同一遮蔭圖的兩種架構。
steps.observationEn: Compare architectures with identical shading maps.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「模組級控制」的驗證。 應先核對量測基準、模型邊界及競爭失效原因。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Equal nominal ratings justify skipping module-level control verification. Check references, model boundaries and competing failure causes first.
steps.check: 提交「模組級控制」的量測比較、誤差來源及放行／保留理由；不能用單一平均值掩蓋最差條件。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement comparison, error sources and accept/hold rationale for module-level control; do not hide limiting conditions behind one average.

scope: 公開原理的離線工程教育與報告判讀。數值為自行設定的教學假設，非產品保證、現場整定、製造配方或帶電操作程序；高壓、旋轉與大型設備實務由合格團隊依正式規格驗證。完成課程不是專業執照。

Inputs are independently chosen teaching assumptions, not product guarantees, field settings, recipes or live-work procedures. Qualified teams validate high-voltage, rotating and large equipment under formal requirements. Course completion is not professional licensure.

knowledge.title: 本課量化連結
knowledge.text: 平面接收器僅考慮直射光的余弦因子，偏角 20° 得 cos20°≈0.9397，即直射分量少約 6.03%。若 500 W/m² 入射、面積 2 m²，理想接收 939.69 W；不含散射、溫度或發電效率。
knowledge.textEn: For direct light only, a flat receiver at 20° error has cos20°≈0.9397, a 6.03% direct-component reduction. At 500 W/m² over 2 m², ideal received power is 939.69 W, excluding diffuse light, temperature and conversion.

quiz.question: 審查「太陽座標」時，哪個判斷或驗證方法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or check is justified for solar coordinates?
options: 方位角與高度角需明確方位及時間慣例。
只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「太陽座標」的驗證。
只調整「太陽座標」的顯示結果吻合，便可當作獨立量測證據。
optionsEn: Azimuth and elevation need direction and time conventions.
Equal nominal ratings justify skipping solar coordinates verification.
Tuning the displayed solar coordinates result to match counts as independent measurement evidence.
quiz.explanation: 方位角與高度角需明確方位及時間慣例。 核對正午、東西與時區案例。
quiz.explanationEn: Azimuth and elevation need direction and time conventions. Check noon, east/west and timezone cases.

steps.title: 太陽座標：量測與判讀
steps.objective: 針對「太陽座標」建立可重算、可檢查的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a reproducible, reviewable engineering record for solar coordinates.
steps.instruction: 先重播本單元模型，讀取兩種假想情境而不接觸真實帶電設備。核對正午、東西與時區案例。 比較差異是否符合「方位角與高度角需明確方位及時間慣例。」；列出至少兩個競爭原因，指定能區分原因的新增量測。先依專案規格訂接受條件，再納入量測不確定度，將未驗證項保持為未決。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit model and inspect two hypothetical cases without accessing energized equipment. Check noon, east/west and timezone cases. Compare the result against: Azimuth and elevation need direction and time conventions. List at least two competing causes and select an additional discriminating measurement. Define acceptance from project requirements before observing results, include uncertainty and retain unverified items as unresolved.
steps.observation: 核對正午、東西與時區案例。
steps.observationEn: Check noon, east/west and timezone cases.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「太陽座標」的驗證。 應先核對量測基準、模型邊界及競爭失效原因。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Equal nominal ratings justify skipping solar coordinates verification. Check references, model boundaries and competing failure causes first.
steps.check: 提交「太陽座標」的量測比較、誤差來源及放行／保留理由；不能用單一平均值掩蓋最差條件。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement comparison, error sources and accept/hold rationale for solar coordinates; do not hide limiting conditions behind one average.

Incidence follows the dot product of sun and panel normals. Build baseline and perturbed cases offline and predict causality. Plan a falsification using: Compare vector and single-axis approximations. Record unknown parameters, units and boundaries in your learning notes.

summary: 以太陽方位、雙軸運動學與風載退避串連 12 個技術單元；新增 24 步，包含原理、假想算例、量測設計、失效辨識與驗收證據。
summaryEn: Twelve technical units connect sun position, dual-axis kinematics and wind stow through 24 new tasks with principles, hypothetical calculations, measurement design, failure discrimination and acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開原理的離線工程教育與報告判讀。數值為自行設定的教學假設，非產品保證、現場整定、製造配方或帶電操作程序；高壓、旋轉與大型設備實務由合格團隊依正式規格驗證。完成課程不是專業執照。
scopeEn: Offline engineering education and report interpretation from public principles. Inputs are independently chosen teaching assumptions, not product guarantees, field settings, recipes or live-work procedures. Qualified teams validate high-voltage, rotating and large equipment under formal requirements. Course completion is not professional licensure.

workedExample.textEn: For direct light only, a flat receiver at 20° error has cos20°≈0.9397, a 6.03% direct-component reduction. At 500 W/m² over 2 m², ideal received power is 939.69 W, excluding diffuse light, temperature and conversion.
workedExample.assumptions: 算例內列出的參數及理想化條件；更改波形、材料、溫度、拓撲或模型邊界後須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Use the stated parameters and idealizations; recalculate after changing waveforms, materials, temperature, topology or boundaries.
workedExample.sourceScope: 作者原創的假想數值題；官方資料支援領域脈絡，並非這組數字的實測來源。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original hypothetical numerical exercise; official sources support context, not measurements of these inputs.

title: 海上風機發電機整合
summary: 以 4 階段、24 步探討海上風能、發電機電磁設計與海洋環境的共同限制，包含 12 個專題模型、對照驗證、原創教學算例及延伸工法。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps explore coupled offshore wind, generator electromagnetics and marine conditions, including 12 topic-specific models, controlled checks, original worked examples and related methods.
scope: 公開原理支持的離線工程教學；24 步是學習拆解，不是完整工廠或現場 SOP。數字明示為假設教學例，不冒充廠商機密、實測或通用設定。穩態功率平衡不描述疲勞、陣風、軸系扭振或短路；需分開做結構、熱與電網動態驗證。
scopeEn: Offline engineering education based on public principles. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete factory/field SOP. Numbers are explicit teaching assumptions, not proprietary recipes, measurements or universal settings. Steady power balance does not describe fatigue, gusts, shaft torsion or faults; structural, thermal and grid-dynamic validation remain separate.

stages.description: 以三個具體技術單元完成能量與傳動；每單元先建立模型，再以對照和反證驗收。
stages.descriptionEn: Complete energy and drivetrain through three technical units, each pairing a model with controlled verification.

steps.objective: 以可檢驗證據理解辨識能量邊界，辨識物理機制、量測條件與模型限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand define energy boundaries through testable evidence, distinguishing physics, measurement conditions and model limits.
steps.instruction: 固定空氣密度，將風速 8 改為 10 m/s，比較理想可用功率比 1.953。 先畫出系統邊界與能量或訊號方向，逐項寫明單位、定義和固定條件，再預測結果；只使用離線模型或已取得的公開紀錄。
steps.instructionEn: At fixed density compare available power at 8 and 10 m/s: the ratio is 1.953. First draw the system boundary and energy/signal direction. State units, definitions and controlled conditions, then predict the result. Use offline models or already available public records only.
steps.observation: 固定空氣密度，將風速 8 改為 10 m/s，比較理想可用功率比 1.953。 比較前先確認量綱與取樣時間一致；若差異小於不確定度，保留未定結論。
steps.observationEn: At fixed density compare available power at 8 and 10 m/s: the ratio is 1.953. Match dimensions and sampling time before comparison; retain an unresolved conclusion if differences are below uncertainty.
steps.failure: 若「辨識能量邊界」的結果與預測不符，分別檢查定義／尺度、模型前提及感測或數據錯誤；不要把海上風能、發電機電磁設計與海洋環境的共同限制的限制隱藏在單一合格數字中。
steps.failureEn: If define energy boundaries disagrees with prediction, separately check definitions/scaling, assumptions and sensing/data faults. Do not hide the limits of coupled offshore wind, generator electromagnetics and marine conditions behind one passing number.
steps.check: 交付「辨識能量邊界」的圖或計算、預測、指定對照、單位與一項尚未驗證的假設；說明何種觀察應暫緩放行。

knowledge.title: 本課可重算的算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 教學例：15 MW、10 rpm 時，ω=2πn/60=1.047 rad/s，軸轉矩 T=P/ω=14.32 MN·m；若機電效率 96%，15 MW 軸輸入只得 14.4 MW 電輸出。這是量綱練習，不是參考風機額定規格。 穩態功率平衡不描述疲勞、陣風、軸系扭振或短路；需分開做結構、熱與電網動態驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching example: at 15 MW and 10 rpm, ω=2πn/60=1.047 rad/s and shaft torque T=P/ω=14.32 MN·m. With 96% electromechanical efficiency, 15 MW shaft input yields 14.4 MW electrical output. This is a dimensional exercise, not a reference-turbine rating. Steady power balance does not describe fatigue, gusts, shaft torsion or faults; structural, thermal and grid-dynamic validation remain separate.

steps.objective: 以可檢驗證據理解選擇直驅或齒輪傳動，辨識物理機制、量測條件與模型限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand compare direct and geared drives through testable evidence, distinguishing physics, measurement conditions and model limits.
steps.instruction: 以相同軸功率比較 10 rpm 與 1,000 rpm，列出轉矩的 100 倍差異。 先畫出系統邊界與能量或訊號方向，逐項寫明單位、定義和固定條件，再預測結果；只使用離線模型或已取得的公開紀錄。
steps.instructionEn: At equal shaft power compare 10 and 1,000 rpm and the 100-fold torque difference. First draw the system boundary and energy/signal direction. State units, definitions and controlled conditions, then predict the result. Use offline models or already available public records only.
steps.observation: 以相同軸功率比較 10 rpm 與 1,000 rpm，列出轉矩的 100 倍差異。 比較前先確認量綱與取樣時間一致；若差異小於不確定度，保留未定結論。
steps.observationEn: At equal shaft power compare 10 and 1,000 rpm and the 100-fold torque difference. Match dimensions and sampling time before comparison; retain an unresolved conclusion if differences are below uncertainty.
steps.failure: 若「選擇直驅或齒輪傳動」的結果與預測不符，分別檢查定義／尺度、模型前提及感測或數據錯誤；不要把海上風能、發電機電磁設計與海洋環境的共同限制的限制隱藏在單一合格數字中。
steps.failureEn: If compare direct and geared drives disagrees with prediction, separately check definitions/scaling, assumptions and sensing/data faults. Do not hide the limits of coupled offshore wind, generator electromagnetics and marine conditions behind one passing number.
steps.check: 交付「選擇直驅或齒輪傳動」的圖或計算、預測、指定對照、單位與一項尚未驗證的假設；說明何種觀察應暫緩放行。
steps.checkEn: Submit a diagram/calculation for compare direct and geared drives, prediction, specified comparison, units and one unvalidated assumption. State which observation requires withholding acceptance.

knowledge.title: 選擇直驅或齒輪傳動：原理
knowledge.titleEn: Compare direct and geared drives: principle
knowledge.text: 增速齒輪降低發電機轉矩需求，卻增加齒輪損耗與維修介面。
knowledge.textEn: A gearbox lowers generator torque but adds gear losses and maintenance interfaces.

knowledge.title: 選擇直驅或齒輪傳動：證據
knowledge.titleEn: Compare direct and geared drives: evidence
knowledge.text: 以相同軸功率比較 10 rpm 與 1,000 rpm，列出轉矩的 100 倍差異。
knowledge.textEn: At equal shaft power compare 10 and 1,000 rpm and the 100-fold torque difference.

knowledge.title: 本課可重算的算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 教學例：15 MW、10 rpm 時，ω=2πn/60=1.047 rad/s，軸轉矩 T=P/ω=14.32 MN·m；若機電效率 96%，15 MW 軸輸入只得 14.4 MW 電輸出。這是量綱練習，不是參考風機額定規格。 穩態功率平衡不描述疲勞、陣風、軸系扭振或短路；需分開做結構、熱與電網動態驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching example: at 15 MW and 10 rpm, ω=2πn/60=1.047 rad/s and shaft torque T=P/ω=14.32 MN·m. With 96% electromechanical efficiency, 15 MW shaft input yields 14.4 MW electrical output. This is a dimensional exercise, not a reference-turbine rating. Steady power balance does not describe fatigue, gusts, shaft torsion or faults; structural, thermal and grid-dynamic validation remain separate.

optionsEn: If a number is near its nominal value, units, boundaries and errors do not need checking.
Use a rating from another course or device directly as this step’s acceptance limit.
A gearbox lowers generator torque but adds gear losses and maintenance interfaces.

quiz.explanationEn: A gearbox lowers generator torque but adds gear losses and maintenance interfaces. At equal shaft power compare 10 and 1,000 rpm and the 100-fold torque difference.

title: 風機變流器與電氣保護
summary: 以 4 階段、24 步探討背對背變流器、直流匯流排與故障穿越的能量協調，包含 12 個專題模型、對照驗證、原創教學算例及延伸工法。

scopeEn: Offline engineering education based on public principles. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete factory/field SOP. options: 只要數值接近名目值，就不必檢查單位、量測邊界與誤差。
用本課 21 ms 算例對照模擬上升時間，改變電容看比例。
以其他課程或其他元件的額定值直接作本步的驗收門檻。
optionsEn: If a number is near its nominal value, units, boundaries and errors do not need checking.
Compare a simulated rise with the 21 ms example and vary capacitance to check scaling.
Use a rating from another course or device directly as this step’s acceptance limit.
quiz.explanation: DC 電壓是功率失衡的積分結果，網側跌壓會減少可輸送功率。 用本課 21 ms 算例對照模擬上升時間，改變電容看比例。
quiz.explanationEn: DC voltage integrates power imbalance; a grid dip can reduce export capacity. Compare a simulated rise with the 21 ms example and vary capacitance to check scaling.

steps.title: 處理限幅與反積分飽和：建立模型
steps.titleEn: Handle limits and anti-windup: build the model
steps.objective: 以可檢驗證據理解處理限幅與反積分飽和，辨識物理機制、量測條件與模型限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand handle limits and anti-windup through testable evidence, distinguishing physics, measurement conditions and model limits.
steps.instruction: 對相同跌壓比較有無反積分飽和的復原波形。 先畫出系統邊界與能量或訊號方向，逐項寫明單位、定義和固定條件，再預測結果；只使用離線模型或已取得的公開紀錄。
steps.instructionEn: Compare recovery from the same voltage dip with and without anti-windup. First draw the system boundary and energy/signal direction. State units, definitions and controlled conditions, then predict the result. Use offline models or already available public records only.
steps.observation: 對相同跌壓比較有無反積分飽和的復原波形。 比較前先確認量綱與取樣時間一致；若差異小於不確定度，保留未定結論。
steps.observationEn: Compare recovery from the same voltage dip with and without anti-windup. Match dimensions and sampling time before comparison; retain an unresolved conclusion if differences are below uncertainty.
steps.failure: 若「處理限幅與反積分飽和」的結果與預測不符，分別檢查定義／尺度、模型前提及感測或數據錯誤；不要把背對背變流器、直流匯流排與故障穿越的能量協調的限制隱藏在單一合格數字中。
steps.failureEn: If handle limits and anti-windup disagrees with prediction, separately check definitions/scaling, assumptions and sensing/data faults. Do not hide the limits of energy coordination of back-to-back converters, DC links and fault ride-through behind one passing number.
steps.check: 交付「處理限幅與反積分飽和」的圖或計算、預測、指定對照、單位與一項尚未驗證的假設；說明何種觀察應暫緩放行。
steps.checkEn: Submit a diagram/calculation for handle limits and anti-windup, prediction, specified comparison, units and one unvalidated assumption. State which observation requires withholding acceptance.

knowledge.title: 本課可重算的算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 教學例：C=20 mF 的直流電容從 1,000 V 升至 1,100 V，ΔE=C(V₂²−V₁²)/2=2.10 kJ。若機側比網側多輸入 100 kW，只需約 21 ms 累積這份能量，忽略損耗。 穿越曲線、無功優先與跳脫時限須取自實際併網規範；本課不提供現場保護設定。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching example: a 20 mF DC capacitor rising from 1,000 to 1,100 V stores ΔE=C(V₂²−V₁²)/2=2.10 kJ. A 100 kW machine-to-grid power imbalance accumulates this in about 21 ms, neglecting losses. Ride-through curves, reactive-current priority and trip delays come from the actual grid code; this course does not prescribe field protection settings.

title: 風場集電系統
summary: 以 4 階段、24 步探討海纜電容、集電拓樸、熱額定與選擇性保護，包含 12 個專題模型、對照驗證、原創教學算例及延伸工法。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps explore subsea-cable capacitance, collector topology, thermal ratings and selective protection, including 12 topic-specific models, controlled checks, original worked examples and related methods.
scope: 公開原理支持的離線工程教學；24 步是學習拆解，不是完整工廠或現場 SOP。數字明示為假設教學例，不冒充廠商機密、實測或通用設定。集中參數模型只適合對應頻段與長度；暫態、局部放電及海床熱阻須用專用模型與量測。
scopeEn: Offline engineering education based on public principles. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete factory/field SOP. Numbers are explicit teaching assumptions, not proprietary recipes, measurements or universal settings. Lumped models apply only within their frequency and length range; transients, partial discharge and seabed thermal resistance need dedicated models and measurements.

knowledge.title: 本課可重算的算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 教學例：平衡三相 30 MW、66 kV、功率因數 0.95，I=P/(√3·VLL·PF)=276.2 A。每相 R=0.6 Ω 時總銅損 3I²R≈137.3 kW；忽略充電電流後的結果不能直接用於長海纜選型。 集中參數模型只適合對應頻段與長度；暫態、局部放電及海床熱阻須用專用模型與量測。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching example: balanced 30 MW at 66 kV and power factor 0.95 gives I=P/(√3·VLL·PF)=276.2 A. At R=0.6 Ω per phase, total copper loss 3I²R≈137.3 kW. title: 抽蓄電站電氣控制
summary: 以 4 階段、24 步探討水力儲能、可變速機組與抽發模式切換的控制邊界，包含 12 個專題模型、對照驗證、原創教學算例及延伸工法。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps explore hydraulic storage, variable-speed machines and pumping/generation control boundaries, including 12 topic-specific models, controlled checks, original worked examples and related methods.
scope: 公開原理支持的離線工程教學；24 步是學習拆解，不是完整工廠或現場 SOP。數字明示為假設教學例，不冒充廠商機密、實測或通用設定。水頭和效率隨工況改變；本課只做離線調度與狀態機分析，不是水輪機現場啟停程序。
scopeEn: Offline engineering education based on public principles. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete factory/field SOP. Numbers are explicit teaching assumptions, not proprietary recipes, measurements or universal settings. Head and efficiency vary with operating point; this is offline dispatch and state-machine analysis, not a field turbine starting procedure.

stages.title: 水能與機組
stages.description: 以三個具體技術單元完成水能與機組；每單元先建立模型，再以對照和反證驗收。
stages.descriptionEn: Complete water and machinery through three technical units, each pairing a model with controlled verification.

steps.title: 定義有效庫容：建立模型
steps.titleEn: Define usable reservoir volume: build the model
steps.objective: 以可檢驗證據理解定義有效庫容，辨識物理機制、量測條件與模型限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand define usable reservoir volume through testable evidence, distinguishing physics, measurement conditions and model limits.
steps.instruction: 以庫容—水位表裁去不可用水位，重新積分位能。 先畫出系統邊界與能量或訊號方向，逐項寫明單位、定義和固定條件，再預測結果；只使用離線模型或已取得的公開紀錄。
steps.instructionEn: Trim unusable levels from a volume-elevation table and reintegrate potential energy. First draw the system boundary and energy/signal direction. State units, definitions and controlled conditions, then predict the result. Use offline models or already available public records only.
steps.observation: 以庫容—水位表裁去不可用水位，重新積分位能。 比較前先確認量綱與取樣時間一致；若差異小於不確定度，保留未定結論。
steps.observationEn: Trim unusable levels from a volume-elevation table and reintegrate potential energy. Match dimensions and sampling time before comparison; retain an unresolved conclusion if differences are below uncertainty.

knowledge.textEn: Gross reservoir volume differs from usable storage because water-level limits bound volume.

knowledge.title: 定義有效庫容：證據
knowledge.text: 以庫容—水位表裁去不可用水位，重新積分位能。
knowledge.textEn: Trim unusable levels from a volume-elevation table and reintegrate potential energy.

knowledge.title: 本課可重算的算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 教學例：ρ=1,000 kg/m³、有效水量 10⁶ m³、平均水頭 100 m，位能 ρgVH=981 GJ=272.5 MWh。發電效率 90% 時得 245.25 MWh；抽水效率 90% 時需 302.78 MWh，往返效率 81%。 水頭和效率隨工況改變；本課只做離線調度與狀態機分析，不是水輪機現場啟停程序。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching example: ρ=1,000 kg/m³, usable volume 10⁶ m³ and mean head 100 m give ρgVH=981 GJ=272.5 MWh. At 90% generating efficiency output is 245.25 MWh; at 90% pumping efficiency input is 302.78 MWh, yielding 81% round-trip efficiency. Head and efficiency vary with operating point; this is offline dispatch and state-machine analysis, not a field turbine starting procedure.

title: 潮汐發電機電力調節
summary: 以 4 階段、24 步探討潮流可預測性、雙向水流與海洋電力調節，包含 12 個專題模型、對照驗證、原創教學算例及延伸工法。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps explore predictable tides, reversing flow and marine power conditioning, including 12 topic-specific models, controlled checks, original worked examples and related methods.
scope: 公開原理支持的離線工程教學；24 步是學習拆解，不是完整工廠或現場 SOP。數字明示為假設教學例，不冒充廠商機密、實測或通用設定。潮汐週期可預測不表示短時功率不變；湍流、海況及環境限制另需評估，無水下作業指令。
scopeEn: Offline engineering education based on public principles. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete factory/field SOP. Numbers are explicit teaching assumptions, not proprietary recipes, measurements or universal settings. Predictable tides do not imply constant short-term power; turbulence, sea state and environmental constraints need separate assessment, with no underwater work instructions.

steps.objective: 以可檢驗證據理解重建潮流時間序列，辨識物理機制、量測條件與模型限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand reconstruct tidal-flow series through testable evidence, distinguishing physics, measurement conditions and model limits.
steps.instruction: 以正弦流速作示意，先取速率絕對值再算立方功率，保留停潮時段。 先畫出系統邊界與能量或訊號方向，逐項寫明單位、定義和固定條件，再預測結果；只使用離線模型或已取得的公開紀錄。
steps.instructionEn: Use an illustrative sine velocity, cube its absolute speed for power and retain slack-water intervals. First draw the system boundary and energy/signal direction. State units, definitions and controlled conditions, then predict the result. Use offline models or already available public records only.
steps.observation: 以正弦流速作示意，先取速率絕對值再算立方功率，保留停潮時段。 比較前先確認量綱與取樣時間一致；若差異小於不確定度，保留未定結論。
steps.observationEn: Use an illustrative sine velocity, cube its absolute speed for power and retain slack-water intervals. Match dimensions and sampling time before comparison; retain an unresolved conclusion if differences are below uncertainty.
steps.failure: 若「重建潮流時間序列」的結果與預測不符，分別檢查定義／尺度、模型前提及感測或數據錯誤；不要把潮流可預測性、雙向水流與海洋電力調節的限制隱藏在單一合格數字中。
steps.failureEn: If reconstruct tidal-flow series disagrees with prediction, separately check definitions/scaling, assumptions and sensing/data faults. Do not hide the limits of predictable tides, reversing flow and marine power conditioning behind one passing number.
steps.check: 交付「重建潮流時間序列」的圖或計算、預測、指定對照、單位與一項尚未驗證的假設；說明何種觀察應暫緩放行。
steps.checkEn: Submit a diagram/calculation for reconstruct tidal-flow series, prediction, specified comparison, units and one unvalidated assumption. State which observation requires withholding acceptance.

knowledge.text: 可預測潮週期仍含大潮小潮與局部湍流變動。
knowledge.textEn: Predictable tidal cycles still include spring-neap variation and local turbulence.

knowledge.title: 重建潮流時間序列：證據

knowledge.textEn: Use an illustrative sine velocity, cube its absolute speed for power and retain slack-water intervals.

knowledge.title: 本課可重算的算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 教學例：海水密度 1,025 kg/m³、掃掠面積 100 m²、流速 2 m/s，流體功率 ρAv³/2=410 kW；假設 Cp=0.40、發電鏈效率 0.90，輸出 147.6 kW。流速反向需另處理轉子控制，不代表負的可採能量。 潮汐週期可預測不表示短時功率不變；湍流、海況及環境限制另需評估，無水下作業指令。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching example: seawater density 1,025 kg/m³, swept area 100 m² and speed 2 m/s give flow power ρAv³/2=410 kW. Assuming Cp=0.40 and conversion efficiency 0.90 gives 147.6 kW. Flow reversal requires rotor-control treatment, not negative harvestable energy. Predictable tides do not imply constant short-term power; turbulence, sea state and environmental constraints need separate assessment, with no underwater work instructions.

knowledge.textEn: Teaching example: seawater density 1,025 kg/m³, swept area 100 m² and speed 2 m/s give flow power ρAv³/2=410 kW. Assuming Cp=0.40 and conversion efficiency 0.90 gives 147.6 kW. Flow reversal requires rotor-control treatment, not negative harvestable energy. Predictable tides do not imply constant short-term power; turbulence, sea state and environmental constraints need separate assessment, with no underwater work instructions.

quiz.question: 關於「匹配發電機整流：建立模型」，哪一項是本步有依據的主張或驗證方式？
quiz.questionEn: For “Match generator and rectifier: build the model”, which claim or verification is justified?
options: 只要數值接近名目值，就不必檢查單位、量測邊界與誤差。
變速發電機的電壓頻率隨轉速改變，整流器需涵蓋運轉包絡。
以其他課程或其他元件的額定值直接作本步的驗收門檻。
optionsEn: If a number is near its nominal value, units, boundaries and errors do not need checking.
Variable-speed generator voltage/frequency change with speed; the rectifier must cover that envelope.
Use a rating from another course or device directly as this step’s acceptance limit.
quiz.explanation: 變速發電機的電壓頻率隨轉速改變，整流器需涵蓋運轉包絡。 比較低流速與高流速的輸入包絡，標记 DC 升壓需求。
quiz.explanationEn: Variable-speed generator voltage/frequency change with speed; the rectifier must cover that envelope. Compare input envelopes at low/high flow and mark where DC boosting is needed.

steps.title: 匹配發電機整流：反證與驗收
steps.titleEn: Match generator and rectifier: challenge and acceptance
steps.objective: 以可檢驗證據理解匹配發電機整流，辨識物理機制、量測條件與模型限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand match generator and rectifier through testable evidence, distinguishing physics, measurement conditions and model limits.
steps.instruction: 先沿用模型，寫下會推翻「變速發電機的電壓頻率隨轉速改變，整流器需涵蓋運轉包絡。」的觀察。比較低流速與高流速的輸入包絡，標记 DC 升壓需求。 加入一個對照條件，分開記錄原始數據、推論與不確定度；若前提失效則暫緩判定。
steps.instructionEn: Use the model and state an observation that would refute this claim: Variable-speed generator voltage/frequency change with speed; the rectifier must cover that envelope. Compare input envelopes at low/high flow and mark where DC boosting is needed. Add a control condition and separate raw data, inference and uncertainty. Withhold acceptance if assumptions fail.
steps.observation: 比較低流速與高流速的輸入包絡，標记 DC 升壓需求。 比較前先確認量綱與取樣時間一致；若差異小於不確定度，保留未定結論。
steps.observationEn: Compare input envelopes at low/high flow and mark where DC boosting is needed. Match dimensions and sampling time before comparison; retain an unresolved conclusion if differences are below uncertainty.
steps.failure: 若「匹配發電機整流」的結果與預測不符，分別檢查定義／尺度、模型前提及感測或數據錯誤；不要把潮流可預測性、雙向水流與海洋電力調節的限制隱藏在單一合格數字中。
steps.failureEn: If match generator and rectifier disagrees with prediction, separately check definitions/scaling, assumptions and sensing/data faults. Do not hide the limits of predictable tides, reversing flow and marine power conditioning behind one passing number.
steps.check: 交付「匹配發電機整流」的圖或計算、預測、指定對照、單位與一項尚未驗證的假設；說明何種觀察應暫緩放行。
steps.checkEn: Submit a diagram/calculation for match generator and rectifier, prediction, specified comparison, units and one unvalidated assumption. State which observation requires withholding acceptance.

steps.objective: 以可檢驗證據理解規劃環境停機限制，辨識物理機制、量測條件與模型限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand plan environmental curtailment through testable evidence, distinguishing physics, measurement conditions and model limits.
steps.instruction: 在發電時序加入一段假設保護停機，重算可供能而不改寫資源流速。 先畫出系統邊界與能量或訊號方向，逐項寫明單位、定義和固定條件，再預測結果；只使用離線模型或已取得的公開紀錄。
steps.instructionEn: Insert a hypothetical environmental curtailment interval and recompute deliverable energy without altering resource velocity. First draw the system boundary and energy/signal direction. State units, definitions and controlled conditions, then predict the result. Use offline models or already available public records only.
steps.observation: 在發電時序加入一段假設保護停機，重算可供能而不改寫資源流速。 比較前先確認量綱與取樣時間一致；若差異小於不確定度，保留未定結論。
steps.observationEn: Insert a hypothetical environmental curtailment interval and recompute deliverable energy without altering resource velocity. Match dimensions and sampling time before comparison; retain an unresolved conclusion if differences are below uncertainty.
steps.failure: 若「規劃環境停機限制」的結果與預測不符，分別檢查定義／尺度、模型前提及感測或數據錯誤；不要把潮流可預測性、雙向水流與海洋電力調節的限制隱藏在單一合格數字中。
steps.failureEn: If plan environmental curtailment disagrees with prediction, separately check definitions/scaling, assumptions and sensing/data faults. Do not hide the limits of predictable tides, reversing flow and marine power conditioning behind one passing number.
steps.check: 交付「規劃環境停機限制」的圖或計算、預測、指定對照、單位與一項尚未驗證的假設；說明何種觀察應暫緩放行。
steps.checkEn: Submit a diagram/calculation for plan environmental curtailment, prediction, specified comparison, units and one unvalidated assumption. State which observation requires withholding acceptance.

knowledge.text: 環境監測可能約束發電時間，電力預測應保留此非電氣限制。

knowledge.textEn: Insert a hypothetical environmental curtailment interval and recompute deliverable energy without altering resource velocity.

knowledge.title: 本課可重算的算例與適用範圍

Flow reversal requires rotor-control treatment, not negative harvestable energy. Predictable tides do not imply constant short-term power; turbulence, sea state and environmental constraints need separate assessment, with no underwater work instructions.

title: 電池儲能電站整合
summary: 以 4 階段、24 步探討儲能電池、功率變流器與能源管理的分層整合，包含 12 個專題模型、對照驗證、原創教學算例及延伸工法。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps explore layered battery, power-converter and energy-management integration, including 12 topic-specific models, controlled checks, original worked examples and related methods.

knowledge.text: 教學例：2 MWh 名目電池只在 SOC 10–90% 間運轉，可用 DC 能量 1.6 MWh；若放電鏈效率 95%，AC 交付約 1.52 MWh。以 1 MW 定功率可維持 1.52 h，尚未計入溫度與老化降額。 容量、消防、併網與建築條件均需專案審核；本課是離線系統整合模型，不提供電池櫃施工與帶電測試程序。

knowledge.textEn: Teaching example: a 2 MWh nominal battery operated between 10% and 90% SOC offers 1.6 MWh DC energy. At 95% discharge-chain efficiency it delivers about 1.52 MWh AC, or 1.52 hours at 1 MW, before temperature and aging derating. Capacity, fire response, interconnection and building conditions need project review; this is an offline integration model, not cabinet construction or energized testing.

quiz.question: 關於「界定可用能量窗口：反證與驗收」，哪一項是本步有依據的主張或驗證方式？
quiz.questionEn: For “Bound usable energy: challenge and acceptance”, which claim or verification is justified?
options: 只要數值接近名目值，就不必檢查單位、量測邊界與誤差。
重算本課 1.52 MWh 例，再把 SOC 上限降至 80% 比較。
以其他課程或其他元件的額定值直接作本步的驗收門檻。
optionsEn: If a number is near its nominal value, units, boundaries and errors do not need checking.
Recompute the 1.52 MWh example and compare after lowering the upper SOC to 80%.
Use a rating from another course or device directly as this step’s acceptance limit.
quiz.explanation: 名目能量不是可交付 AC 能量，SOC 窗口與效率需順序計入。 重算本課 1.52 MWh 例，再把 SOC 上限降至 80% 比較。
quiz.explanationEn: Nominal energy is not deliverable AC energy; SOC window and efficiency enter sequentially. Recompute the 1.52 MWh example and compare after lowering the upper SOC to 80%.

stages.title: 直流與變流
stages.description: 以三個具體技術單元完成直流與變流；每單元先建立模型，再以對照和反證驗收。
stages.descriptionEn: Complete dc and conversion through three technical units, each pairing a model with controlled verification.

steps.title: 建立預充概念模型：建立模型
steps.titleEn: Build a precharge concept model: build the model
steps.objective: 以可檢驗證據理解建立預充概念模型，辨識物理機制、量測條件與模型限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand build a precharge concept model through testable evidence, distinguishing physics, measurement conditions and model limits.
steps.instruction: 離線模擬 RC 充電至 3τ 約 95%，明示這不是現場接線時間設定。 先畫出系統邊界與能量或訊號方向，逐項寫明單位、定義和固定條件，再預測結果；只使用離線模型或已取得的公開紀錄。
steps.instructionEn: Simulate RC charging to about 95% at 3τ and state that this is not a field timing setting. First draw the system boundary and energy/signal direction. State units, definitions and controlled conditions, then predict the result. Use offline models or already available public records only.
steps.observation: 離線模擬 RC 充電至 3τ 約 95%，明示這不是現場接線時間設定。 比較前先確認量綱與取樣時間一致；若差異小於不確定度，保留未定結論。
steps.observationEn: Simulate RC charging to about 95% at 3τ and state that this is not a field timing setting. Match dimensions and sampling time before comparison; retain an unresolved conclusion if differences are below uncertainty.
steps.failure: 若「建立預充概念模型」的結果與預測不符，分別檢查定義／尺度、模型前提及感測或數據錯誤；不要把儲能電池、功率變流器與能源管理的分層整合的限制隱藏在單一合格數字中。
steps.failureEn: If build a precharge concept model disagrees with prediction, separately check definitions/scaling, assumptions and sensing/data faults. Do not hide the limits of layered battery, power-converter and energy-management integration behind one passing number.
steps.check: 交付「建立預充概念模型」的圖或計算、預測、指定對照、單位與一項尚未驗證的假設；說明何種觀察應暫緩放行。
steps.checkEn: Submit a diagram/calculation for build a precharge concept model, prediction, specified comparison, units and one unvalidated assumption. State which observation requires withholding acceptance.

title: 鋰離子電池管理系統
summary: 以 4 階段、24 步探討單體量測、SOC 估測、均衡與分層保護，包含 12 個專題模型、對照驗證、原創教學算例及延伸工法。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps explore cell measurements, SOC estimation, balancing and layered protection, including 12 topic-specific models, controlled checks, original worked examples and related methods.
scope: 公開原理支持的離線工程教學；24 步是學習拆解，不是完整工廠或現場 SOP。數字明示為假設教學例，不冒充廠商機密、實測或通用設定。保護門檻依電芯化學、溫度、廠商與設計而異；不提供可直接燒錄的通用電池保護設定。
scopeEn: Offline engineering education based on public principles. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete factory/field SOP. Numbers are explicit teaching assumptions, not proprietary recipes, measurements or universal settings. Protection thresholds depend on chemistry, temperature, supplier and design; no universal flashable protection settings are provided.

knowledge.textEn: Reconcile four columns: liquid inventory, integrated charge, pump consumption and AC energy.

knowledge.title: 本課可重算的算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 教學例：假設堆疊輸出 100 kW、泵浦與輔機共 6 kW、PCS 效率 96%，AC 淨輸出=(100−6)×0.96=90.24 kW。輔機從哪一側供電會改變能量帳，必須先畫邊界。 電解液種類、堆疊阻抗與泵流條件依系統而異；本課無化學配製、壓力管路或現場通電程序。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching example: assume 100 kW stack output, 6 kW pump/auxiliary load and 96% PCS efficiency. Net AC output=(100−6)×0.96=90.24 kW. The accounting changes with auxiliary supply location, so draw the boundary first. Electrolyte chemistry, stack impedance and flow conditions are system-specific; no chemical preparation, pressure-piping or field energization procedures are provided.

title: 超級電容功率緩衝
summary: 以 4 階段、24 步探討電容量、ESR、串聯均壓與脈衝功率分配，包含 12 個專題模型、對照驗證、原創教學算例及延伸工法。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps explore capacitance, ESR, series balancing and pulse-power allocation, including 12 topic-specific models, controlled checks, original worked examples and related methods.
scope: 公開原理支持的離線工程教學；24 步是學習拆解，不是完整工廠或現場 SOP。數字明示為假設教學例，不冒充廠商機密、實測或通用設定。等效 RC 只描述選定時間尺度；漏電、溫度及老化必須另量測，教學假設不是充電安全限值。
scopeEn: Offline engineering education based on public principles. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete factory/field SOP. Numbers are explicit teaching assumptions, not proprietary recipes, measurements or universal settings. An equivalent RC model describes only selected timescales; leakage, temperature and aging need separate measurement, and examples are not safe charging limits.

stages.description: 以三個具體技術單元完成能量與阻抗；每單元先建立模型，再以對照和反證驗收。
stages.descriptionEn: Complete energy and impedance through three technical units, each pairing a model with controlled verification.

steps.titleEn: Distinguish charge and energy: build the model
steps.objective: 以可檢驗證據理解區分電荷與能量，辨識物理機制、量測條件與模型限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand distinguish charge and energy through testable evidence, distinguishing physics, measurement conditions and model limits.
steps.instruction: 重算本課 14 Wh，再比較放到 24 V 時可用能量。 先畫出系統邊界與能量或訊號方向，逐項寫明單位、定義和固定條件，再預測結果；只使用離線模型或已取得的公開紀錄。
steps.instructionEn: Recompute the 14 Wh example and compare usable energy when discharging to 24 V. First draw the system boundary and energy/signal direction. State units, definitions and controlled conditions, then predict the result. Use offline models or already available public records only.
steps.observation: 重算本課 14 Wh，再比較放到 24 V 時可用能量。 比較前先確認量綱與取樣時間一致；若差異小於不確定度，保留未定結論。
steps.observationEn: Recompute the 14 Wh example and compare usable energy when discharging to 24 V. Match dimensions and sampling time before comparison; retain an unresolved conclusion if differences are below uncertainty.
steps.failure: 若「區分電荷與能量」的結果與預測不符，分別檢查定義／尺度、模型前提及感測或數據錯誤；不要把電容量、ESR、串聯均壓與脈衝功率分配的限制隱藏在單一合格數字中。

knowledge.title: 區分電荷與能量：原理
knowledge.text: Q=CV 與 E=CV²/2 描述不同物理量，放電能量隨電壓平方變化。
knowledge.textEn: Q=CV and E=CV²/2 describe different quantities; discharge energy depends on voltage squared.

knowledge.title: 區分電荷與能量：證據
knowledge.text: 重算本課 14 Wh，再比較放到 24 V 時可用能量。

knowledge.title: 本課可重算的算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 教學例：100 F 模組從 48 V 放至 36 V，可用 E=C(Vmax²−Vmin²)/2=50,400 J=14 Wh；不是用 48 V×100 F 得能量。若 ESR=20 mΩ、電流 100 A，瞬時壓降 2 V、熱損 200 W。 等效 RC 只描述選定時間尺度；漏電、溫度及老化必須另量測，教學假設不是充電安全限值。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching example: a 100 F module discharged from 48 to 36 V provides E=C(Vmax²−Vmin²)/2=50,400 J=14 Wh. Voltage times farads is not energy. With ESR=20 mΩ at 100 A, the immediate drop is 2 V and heating is 200 W. An equivalent RC model describes only selected timescales; leakage, temperature and aging need separate measurement, and examples are not safe charging limits.

knowledge.textEn: For equal-duration ±50 A pulses compute 0 A mean, 50 A RMS and I²R heating.

knowledge.title: 本課可重算的算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 教學例：100 F 模組從 48 V 放至 36 V，可用 E=C(Vmax²−Vmin²)/2=50,400 J=14 Wh；不是用 48 V×100 F 得能量。若 ESR=20 mΩ、電流 100 A，瞬時壓降 2 V、熱損 200 W。 等效 RC 只描述選定時間尺度；漏電、溫度及老化必須另量測，教學假設不是充電安全限值。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching example: a 100 F module discharged from 48 to 36 V provides E=C(Vmax²−Vmin²)/2=50,400 J=14 Wh. Voltage times farads is not energy. With ESR=20 mΩ at 100 A, the immediate drop is 2 V and heating is 200 W. An equivalent RC model describes only selected timescales; leakage, temperature and aging need separate measurement, and examples are not safe charging limits.

steps.title: 建立 RMS 熱損：反證與驗收

steps.instructionEn: Use the model and state an observation that would refute this claim: ESR heating depends on RMS current; zero average current can still generate heat.
