steps.observationEn: For equal-duration ±50 A pulses compute 0 A mean, 50 A RMS and I²R heating. Match dimensions and sampling time before comparison; retain an unresolved conclusion if differences are below uncertainty.
steps.failure: 若「建立 RMS 熱損」的結果與預測不符，分別檢查定義／尺度、模型前提及感測或數據錯誤；不要把電容量、ESR、串聯均壓與脈衝功率分配的限制隱藏在單一合格數字中。
steps.failureEn: If build rms heating losses disagrees with prediction, separately check definitions/scaling, assumptions and sensing/data faults. Do not hide the limits of capacitance, ESR, series balancing and pulse-power allocation behind one passing number.
steps.check: 交付「建立 RMS 熱損」的圖或計算、預測、指定對照、單位與一項尚未驗證的假設；說明何種觀察應暫緩放行。
steps.checkEn: Submit a diagram/calculation for build rms heating losses, prediction, specified comparison, units and one unvalidated assumption. State which observation requires withholding acceptance.

knowledge.text: 回放 100 次離線脈衝，保留峰溫、最低電壓及充回時間。
knowledge.textEn: Replay 100 offline pulses and retain peak temperature, minimum voltage and recharge time.

title: 飛輪儲能電機控制
summary: 以 4 階段、24 步探討旋轉動能、雙向電機與飛輪損耗管理，包含 12 個專題模型、對照驗證、原創教學算例及延伸工法。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps explore rotational energy, bidirectional machines and flywheel loss management, including 12 topic-specific models, controlled checks, original worked examples and related methods.
scope: 公開原理支持的離線工程教學；24 步是學習拆解，不是完整工廠或現場 SOP。數字明示為假設教學例，不冒充廠商機密、實測或通用設定。飛輪破裂、真空與軸承失效有重大實體風險；僅做離線能量及控制建模，不提供轉子製造或超速測試程序。
scopeEn: Offline engineering education based on public principles. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete factory/field SOP. Numbers are explicit teaching assumptions, not proprietary recipes, measurements or universal settings. Rotor burst, vacuum and bearing failures are significant physical hazards; this is offline energy/control modeling, not rotor fabrication or overspeed testing.

knowledge.textEn: Teaching example: with J=10 kg·m² and speed falling from 10,000 to 5,000 rpm, ΔE=J(ω₁²−ω₂²)/2≈4.112 MJ=1.142 kWh. Halving speed leaves one quarter of initial energy; high speed also increases rotor stress. Rotor burst, vacuum and bearing failures are significant physical hazards; this is offline energy/control modeling, not rotor fabrication or overspeed testing.

quiz.question: 關於「分辨電磁與機械限制：建立模型」，哪一項是本步有依據的主張或驗證方式？

options: 只要數值接近名目值，就不必檢查單位、量測邊界與誤差。
以其他課程或其他元件的額定值直接作本步的驗收門檻。
電流限制、反電勢限制與轉子應力限制互不等價。
optionsEn: If a number is near its nominal value, units, boundaries and errors do not need checking.
Use a rating from another course or device directly as this step’s acceptance limit.
Current, back-EMF and rotor-stress limits are not equivalent.

quiz.explanationEn: Current, back-EMF and rotor-stress limits are not equivalent. Mark each limit on a torque-speed diagram and use their intersection rather than one rating.

steps.title: 分辨電磁與機械限制：反證與驗收
steps.titleEn: Separate electromagnetic and mechanical limits: challenge and acceptance
steps.objective: 以可檢驗證據理解分辨電磁與機械限制，辨識物理機制、量測條件與模型限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand separate electromagnetic and mechanical limits through testable evidence, distinguishing physics, measurement conditions and model limits.
steps.instruction: 先沿用模型，寫下會推翻「電流限制、反電勢限制與轉子應力限制互不等價。」的觀察。在轉矩—轉速圖各標一條限制，取交集而非單一額定點。 加入一個對照條件，分開記錄原始數據、推論與不確定度；若前提失效則暫緩判定。
steps.instructionEn: Use the model and state an observation that would refute this claim: Current, back-EMF and rotor-stress limits are not equivalent. Mark each limit on a torque-speed diagram and use their intersection rather than one rating. Add a control condition and separate raw data, inference and uncertainty. Withhold acceptance if assumptions fail.
steps.observation: 在轉矩—轉速圖各標一條限制，取交集而非單一額定點。 比較前先確認量綱與取樣時間一致；若差異小於不確定度，保留未定結論。
steps.observationEn: Mark each limit on a torque-speed diagram and use their intersection rather than one rating. Match dimensions and sampling time before comparison; retain an unresolved conclusion if differences are below uncertainty.
steps.failure: 若「分辨電磁與機械限制」的結果與預測不符，分別檢查定義／尺度、模型前提及感測或數據錯誤；不要把旋轉動能、雙向電機與飛輪損耗管理的限制隱藏在單一合格數字中。
steps.failureEn: If separate electromagnetic and mechanical limits disagrees with prediction, separately check definitions/scaling, assumptions and sensing/data faults. Do not hide the limits of rotational energy, bidirectional machines and flywheel loss management behind one passing number.
steps.check: 交付「分辨電磁與機械限制」的圖或計算、預測、指定對照、單位與一項尚未驗證的假設；說明何種觀察應暫緩放行。
steps.checkEn: Submit a diagram/calculation for separate electromagnetic and mechanical limits, prediction, specified comparison, units and one unvalidated assumption. State which observation requires withholding acceptance.

title: 不斷電系統設計
summary: 以 4 階段、24 步探討UPS 拓樸、儲能續航、旁路與負載相容性，包含 12 個專題模型、對照驗證、原創教學算例及延伸工法。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps explore UPS topologies, runtime, bypass and load compatibility, including 12 topic-specific models, controlled checks, original worked examples and related methods.
scope: 公開原理支持的離線工程教學；24 步是學習拆解，不是完整工廠或現場 SOP。數字明示為假設教學例，不冒充廠商機密、實測或通用設定。負載相容、轉換時間、短路保護及電池曲線需按選定設備驗證；本課不作帶電旁路操作指導。
scopeEn: Offline engineering education based on public principles. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete factory/field SOP. Numbers are explicit teaching assumptions, not proprietary recipes, measurements or universal settings. Validate load compatibility, transfer time, fault protection and battery curves for selected equipment; this course does not guide energized bypass operations.

title: 資料中心備援配電
titleEn: Redundant power distribution for data centers
summary: 以 4 階段、24 步探討A/B 配電、容量備援、共同失效與運維證據，包含 12 個專題模型、對照驗證、原創教學算例及延伸工法。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps explore A/B distribution, redundant capacity, common failures and operational evidence, including 12 topic-specific models, controlled checks, original worked examples and related methods.
scope: 公開原理支持的離線工程教學；24 步是學習拆解，不是完整工廠或現場 SOP。數字明示為假設教學例，不冒充廠商機密、實測或通用設定。可靠度分類、接地及現場切換須按工程規範與合格專業審核；課程只評估離線拓樸。
scopeEn: Offline engineering education based on public principles. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete factory/field SOP. Numbers are explicit teaching assumptions, not proprietary recipes, measurements or universal settings. Reliability classification, grounding and field switching require applicable engineering review; the course evaluates offline topologies only.

steps.instructionEn: Use the model and state an observation that would refute this claim: Phase imbalance and neutral harmonics matter; total kW is insufficient. Rebalance a 10, 8, 6 kW phase inventory while preserving branch constraints. Add a control condition and separate raw data, inference and uncertainty. Withhold acceptance if assumptions fail.
steps.observation: 對三相 10、8、6 kW 清單重新分配機櫃，保留支路限制。 比較前先確認量綱與取樣時間一致；若差異小於不確定度，保留未定結論。
steps.observationEn: Rebalance a 10, 8, 6 kW phase inventory while preserving branch constraints. Match dimensions and sampling time before comparison; retain an unresolved conclusion if differences are below uncertainty.
steps.failure: 若「平衡三相負載」的結果與預測不符，分別檢查定義／尺度、模型前提及感測或數據錯誤；不要把A/B 配電、容量備援、共同失效與運維證據的限制隱藏在單一合格數字中。

steps.check: 交付「平衡三相負載」的圖或計算、預測、指定對照、單位與一項尚未驗證的假設；說明何種觀察應暫緩放行。

knowledge.text: 將非電氣依賴加到故障樹，重新判斷路徑独立性。
knowledge.textEn: Add non-electrical dependencies to the fault tree and reassess path independence.

knowledge.title: 本課可重算的算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 教學例：一櫃 12 kW 雙電源負載正常平均由 A/B 各供 6 kW，但任一路失效後另一側須承接 12 kW。若把每側只按 6 kW 配置，兩路標籤不會產生備援。 可靠度分類、接地及現場切換須按工程規範與合格專業審核；課程只評估離線拓樸。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching example: a 12 kW dual-cord rack normally takes 6 kW from each A/B path, but either 剩餘路徑 must carry 12 kW after the other fails. Rating each path at only 6 kW does not create redundancy. Reliability classification, grounding and field switching require applicable engineering review; the course evaluates offline topologies only.

quiz.question: 關於「分析控制與燃料依賴：建立模型」，哪一項是本步有依據的主張或驗證方式？
quiz.questionEn: For “Analyze control and fuel dependencies: build the model”, which claim or verification is justified?
options: 共用控制網、發電機燃料或冷卻會形成跨電力路徑共同失效。
只要數值接近名目值，就不必檢查單位、量測邊界與誤差。
以其他課程或其他元件的額定值直接作本步的驗收門檻。
optionsEn: Shared controls, generator fuel or cooling can couple otherwise separate power paths.
If a number is near its nominal value, units, boundaries and errors do not need checking.
Use a rating from another course or device directly as this step’s acceptance limit.
quiz.explanation: 共用控制網、發電機燃料或冷卻會形成跨電力路徑共同失效。 將非電氣依賴加到故障樹，重新判斷路徑独立性。
quiz.explanationEn: Shared controls, generator fuel or cooling can couple otherwise separate power paths. Add non-electrical dependencies to the fault tree and reassess path independence.

steps.title: 分析控制與燃料依賴：反證與驗收
steps.titleEn: Analyze control and fuel dependencies: challenge and acceptance
steps.objective: 以可檢驗證據理解分析控制與燃料依賴，辨識物理機制、量測條件與模型限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand analyze control and fuel dependencies through testable evidence, distinguishing physics, measurement conditions and model limits.
steps.instruction: 先沿用模型，寫下會推翻「共用控制網、發電機燃料或冷卻會形成跨電力路徑共同失效。」的觀察。將非電氣依賴加到故障樹，重新判斷路徑独立性。 加入一個對照條件，分開記錄原始數據、推論與不確定度；若前提失效則暫緩判定。
steps.instructionEn: Use the model and state an observation that would refute this claim: Shared controls, generator fuel or cooling can couple otherwise separate power paths. Add non-electrical dependencies to the fault tree and reassess path independence. Add a control condition and separate raw data, inference and uncertainty. Withhold acceptance if assumptions fail.
steps.observation: 將非電氣依賴加到故障樹，重新判斷路徑独立性。 比較前先確認量綱與取樣時間一致；若差異小於不確定度，保留未定結論。
steps.observationEn: Add non-electrical dependencies to the fault tree and reassess path independence. Match dimensions and sampling time before comparison; retain an unresolved conclusion if differences are below uncertainty.
steps.failure: 若「分析控制與燃料依賴」的結果與預測不符，分別檢查定義／尺度、模型前提及感測或數據錯誤；不要把A/B 配電、容量備援、共同失效與運維證據的限制隱藏在單一合格數字中。
steps.failureEn: If analyze control and fuel dependencies disagrees with prediction, separately check definitions/scaling, assumptions and sensing/data faults. Do not hide the limits of A/B distribution, redundant capacity, common failures and operational evidence behind one passing number.
steps.check: 交付「分析控制與燃料依賴」的圖或計算、預測、指定對照、單位與一項尚未驗證的假設；說明何種觀察應暫緩放行。
steps.checkEn: Submit a diagram/calculation for analyze control and fuel dependencies, prediction, specified comparison, units and one unvalidated assumption. State which observation requires withholding acceptance.

steps.title: 區分 PUE 與供電效率：建立模型

steps.failureEn: If separate pue and power efficiency disagrees with prediction, separately check definitions/scaling, assumptions and sensing/data faults. Do not hide the limits of A/B distribution, redundant capacity, common failures and operational evidence behind one passing number.
steps.check: 交付「區分 PUE 與供電效率」的圖或計算、預測、指定對照、單位與一項尚未驗證的假設；說明何種觀察應暫緩放行。

steps.objective: 以可檢驗證據理解建立電流斜率限制，辨識物理機制、量測條件與模型限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand build current-slew limits through testable evidence, distinguishing physics, measurement conditions and model limits.
steps.instruction: 在負載階躍模型加入斜率限制，記錄母線偏差與緩衝能量。 先畫出系統邊界與能量或訊號方向，逐項寫明單位、定義和固定條件，再預測結果；只使用離線模型或已取得的公開紀錄。
steps.instructionEn: Add a slew limit to a load-step model and record bus deviation and buffer energy. First draw the system boundary and energy/signal direction. State units, definitions and controlled conditions, then predict the result. Use offline models or already available public records only.
steps.observation: 在負載階躍模型加入斜率限制，記錄母線偏差與緩衝能量。 比較前先確認量綱與取樣時間一致；若差異小於不確定度，保留未定結論。
steps.observationEn: Add a slew limit to a load-step model and record bus deviation and buffer energy. Match dimensions and sampling time before comparison; retain an unresolved conclusion if differences are below uncertainty.
steps.failure: 若「建立電流斜率限制」的結果與預測不符，分別檢查定義／尺度、模型前提及感測或數據錯誤；不要把燃料電池極化、輸入紋波與升壓控制的限制隱藏在單一合格數字中。
steps.failureEn: If build current-slew limits disagrees with prediction, separately check definitions/scaling, assumptions and sensing/data faults. Do not hide the limits of fuel-cell polarization, input ripple and boost regulation behind one passing number.
steps.check: 交付「建立電流斜率限制」的圖或計算、預測、指定對照、單位與一項尚未驗證的假設；說明何種觀察應暫緩放行。
steps.checkEn: Submit a diagram/calculation for build current-slew limits, prediction, specified comparison, units and one unvalidated assumption. State which observation requires withholding acceptance.

knowledge.title: 建立電流斜率限制：原理
knowledge.text: 堆疊電流斜率限制應由系統能力決定，不可一味追求快速外環。
knowledge.textEn: Stack current slew should reflect system capability, not simply maximize outer-loop speed.

knowledge.title: 建立電流斜率限制：證據
knowledge.text: 在負載階躍模型加入斜率限制，記錄母線偏差與緩衝能量。
knowledge.textEn: Add a slew limit to a load-step model and record bus deviation and buffer energy.

knowledge.title: 本課可重算的算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 教學例：堆疊 100 V 供 20 kW 負載、轉換效率 95%，平均輸入 I=Pout/(ηVin)=210.5 A。若 Vin 下降到 80 V，同功率需 263.2 A，顯示把堆疊當理想電壓源會低估電流。 本課不涵蓋氫氣管線、燃料供應啟停或化學操作；堆疊限制以供應商資料及專業試驗為準。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching example: a 100 V stack supplies 20 kW at 95% converter efficiency, requiring I=Pout/(ηVin)=210.5 A. At 80 V the same output requires 263.2 A, showing why an ideal-voltage-source assumption understates current. Hydrogen piping, fuel-system startup and chemical operations are outside scope; stack limits require supplier data and professional tests.

quiz.question: 關於「建立電流斜率限制：建立模型」，哪一項是本步有依據的主張或驗證方式？
quiz.questionEn: For “Build current-slew limits: build the model”, which claim or verification is justified?
options: 只要數值接近名目值，就不必檢查單位、量測邊界與誤差。
堆疊電流斜率限制應由系統能力決定，不可一味追求快速外環。
以其他課程或其他元件的額定值直接作本步的驗收門檻。
optionsEn: If a number is near its nominal value, units, boundaries and errors do not need checking.
Stack current slew should reflect system capability, not simply maximize outer-loop speed.
Use a rating from another course or device directly as this step’s acceptance limit.
quiz.explanation: 堆疊電流斜率限制應由系統能力決定，不可一味追求快速外環。 在負載階躍模型加入斜率限制，記錄母線偏差與緩衝能量。
quiz.explanationEn: Stack current slew should reflect system capability, not simply maximize outer-loop speed. Add a slew limit to a load-step model and record bus deviation and buffer energy.

scope: 公開原理支持的離線工程教學；24 步是學習拆解，不是完整工廠或現場 SOP。數字明示為假設教學例，不冒充廠商機密、實測或通用設定。船岸接線、接地、互鎖、同步與操作需合格港務及船舶專業規範；本課只做概念模型。
scopeEn: Offline engineering education based on public principles. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete factory/field SOP. Numbers are explicit teaching assumptions, not proprietary recipes, measurements or universal settings. Connections, grounding, interlocks, synchronization and operations require qualified port/marine engineering; this course uses conceptual models only.

stages.title: 岸船需求
stages.description: 以三個具體技術單元完成岸船需求；每單元先建立模型，再以對照和反證驗收。
stages.descriptionEn: Complete shore/ship requirements through three technical units, each pairing a model with controlled verification.

steps.title: 盤點船舶供電需求：建立模型
steps.titleEn: Inventory ship demand: build the model
steps.objective: 以可檢驗證據理解盤點船舶供電需求，辨識物理機制、量測條件與模型限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand inventory ship demand through testable evidence, distinguishing physics, measurement conditions and model limits.
steps.instruction: 以需求矩陣比較 50/60 Hz 和兩種船舶電壓，標示需轉換項目。 先畫出系統邊界與能量或訊號方向，逐項寫明單位、定義和固定條件，再預測結果；只使用離線模型或已取得的公開紀錄。
steps.instructionEn: Compare 50/60 Hz and two ship voltages in a requirement matrix and mark conversion needs. First draw the system boundary and energy/signal direction. State units, definitions and controlled conditions, then predict the result. Use offline models or already available public records only.
steps.observation: 以需求矩陣比較 50/60 Hz 和兩種船舶電壓，標示需轉換項目。 比較前先確認量綱與取樣時間一致；若差異小於不確定度，保留未定結論。
steps.observationEn: Compare 50/60 Hz and two ship voltages in a requirement matrix and mark conversion needs. Match dimensions and sampling time before comparison; retain an unresolved conclusion if differences are below uncertainty.
steps.failure: 若「盤點船舶供電需求」的結果與預測不符，分別檢查定義／尺度、模型前提及感測或數據錯誤；不要把岸船頻率轉換、接地介面與負載轉移的限制隱藏在單一合格數字中。
steps.failureEn: If inventory ship demand disagrees with prediction, separately check definitions/scaling, assumptions and sensing/data faults. Do not hide the limits of shore/ship frequency conversion, grounding interfaces and load transfer behind one passing number.
steps.check: 交付「盤點船舶供電需求」的圖或計算、預測、指定對照、單位與一項尚未驗證的假設；說明何種觀察應暫緩放行。
steps.checkEn: Submit a diagram/calculation for inventory ship demand, prediction, specified comparison, units and one unvalidated assumption. State which observation requires withholding acceptance.

knowledge.title: 盤點船舶供電需求：原理

knowledge.title: 本課可重算的算例與適用範圍

Connections, grounding, interlocks, synchronization and operations require qualified port/marine engineering; this course uses conceptual models only.

title: 感應馬達製造

summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps explore stator/rotor electromagnetics, manufacturing tolerances and machine validation, including 12 topic-specific models, controlled checks, original worked examples and related methods.
scope: 公開原理支持的離線工程教學；24 步是學習拆解，不是完整工廠或現場 SOP。數字明示為假設教學例，不冒充廠商機密、實測或通用設定。製造參數取決於材料與設計；本課為圖面、模擬和檢驗資料判讀，無帶電耐壓、加工與轉子超速指令。
scopeEn: Offline engineering education based on public principles. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete factory/field SOP. Numbers are explicit teaching assumptions, not proprietary recipes, measurements or universal settings. Manufacturing parameters depend on materials and design; the course interprets drawings, simulations and inspection data, without energized withstand, machining or overspeed instructions.

title: 永磁同步馬達製造
summary: 以 4 階段、24 步探討永磁材料、轉子拓樸、反電勢與退磁餘裕，包含 12 個專題模型、對照驗證、原創教學算例及延伸工法。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps explore magnet materials, rotor topology, back-EMF and demagnetization margin, including 12 topic-specific models, controlled checks, original worked examples and related methods.
scope: 公開原理支持的離線工程教學；24 步是學習拆解，不是完整工廠或現場 SOP。數字明示為假設教學例，不冒充廠商機密、實測或通用設定。磁鐵裝配、轉子保持及退磁驗證需材料與機械專業；本課無實體高速轉子製造或測試程序。
scopeEn: Offline engineering education based on public principles. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete factory/field SOP. Numbers are explicit teaching assumptions, not proprietary recipes, measurements or universal settings. Magnet assembly, rotor retention and demagnetization validation need materials/mechanical expertise; no physical high-speed rotor fabrication/testing procedure is given.

knowledge.text: 對兩種原創截面標出磁通與橋部，列出可與不可轉移的模型。
knowledge.textEn: Mark flux and bridges on two original cross sections and list transferable and nontransferable models.

knowledge.title: 本課可重算的算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 教學例：採峰值 dq 電流慣例，表面永磁機 T=1.5pψfIq。p=4、ψf=0.08 Wb、Iq=50 A 時 T=24 N·m；3,000 rpm 時理想機械功率 Tω≈7.54 kW。RMS 電流慣例下不可直接照搬係數。 磁鐵裝配、轉子保持及退磁驗證需材料與機械專業；本課無實體高速轉子製造或測試程序。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching example using peak dq currents: a surface-PM machine has T=1.5pψfIq. With p=4, ψf=0.08 Wb and Iq=50 A, T=24 N·m; at 3,000 rpm ideal mechanical power is about 7.54 kW. Do not reuse the coefficient unchanged with RMS conventions. Magnet assembly, rotor retention and demagnetization validation need materials/mechanical expertise; no physical high-speed rotor fabrication/testing procedure is given.

quiz.question: 關於「比較表貼與內埋磁鐵：反證與驗收」，哪一項是本步有依據的主張或驗證方式？
quiz.questionEn: For “Compare surface and interior magnets: challenge and acceptance”, which claim or verification is justified?
options: 只要數值接近名目值，就不必檢查單位、量測邊界與誤差。
以其他課程或其他元件的額定值直接作本步的驗收門檻。
對兩種原創截面標出磁通與橋部，列出可與不可轉移的模型。
optionsEn: If a number is near its nominal value, units, boundaries and errors do not need checking.
Use a rating from another course or device directly as this step’s acceptance limit.
Mark flux and bridges on two original cross sections and list transferable and nontransferable models.
quiz.explanation: 表貼與內埋拓樸在凸極性、磁阻轉矩及機械保持上不同。 對兩種原創截面標出磁通與橋部，列出可與不可轉移的模型。
quiz.explanationEn: Surface and interior PM rotors differ in saliency, reluctance torque and retention. Mark flux and bridges on two original cross sections and list transferable and nontransferable models.

steps.title: 讀取磁鐵 B–H 曲線：建立模型
steps.titleEn: Read magnet B–H curves: build the model
steps.objective: 以可檢驗證據理解讀取磁鐵 B–H 曲線，辨識物理機制、量測條件與模型限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand read magnet b–h curves through testable evidence, distinguishing physics, measurement conditions and model limits.
steps.instruction: 比較兩溫度退磁曲線與工作點，指出不可逆退磁風險方向。 先畫出系統邊界與能量或訊號方向，逐項寫明單位、定義和固定條件，再預測結果；只使用離線模型或已取得的公開紀錄。
steps.instructionEn: Compare demagnetization curves and operating points at two temperatures and identify irreversible-risk direction. First draw the system boundary and energy/signal direction. State units, definitions and controlled conditions, then predict the result. Use offline models or already available public records only.
steps.observation: 比較兩溫度退磁曲線與工作點，指出不可逆退磁風險方向。 比較前先確認量綱與取樣時間一致；若差異小於不確定度，保留未定結論。
steps.observationEn: Compare demagnetization curves and operating points at two temperatures and identify irreversible-risk direction. Match dimensions and sampling time before comparison; retain an unresolved conclusion if differences are below uncertainty.
steps.failure: 若「讀取磁鐵 B–H 曲線」的結果與預測不符，分別檢查定義／尺度、模型前提及感測或數據錯誤；不要把永磁材料、轉子拓樸、反電勢與退磁餘裕的限制隱藏在單一合格數字中。
steps.failureEn: If read magnet b–h curves disagrees with prediction, separately check definitions/scaling, assumptions and sensing/data faults. Do not hide the limits of magnet materials, rotor topology, back-EMF and demagnetization margin behind one passing number.
steps.check: 交付「讀取磁鐵 B–H 曲線」的圖或計算、預測、指定對照、單位與一項尚未驗證的假設；說明何種觀察應暫緩放行。
steps.checkEn: Submit a diagram/calculation for read magnet b–h curves, prediction, specified comparison, units and one unvalidated assumption. State which observation requires withholding acceptance.

steps.title: 建立極對數映射：建立模型

steps.objective: 以可檢驗證據理解建立極對數映射，辨識物理機制、量測條件與模型限制。

steps.failure: 若「建立極對數映射」的結果與預測不符，分別檢查定義／尺度、模型前提及感測或數據錯誤；不要把永磁材料、轉子拓樸、反電勢與退磁餘裕的限制隱藏在單一合格數字中。

steps.titleEn: Configure windings and sequence: build the model
steps.objective: 以可檢驗證據理解配置繞組與相序，辨識物理機制、量測條件與模型限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand configure windings and sequence through testable evidence, distinguishing physics, measurement conditions and model limits.
steps.instruction: 在離線三相反電勢資料交換兩相，觀察相序反轉。 先畫出系統邊界與能量或訊號方向，逐項寫明單位、定義和固定條件，再預測結果；只使用離線模型或已取得的公開紀錄。
steps.instructionEn: Swap two phases in offline three-phase EMF data and observe sequence reversal. First draw the system boundary and energy/signal direction. State units, definitions and controlled conditions, then predict the result. Use offline models or already available public records only.
steps.observation: 在離線三相反電勢資料交換兩相，觀察相序反轉。 比較前先確認量綱與取樣時間一致；若差異小於不確定度，保留未定結論。
steps.observationEn: Swap two phases in offline three-phase EMF data and observe sequence reversal. Match dimensions and sampling time before comparison; retain an unresolved conclusion if differences are below uncertainty.
steps.failure: 若「配置繞組與相序」的結果與預測不符，分別檢查定義／尺度、模型前提及感測或數據錯誤；不要把永磁材料、轉子拓樸、反電勢與退磁餘裕的限制隱藏在單一合格數字中。
steps.failureEn: If configure windings and sequence disagrees with prediction, separately check definitions/scaling, assumptions and sensing/data faults. Do not hide the limits of magnet materials, rotor topology, back-EMF and demagnetization margin behind one passing number.
steps.check: 交付「配置繞組與相序」的圖或計算、預測、指定對照、單位與一項尚未驗證的假設；說明何種觀察應暫緩放行。
steps.checkEn: Submit a diagram/calculation for configure windings and sequence, prediction, specified comparison, units and one unvalidated assumption. State which observation requires withholding acceptance.

knowledge.title: 本課可重算的算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 教學例：採峰值 dq 電流慣例，表面永磁機 T=1.5pψfIq。p=4、ψf=0.08 Wb、Iq=50 A 時 T=24 N·m；3,000 rpm 時理想機械功率 Tω≈7.54 kW。RMS 電流慣例下不可直接照搬係數。 磁鐵裝配、轉子保持及退磁驗證需材料與機械專業；本課無實體高速轉子製造或測試程序。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching example using peak dq currents: a surface-PM machine has T=1.5pψfIq. With p=4, ψf=0.08 Wb and Iq=50 A, T=24 N·m; at 3,000 rpm ideal mechanical power is about 7.54 kW. Do not reuse the coefficient unchanged with RMS conventions. Magnet assembly, rotor retention and demagnetization validation need materials/mechanical expertise; no physical high-speed rotor fabrication/testing procedure is given.

summary: 以 4 階段、24 步探討磁阻轉矩、相電流成形與換相區間，包含 12 個專題模型、對照驗證、原創教學算例及延伸工法。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps explore reluctance torque, phase-current shaping and commutation intervals, including 12 topic-specific models, controlled checks, original worked examples and related methods.
scope: 公開原理支持的離線工程教學；24 步是學習拆解，不是完整工廠或現場 SOP。數字明示為假設教學例，不冒充廠商機密、實測或通用設定。磁路飽和、非線性和機械噪音不可由單一線性式充分描述；僅做模擬與公開資料判讀。
scopeEn: Offline engineering education based on public principles. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete factory/field SOP. Numbers are explicit teaching assumptions, not proprietary recipes, measurements or universal settings. Magnetic saturation, nonlinearity and acoustic behavior exceed one linear equation; work is limited to simulation and public-data interpretation.

stages.title: 磁路與角度
stages.description: 以三個具體技術單元完成磁路與角度；每單元先建立模型，再以對照和反證驗收。
stages.descriptionEn: Complete magnetics and angle through three technical units, each pairing a model with controlled verification.

steps.title: 標記凸極結構：建立模型
steps.titleEn: Identify doubly salient geometry: build the model
steps.objective: 以可檢驗證據理解標記凸極結構，辨識物理機制、量測條件與模型限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand identify doubly salient geometry through testable evidence, distinguishing physics, measurement conditions and model limits.
steps.instruction: 在對齊與未對齊兩張示意圖比較磁阻和電感方向。 先畫出系統邊界與能量或訊號方向，逐項寫明單位、定義和固定條件，再預測結果；只使用離線模型或已取得的公開紀錄。
steps.instructionEn: Compare reluctance/inductance directions in aligned and unaligned sketches. First draw the system boundary and energy/signal direction. State units, definitions and controlled conditions, then predict the result. Use offline models or already available public records only.
steps.observation: 在對齊與未對齊兩張示意圖比較磁阻和電感方向。 比較前先確認量綱與取樣時間一致；若差異小於不確定度，保留未定結論。
steps.observationEn: Compare reluctance/inductance directions in aligned and unaligned sketches. Match dimensions and sampling time before comparison; retain an unresolved conclusion if differences are below uncertainty.
steps.failure: 若「標記凸極結構」的結果與預測不符，分別檢查定義／尺度、模型前提及感測或數據錯誤；不要把磁阻轉矩、相電流成形與換相區間的限制隱藏在單一合格數字中。
steps.failureEn: If identify doubly salient geometry disagrees with prediction, separately check definitions/scaling, assumptions and sensing/data faults. Do not hide the limits of reluctance torque, phase-current shaping and commutation intervals behind one passing number.
steps.check: 交付「標記凸極結構」的圖或計算、預測、指定對照、單位與一項尚未驗證的假設；說明何種觀察應暫緩放行。

knowledge.title: 標記凸極結構：原理
knowledge.text: 磁阻機轉子無永久磁鐵，轉矩來自磁路隨角度改變。
knowledge.textEn: An SR rotor has no permanent magnets; torque arises from angle-dependent magnetic paths.

knowledge.title: 標記凸極結構：證據
knowledge.text: 在對齊與未對齊兩張示意圖比較磁阻和電感方向。

knowledge.title: 本課可重算的算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 教學例：線性未飽和近似 T≈0.5i²dL/dθ。i=10 A、dL/dθ=0.02 H/rad 時 T≈1 N·m。角度若以度表示需先換為 rad；飽和時必須改用磁共能曲線，不可外推 i²。 磁路飽和、非線性和機械噪音不可由單一線性式充分描述；僅做模擬與公開資料判讀。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching example in the unsaturated linear approximation: T≈0.5i²dL/dθ. With i=10 A and dL/dθ=0.02 H/rad, T≈1 N·m. Angles must be in radians; saturation requires co-energy curves rather than extrapolating i². Magnetic saturation, nonlinearity and acoustic behavior exceed one linear equation; work is limited to simulation and public-data interpretation.

Withhold acceptance if assumptions fail.

steps.observationEn: Compare force-spectrum peaks with assumed structural modes and distinguish excitation from response. Match dimensions and sampling time before comparison; retain an unresolved conclusion if differences are below uncertainty.

title: 線性馬達定位平台
summary: 以 4 階段、24 步探討直線力、熱負載、位置回授與機械模態，包含 12 個專題模型、對照驗證、原創教學算例及延伸工法。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps explore linear force, thermal load, position feedback and mechanical modes, including 12 topic-specific models, controlled checks, original worked examples and related methods.
scope: 公開原理支持的離線工程教學；24 步是學習拆解，不是完整工廠或現場 SOP。數字明示為假設教學例，不冒充廠商機密、實測或通用設定。RMS 力只是熱估算的一部分，導軌、電纜拖鏈、碰撞及垂直軸安全另需專業設計。
scopeEn: Offline engineering education based on public principles. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete factory/field SOP. Numbers are explicit teaching assumptions, not proprietary recipes, measurements or universal settings. RMS force is only part of thermal sizing; guides, cable chains, collision and vertical-axis safety need separate professional design.

stages.title: 行程與力
stages.description: 以三個具體技術單元完成行程與力；每單元先建立模型，再以對照和反證驗收。
stages.descriptionEn: Complete travel and force through three technical units, each pairing a model with controlled verification.

steps.title: 建立負載與行程：建立模型

steps.objective: 以可檢驗證據理解建立負載與行程，辨識物理機制、量測條件與模型限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand build load and travel requirements through testable evidence, distinguishing physics, measurement conditions and model limits.
steps.instruction: 將各質量分項加總，用 ±10% 質量變化測試推力需求。 先畫出系統邊界與能量或訊號方向，逐項寫明單位、定義和固定條件，再預測結果；只使用離線模型或已取得的公開紀錄。

steps.observation: 將各質量分項加總，用 ±10% 質量變化測試推力需求。 比較前先確認量綱與取樣時間一致；若差異小於不確定度，保留未定結論。

steps.failure: 若「建立負載與行程」的結果與預測不符，分別檢查定義／尺度、模型前提及感測或數據錯誤；不要把直線力、熱負載、位置回授與機械模態的限制隱藏在單一合格數字中。

knowledge.text: 教學例：20 kg 移動負載需 2 m/s² 加速度、外力摩擦共 15 N，理想推力 F=ma+F外=55 N。若此推力占週期 25%、其餘無力，Frms=55√0.25=27.5 N；實際回程與保持力也必須納入。 RMS 力只是熱估算的一部分，導軌、電纜拖鏈、碰撞及垂直軸安全另需專業設計。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching example: moving 20 kg at 2 m/s² against 15 N external/friction force requires F=ma+Fexternal=55 N. title: 無刷直流馬達驅動器
summary: 以 4 階段、24 步探討六步換相、反電勢偵測與電流控制，包含 12 個專題模型、對照驗證、原創教學算例及延伸工法。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps explore six-step commutation, back-EMF sensing and current regulation, including 12 topic-specific models, controlled checks, original worked examples and related methods.
scope: 公開原理支持的離線工程教學；24 步是學習拆解，不是完整工廠或現場 SOP。數字明示為假設教學例，不冒充廠商機密、實測或通用設定。電路操作限於模擬；六步控制不適合用作所有 PMSM 的通用性能保證，電機波形與熱限制須匹配。
scopeEn: Offline engineering education based on public principles. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete factory/field SOP. Numbers are explicit teaching assumptions, not proprietary recipes, measurements or universal settings. Circuit work is simulation-only; six-step control is not a universal performance guarantee for all PMSMs, and waveform/thermal compatibility must be checked.

knowledge.textEn: Teaching example: four pole pairs at 3,000 rpm give fe=pn/60=200 Hz. Six sectors per electrical cycle imply 1,200 commutations/s and about 0.833 ms per sector. PWM frequency and commutation frequency are different variables. Circuit work is simulation-only; six-step control is not a universal performance guarantee for all PMSMs, and waveform/thermal compatibility must be checked.

optionsEn: If a number is near its nominal value, units, boundaries and errors do not need checking.
Eliminate same-leg simultaneous-on combinations in an offline truth table without generating hardware signals.
Use a rating from another course or device directly as this step’s acceptance limit.

title: 伺服馬達編碼器整合
summary: 以 4 階段、24 步探討編碼器尺度、角度校準、同步取樣與錯誤診斷，包含 12 個專題模型、對照驗證、原創教學算例及延伸工法。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps explore encoder scaling, angle calibration, synchronous sampling and diagnostics, including 12 topic-specific models, controlled checks, original worked examples and related methods.
scope: 公開原理支持的離線工程教學；24 步是學習拆解，不是完整工廠或現場 SOP。數字明示為假設教學例，不冒充廠商機密、實測或通用設定。不同編碼器的線數、位元、更新率與協定定義不同；須核對資料表及時間語義，不保證任意接口可互換。
scopeEn: Offline engineering education based on public principles. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete factory/field SOP. Numbers are explicit teaching assumptions, not proprietary recipes, measurements or universal settings. Line count, bits, update rates and protocol definitions vary; verify datasheets and timing semantics rather than assume interchangeable interfaces.

stages.title: 碼尺與介面

steps.title: 比較增量與絕對位置：建立模型
steps.titleEn: Compare incremental and absolute position: build the model
steps.objective: 以可檢驗證據理解比較增量與絕對位置，辨識物理機制、量測條件與模型限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand compare incremental and absolute position through testable evidence, distinguishing physics, measurement conditions and model limits.
steps.instruction: 讓離線計數器失電後重啟，對照是否仍知道軸位置。 先畫出系統邊界與能量或訊號方向，逐項寫明單位、定義和固定條件，再預測結果；只使用離線模型或已取得的公開紀錄。
steps.instructionEn: Power-cycle an offline counter and compare whether shaft position remains known. First draw the system boundary and energy/signal direction. State units, definitions and controlled conditions, then predict the result. Use offline models or already available public records only.
steps.observation: 讓離線計數器失電後重啟，對照是否仍知道軸位置。 比較前先確認量綱與取樣時間一致；若差異小於不確定度，保留未定結論。

steps.failure: 若「比較增量與絕對位置」的結果與預測不符，分別檢查定義／尺度、模型前提及感測或數據錯誤；不要把編碼器尺度、角度校準、同步取樣與錯誤診斷的限制隱藏在單一合格數字中。
steps.failureEn: If compare incremental and absolute position disagrees with prediction, separately check definitions/scaling, assumptions and sensing/data faults. Do not hide the limits of encoder scaling, angle calibration, synchronous sampling and diagnostics behind one passing number.
steps.check: 交付「比較增量與絕對位置」的圖或計算、預測、指定對照、單位與一項尚未驗證的假設；說明何種觀察應暫緩放行。
steps.checkEn: Submit a diagram/calculation for compare incremental and absolute position, prediction, specified comparison, units and one unvalidated assumption. State which observation requires withholding acceptance.

knowledge.text: 增量介面記錄位移，絕對介面提供編碼位置，斷電後行為不同。
knowledge.textEn: Incremental interfaces track motion; absolute interfaces encode position, with different power-loss behavior.

knowledge.title: 比較增量與絕對位置：證據

knowledge.title: 本課可重算的算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 教學例：增量編碼器每圈 2,500 線，以四倍計數得到 10,000 counts/rev，機械解析度 0.036°。四極對馬達的電角解析度是 0.144°，而非 0.036°；解析度不代表絕對精度。 不同編碼器的線數、位元、更新率與協定定義不同；須核對資料表及時間語義，不保證任意接口可互換。

A four-pole-pair motor has 0.144° electrical resolution, not 0.036°. Resolution is not absolute accuracy. Line count, bits, update rates and protocol definitions vary; verify datasheets and timing semantics rather than assume interchangeable interfaces.

延遲造成角誤差 Δθ=ωΔt，高速下即使高解析度仍可能不準。

Use a rating from another course or device directly as this step’s acceptance limit.
Delay gives angle error Δθ=ωΔt; high resolution does not prevent high-speed error.

steps.title: 估算取樣延遲：反證與驗收

steps.instructionEn: Use the model and state an observation that would refute this claim: Delay gives angle error Δθ=ωΔt; high resolution does not prevent high-speed error. At 3,000 rpm and 100 μs delay compute 1.8° mechanical and 7.2° electrical for four pole pairs. Add a control condition and separate raw data, inference and uncertainty. Withhold acceptance if assumptions fail.

steps.observationEn: At 3,000 rpm and 100 μs delay compute 1.8° mechanical and 7.2° electrical for four pole pairs. Match dimensions and sampling time before comparison; retain an unresolved conclusion if differences are below uncertainty.

knowledge.title: 交付故障可觀測表：原理
knowledge.text: CRC 正確仍可能有機械鬆動、比例錯誤或老舊資料。

knowledge.title: 交付故障可觀測表：證據
knowledge.text: 為每類故障指定獨立證據：時戳、電頻率、參考位置或冗餘感測。
knowledge.textEn: Assign independent evidence—timestamp, electrical frequency, reference position or redundant sensing—to each fault.

knowledge.title: 本課可重算的算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 教學例：增量編碼器每圈 2,500 線，以四倍計數得到 10,000 counts/rev，機械解析度 0.036°。四極對馬達的電角解析度是 0.144°，而非 0.036°；解析度不代表絕對精度。 不同編碼器的線數、位元、更新率與協定定義不同；須核對資料表及時間語義，不保證任意接口可互換。

title: 馬達磁場導向控制
summary: 以 4 階段、24 步探討Clarke/Park 變換、dq 電流迴路與電壓限制，包含 12 個專題模型、對照驗證、原創教學算例及延伸工法。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps explore Clarke/Park transforms, dq current loops and voltage limits, including 12 topic-specific models, controlled checks, original worked examples and related methods.
scope: 公開原理支持的離線工程教學；24 步是學習拆解，不是完整工廠或現場 SOP。數字明示為假設教學例，不冒充廠商機密、實測或通用設定。必須固定幅值/功率不變尺度、峰值/RMS 和角度正方向；不同慣例不能混搭控制器參數。
scopeEn: Offline engineering education based on public principles. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete factory/field SOP. Numbers are explicit teaching assumptions, not proprietary recipes, measurements or universal settings. Fix amplitude/power-invariant scaling, peak/RMS convention and angle direction; do not mix controller parameters across conventions.

options: 只要數值接近名目值，就不必檢查單位、量測邊界與誤差。
以其他課程或其他元件的額定值直接作本步的驗收門檻。
αβ 將三相映到靜止兩軸，縮放選擇改變幅值與功率係數。
optionsEn: If a number is near its nominal value, units, boundaries and errors do not need checking.
Use a rating from another course or device directly as this step’s acceptance limit.
Clarke maps phases to stationary axes; scaling changes amplitudes and power coefficients.
quiz.explanation: αβ 將三相映到靜止兩軸，縮放選擇改變幅值與功率係數。 對一組已知三相正弦逐點換算，驗證旋轉向量半徑。
quiz.explanationEn: Clarke maps phases to stationary axes; scaling changes amplitudes and power coefficients. Transform known three-phase sinusoids sample by sample and verify rotating-vector radius.

steps.title: 套用 Clarke 變換：反證與驗收
steps.titleEn: Apply Clarke transforms: challenge and acceptance
steps.objective: 以可檢驗證據理解套用 Clarke 變換，辨識物理機制、量測條件與模型限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand apply clarke transforms through testable evidence, distinguishing physics, measurement conditions and model limits.
steps.instruction: 先沿用模型，寫下會推翻「αβ 將三相映到靜止兩軸，縮放選擇改變幅值與功率係數。」的觀察。對一組已知三相正弦逐點換算，驗證旋轉向量半徑。 加入一個對照條件，分開記錄原始數據、推論與不確定度；若前提失效則暫緩判定。
steps.instructionEn: Use the model and state an observation that would refute this claim: Clarke maps phases to stationary axes; scaling changes amplitudes and power coefficients. Transform known three-phase sinusoids sample by sample and verify rotating-vector radius. Add a control condition and separate raw data, inference and uncertainty. Withhold acceptance if assumptions fail.
steps.observation: 對一組已知三相正弦逐點換算，驗證旋轉向量半徑。 比較前先確認量綱與取樣時間一致；若差異小於不確定度，保留未定結論。
steps.observationEn: Transform known three-phase sinusoids sample by sample and verify rotating-vector radius. Match dimensions and sampling time before comparison; retain an unresolved conclusion if differences are below uncertainty.
steps.failure: 若「套用 Clarke 變換」的結果與預測不符，分別檢查定義／尺度、模型前提及感測或數據錯誤；不要把Clarke/Park 變換、dq 電流迴路與電壓限制的限制隱藏在單一合格數字中。
steps.failureEn: If apply clarke transforms disagrees with prediction, separately check definitions/scaling, assumptions and sensing/data faults. Do not hide the limits of Clarke/Park transforms, dq current loops and voltage limits behind one passing number.
steps.check: 交付「套用 Clarke 變換」的圖或計算、預測、指定對照、單位與一項尚未驗證的假設；說明何種觀察應暫緩放行。
steps.checkEn: Submit a diagram/calculation for apply clarke transforms, prediction, specified comparison, units and one unvalidated assumption. State which observation requires withholding acceptance.

knowledge.title: 套用 Clarke 變換：證據
knowledge.text: 對一組已知三相正弦逐點換算，驗證旋轉向量半徑。
knowledge.textEn: Transform known three-phase sinusoids sample by sample and verify rotating-vector radius.

knowledge.title: 本課可重算的算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 教學例：採幅值不變 Park 變換，三相平衡電流峰值 10 A，對齊旋轉座標後 d/q 向量幅值仍 10 A。電功率是 1.5(VdId+VqIq)；若 Vq=100 V、Iq=10 A、Vd=Id=0，P=1.5 kW。 必須固定幅值/功率不變尺度、峰值/RMS 和角度正方向；不同慣例不能混搭控制器參數。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching example with amplitude-invariant Park scaling: balanced three-phase current of 10 A peak gives a 10 A dq-vector magnitude in an aligned frame. Power is 1.5(VdId+VqIq); Vq=100 V, Iq=10 A and Vd=Id=0 give 1.5 kW. Fix amplitude/power-invariant scaling, peak/RMS convention and angle direction; do not mix controller parameters across conventions.

scope: 公開原理支持的離線工程教學；24 步是學習拆解，不是完整工廠或現場 SOP。數字明示為假設教學例，不冒充廠商機密、實測或通用設定。估測器適用性依電機、速度、飽和與訊號品質而異；未配置真實參考量測時不宣稱實機角度精度。
scopeEn: Offline engineering education based on public principles. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete factory/field SOP. knowledge.text: 教學例：用 e=v−Ri−Ldi/dt 估反電勢，若真 e=1 V、電阻誤差 ΔR=0.05 Ω、電流 10 A，僅電阻誤差就造成 0.5 V 偏差。高速 e=20 V 時同偏差只占 2.5%，顯示低速更難。 估測器適用性依電機、速度、飽和與訊號品質而異；未配置真實參考量測時不宣稱實機角度精度。

knowledge.text: 教學例：用 e=v−Ri−Ldi/dt 估反電勢，若真 e=1 V、電阻誤差 ΔR=0.05 Ω、電流 10 A，僅電阻誤差就造成 0.5 V 偏差。高速 e=20 V 時同偏差只占 2.5%，顯示低速更難。 估測器適用性依電機、速度、飽和與訊號品質而異；未配置真實參考量測時不宣稱實機角度精度。

title: 再生煞車電力回收
summary: 以 4 階段、24 步探討機械動能、回生轉矩與儲能接受能力，包含 12 個專題模型、對照驗證、原創教學算例及延伸工法。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps explore kinetic energy, regenerative torque and storage acceptance, including 12 topic-specific models, controlled checks, original worked examples and related methods.
scope: 公開原理支持的離線工程教學；24 步是學習拆解，不是完整工廠或現場 SOP。數字明示為假設教學例，不冒充廠商機密、實測或通用設定。這是離線功率與控制課，不是道路車輛煞車改裝指南；制動安全與功能安全需獨立專業驗證。
scopeEn: Offline engineering education based on public principles. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete factory/field SOP. Numbers are explicit teaching assumptions, not proprietary recipes, measurements or universal settings. This is offline power/control education, not a road-vehicle braking modification guide; braking and functional safety need independent professional validation.

summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps explore magnetic-bearing feedback, negative stiffness, rotor modes and rundown energy, including 12 topic-specific models, controlled checks, original worked examples and related methods.

steps.objective: 以可檢驗證據理解配置位移感測，辨識物理機制、量測條件與模型限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand configure displacement sensing through testable evidence, distinguishing physics, measurement conditions and model limits.
steps.instruction: 比較轉子靜態跳動表與運轉位移頻譜，提出補償界線。 先畫出系統邊界與能量或訊號方向，逐項寫明單位、定義和固定條件，再預測結果；只使用離線模型或已取得的公開紀錄。
steps.instructionEn: Compare static runout maps and operating displacement spectra and define compensation bounds. First draw the system boundary and energy/signal direction. State units, definitions and controlled conditions, then predict the result. Use offline models or already available public records only.
steps.observation: 比較轉子靜態跳動表與運轉位移頻譜，提出補償界線。 比較前先確認量綱與取樣時間一致；若差異小於不確定度，保留未定結論。
steps.observationEn: Compare static runout maps and operating displacement spectra and define compensation bounds. Match dimensions and sampling time before comparison; retain an unresolved conclusion if differences are below uncertainty.
steps.failure: 若「配置位移感測」的結果與預測不符，分別檢查定義／尺度、模型前提及感測或數據錯誤；不要把磁浮位置回授、負剛性、轉子模態與停機能量的限制隱藏在單一合格數字中。
steps.failureEn: If configure displacement sensing disagrees with prediction, separately check definitions/scaling, assumptions and sensing/data faults. Do not hide the limits of magnetic-bearing feedback, negative stiffness, rotor modes and rundown energy behind one passing number.
steps.check: 交付「配置位移感測」的圖或計算、預測、指定對照、單位與一項尚未驗證的假設；說明何種觀察應暫緩放行。
steps.checkEn: Submit a diagram/calculation for configure displacement sensing, prediction, specified comparison, units and one unvalidated assumption. State which observation requires withholding acceptance.

knowledge.title: 配置位移感測：原理
knowledge.text: 感測器量到的是其位置附近表面，幾何跳動可混入真實運動。
knowledge.textEn: Sensors see the nearby rotor surface; geometric runout can mix with true motion.

knowledge.title: 配置位移感測：證據
knowledge.text: 比較轉子靜態跳動表與運轉位移頻譜，提出補償界線。
knowledge.textEn: Compare static runout maps and operating displacement spectra and define compensation bounds.

knowledge.title: 本課可重算的算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 教學例：簡化吸力 F≈kI²/g²，若電流固定而氣隙由 1.0 降至 0.8 mm，吸力增至 1/0.8²=1.5625 倍。轉子越靠近磁極吸力越強，顯示需主動穩定；此式忽略飽和和漏磁。 磁浮軸承屬高速轉子安全關鍵系統；只分析公開概念及合成數據，不指導超速、拆卸或實機增益調整。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching example: approximate attraction F≈kI²/g². At fixed current reducing gap from 1.0 to 0.8 mm raises force by 1/0.8²=1.5625. Attraction grows as the rotor approaches a pole, requiring active stabilization; saturation and leakage are omitted. Magnetic bearings are safety-critical high-speed rotor systems; only public concepts and synthetic data are analyzed, without overspeed, disassembly or live tuning instructions.

quiz.question: 關於「配置位移感測：建立模型」，哪一項是本步有依據的主張或驗證方式？

options: 感測器量到的是其位置附近表面，幾何跳動可混入真實運動。
只要數值接近名目值，就不必檢查單位、量測邊界與誤差。
以其他課程或其他元件的額定值直接作本步的驗收門檻。
optionsEn: Sensors see the nearby rotor surface; geometric runout can mix with true motion.
If a number is near its nominal value, units, boundaries and errors do not need checking.
Use a rating from another course or device directly as this step’s acceptance limit.
quiz.explanation: 感測器量到的是其位置附近表面，幾何跳動可混入真實運動。 比較轉子靜態跳動表與運轉位移頻譜，提出補償界線。
quiz.explanationEn: Sensors see the nearby rotor surface; geometric runout can mix with true motion. Compare static runout maps and operating displacement spectra and define compensation bounds.

title: 碳化矽牽引逆變器
summary: 以 4 階段、24 步探討SiC 開關暫態、牽引效率與電熱限制，包含 12 個專題模型、對照驗證、原創教學算例及延伸工法。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps explore SiC switching transients, traction efficiency and electrothermal limits, including 12 topic-specific models, controlled checks, original worked examples and related methods.
scope: 公開原理支持的離線工程教學；24 步是學習拆解，不是完整工廠或現場 SOP。數字明示為假設教學例，不冒充廠商機密、實測或通用設定。電動車高壓牽引系統需絕緣、功能安全與專業試驗；本課只操作合成波形和模型，不提供實機高壓接線。
scopeEn: Offline engineering education based on public principles. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete factory/field SOP. Numbers are explicit teaching assumptions, not proprietary recipes, measurements or universal settings. High-voltage traction requires insulation, functional safety and professional tests; this course uses synthetic traces/models without physical high-voltage wiring instructions.

knowledge.title: 本課可重算的算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 教學例：假設一次開關 Eon+Eoff=2 mJ、fs=20 kHz，單顆近似開關損耗 40 W。若導通 RMS 電流 100 A、等效 Rds(on)=5 mΩ，導通損耗 50 W；R 值必須對應工作溫度，開關能量也須對應電壓電流條件。 電動車高壓牽引系統需絕緣、功能安全與專業試驗；本課只操作合成波形和模型，不提供實機高壓接線。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching example: assumed Eon+Eoff=2 mJ at fs=20 kHz gives about 40 W switching loss per device. At 100 A RMS and effective Rds(on)=5 mΩ, conduction loss is 50 W. Resistance must match operating temperature and switching energy must match voltage/current conditions. High-voltage traction requires insulation, functional safety and professional tests; this course uses synthetic traces/models without physical high-voltage wiring instructions.

options: 只要數值接近名目值，就不必檢查單位、量測邊界與誤差。
峰值功率、持續轉矩與回生能力須分開指定。
以其他課程或其他元件的額定值直接作本步的驗收門檻。
optionsEn: If a number is near its nominal value, units, boundaries and errors do not need checking.
Peak power, continuous torque and regeneration must be specified separately.
Use a rating from another course or device directly as this step’s acceptance limit.
quiz.explanation: 峰值功率、持續轉矩與回生能力須分開指定。 建立轉矩—轉速圖，加入電池電壓上下限兩種情境。
quiz.explanationEn: Peak power, continuous torque and regeneration must be specified separately. Build torque-speed maps for low/high battery voltage.

steps.title: 界定牽引工作區：反證與驗收
steps.titleEn: Bound traction operation: challenge and acceptance
steps.objective: 以可檢驗證據理解界定牽引工作區，辨識物理機制、量測條件與模型限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand bound traction operation through testable evidence, distinguishing physics, measurement conditions and model limits.
steps.instruction: 先沿用模型，寫下會推翻「峰值功率、持續轉矩與回生能力須分開指定。」的觀察。建立轉矩—轉速圖，加入電池電壓上下限兩種情境。 加入一個對照條件，分開記錄原始數據、推論與不確定度；若前提失效則暫緩判定。
steps.instructionEn: Use the model and state an observation that would refute this claim: Peak power, continuous torque and regeneration must be specified separately. Build torque-speed maps for low/high battery voltage. Add a control condition and separate raw data, inference and uncertainty. Withhold acceptance if assumptions fail.
steps.observation: 建立轉矩—轉速圖，加入電池電壓上下限兩種情境。 比較前先確認量綱與取樣時間一致；若差異小於不確定度，保留未定結論。
steps.observationEn: Build torque-speed maps for low/high battery voltage. Match dimensions and sampling time before comparison; retain an unresolved conclusion if differences are below uncertainty.
steps.failure: 若「界定牽引工作區」的結果與預測不符，分別檢查定義／尺度、模型前提及感測或數據錯誤；不要把SiC 開關暫態、牽引效率與電熱限制的限制隱藏在單一合格數字中。
steps.failureEn: If bound traction operation disagrees with prediction, separately check definitions/scaling, assumptions and sensing/data faults. Do not hide the limits of SiC switching transients, traction efficiency and electrothermal limits behind one passing number.
steps.check: 交付「界定牽引工作區」的圖或計算、預測、指定對照、單位與一項尚未驗證的假設；說明何種觀察應暫緩放行。
steps.checkEn: Submit a diagram/calculation for bound traction operation, prediction, specified comparison, units and one unvalidated assumption. State which observation requires withholding acceptance.

knowledge.title: 本課可重算的算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 教學例：假設一次開關 Eon+Eoff=2 mJ、fs=20 kHz，單顆近似開關損耗 40 W。若導通 RMS 電流 100 A、等效 Rds(on)=5 mΩ，導通損耗 50 W；R 值必須對應工作溫度，開關能量也須對應電壓電流條件。 電動車高壓牽引系統需絕緣、功能安全與專業試驗；本課只操作合成波形和模型，不提供實機高壓接線。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching example: assumed Eon+Eoff=2 mJ at fs=20 kHz gives about 40 W switching loss per device. At 100 A RMS and effective Rds(on)=5 mΩ, conduction loss is 50 W. Resistance must match operating temperature and switching energy must match voltage/current conditions. High-voltage traction requires insulation, functional safety and professional tests; this course uses synthetic traces/models without physical high-voltage wiring instructions.

knowledge.textEn: Blocking rating does not permit arbitrary overshoot; temperature/life need margin.

knowledge.title: 核對額定與降額：證據
knowledge.text: 把 DC 最大值、寄生過衝及不確定度分欄，標出待驗證設計裕度。
knowledge.textEn: Separate maximum DC voltage, parasitic overshoot and uncertainty, marking margin for validation.

knowledge.title: 本課可重算的算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 教學例：假設一次開關 Eon+Eoff=2 mJ、fs=20 kHz，單顆近似開關損耗 40 W。若導通 RMS 電流 100 A、等效 Rds(on)=5 mΩ，導通損耗 50 W；R 值必須對應工作溫度，開關能量也須對應電壓電流條件。 電動車高壓牽引系統需絕緣、功能安全與專業試驗；本課只操作合成波形和模型，不提供實機高壓接線。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching example: assumed Eon+Eoff=2 mJ at fs=20 kHz gives about 40 W switching loss per device. At 100 A RMS and effective Rds(on)=5 mΩ, conduction loss is 50 W. Resistance must match operating temperature and switching energy must match voltage/current conditions. High-voltage traction requires insulation, functional safety and professional tests; this course uses synthetic traces/models without physical high-voltage wiring instructions.

quiz.question: 關於「核對額定與降額：反證與驗收」，哪一項是本步有依據的主張或驗證方式？
quiz.questionEn: For “Check ratings and derating: challenge and acceptance”, which claim or verification is justified?
options: 把 DC 最大值、寄生過衝及不確定度分欄，標出待驗證設計裕度。
只要數值接近名目值，就不必檢查單位、量測邊界與誤差。
以其他課程或其他元件的額定值直接作本步的驗收門檻。
optionsEn: Separate maximum DC voltage, parasitic overshoot and uncertainty, marking margin for validation.
If a number is near its nominal value, units, boundaries and errors do not need checking.
Use a rating from another course or device directly as this step’s acceptance limit.
quiz.explanation: 阻斷電壓額定不等於允許所有開關過衝，溫度與壽命需餘裕。 把 DC 最大值、寄生過衝及不確定度分欄，標出待驗證設計裕度。
quiz.explanationEn: Blocking rating does not permit arbitrary overshoot; temperature/life need margin. Separate maximum DC voltage, parasitic overshoot and uncertainty, marking margin for validation.

stages.title: 門極與母線
